    // §3.4) and the v3 card; headings and spots seeded. `me` is the battleship.
    async Task LaneBWarpChecks(PlayerShip me, TargetDummy d2w)
    {
        var home = me.Position;
        void Ready(float rot) { me.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; me.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = rot; }
        async Task Settle()
        {   // an overshoot's lock and status run out by themselves (6 s at most)
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && me.Disabled; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        Check(me.Class == ShipClass.Battleship && me.Drive == Drives.Warp, $"the battleship's V is the warp ({me.Drive?.Id})");
        // the pure rules, by literal
        Check(Drives.Reach(0.9, 800, 2400) < 0 && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(Drives.Reach(2.0, 800, 2400), 800f) && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(Drives.Reach(4.0, 800, 2400), 2400f)
              && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(Drives.Reach(5.2, 800, 2400), 3300f) && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(Drives.Reach(8.0, 800, 2400), 3300f),
              "the charge: nothing inside the 1.0 s spool, then 800 u/s -- 800 u at 2.0 s, 2400 at 4.0, stopping at 3300 (2400 + 900) at 5.2 s and after");
        var overs = new[] { (-50.0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0), (150.0, 1.0), (300.0, 2.0), (600.0, 4.0), (900.0, 6.0), (1300.0, 6.0) };
        Check(overs.All(o => Math.Abs(Drives.DisabledFor(o.Item1) - o.Item2) < 1e-9),
              "the price: {0, 150, 300, 600, 900} u over the safe limit is {0, 1, 2, 4, 6} s disabled, proportional, 6 s at most");

        // HOLDS, each at a seeded spot and heading, nothing selected
        foreach (var (held, want) in new[] { (0.9, -1f), (2.0, 800f), (4.0, 2400f), (5.2, 3300f), (6.0, 3300f) })
        {
            H.ClearSelection();
            me.Position = VaryNear(home, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle()); await Wait(0.2);
            var bow = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation);
            var (reach, moved, cancelled) = await WarpHold(me, held);
            double cool = me.Sl("warp").Cool, off = me.Statuses.Left(Status.Disabled);
            if (want < 0)
                Check(cancelled && moved.Length() < 1f && cool == 0 && off == 0 && !me.Disabled,
                      $"V held {held:0.0} s and released inside the 1.0 s spool: cancelled -- {moved.Length():0.0} u moved, no cooldown ({cool:0.0} s)");
            else
            {
                double wantOff = want > 2400f ? 6.0 : 0.0;
                Check(Math.Abs(moved.Length() - want) < 20f && Mathf.Abs(bow.AngleTo(moved)) < 0.02f && Math.Abs(cool - 20) < 0.2
                      && Math.Abs(off - wantOff) < 0.15 && (me.DriveLock > 0) == (wantOff > 0) && me.Velocity.Length() < 1f,
                      $"V held {held:0.0} s at {Mathf.RadToDeg(me.Rotation):0} deg: {moved.Length():0} u along the bow (want {want:0} ±20), stopped dead, 20 s to recharge ({cool:0.0}), disabled {off:0.0} s (want {wantOff:0})");
            }
            await Settle();
        }

        // THE OVERSHOOT: {-80, 150, 300, 600, 900} u past the ring -> {0, 1, 2, 4, 6} s, as the host (this
        // ship's own) sets it, and as the drive's own rule reads what it really moved.
        foreach (var (over, secs) in new[] { (-80.0, 0.0), (150.0, 1.0), (300.0, 2.0), (600.0, 4.0), (900.0, 6.0) })
        {
            H.ClearSelection();
            me.Position = VaryNear(home, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle()); await Wait(0.2);
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 1.0 + (2400.0 + over) / 800.0);
            double off = me.Statuses.Left(Status.Disabled), byRule = Drives.DisabledFor(moved.Length() - 2400.0);
            Check(Math.Abs(off - secs) < 0.15 && Math.Abs(off - byRule) < 0.05,
                  $"a jump {moved.Length() - 2400:0} u past the 2400 u ring lands disabled {off:0.00} s (want {secs:0} ±0.15; its own distance prices {byRule:0.00})");
            if (secs >= 4.0)
            {   // DISABLED: no thrust, no rudder, no ability, no warp
                var at = me.Position; float rot = me.Rotation;
                KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.A);
                await Wait(0.5);
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.A);
                me.Sl("broadside").Cool = 0; me.UseAbility("broadside", 0);
                me.Sl("warp").Cool = 0;
                Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                Check(me.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 1f && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, me.Rotation)) < 0.005f
                      && me.FailNote("broadside") == "DISABLED" && me.BroadsideWindupLeft <= 0 && !me.Charging && me.FailNote("warp") == "DISABLED",
                      $"disabled after the overshoot: W+A move it {me.Position.DistanceTo(at):0.00} u, the broadside says {me.FailNote("broadside")}, V says {me.FailNote("warp")}");
            }
            await Settle();
        }

        // THE COOLDOWN: V while it recharges starts nothing, and says why
        H.ClearSelection();
        me.Position = VaryNear(home, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle()); await Wait(0.2);
        await WarpHold(me, 2.5);
        var coolAt = me.Position;
        Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        Check(!me.Charging && me.FailNote("warp") == "COOLING" && me.Sl("warp").Cool > 19 && me.Position.DistanceTo(coolAt) < 0.5f,
              $"V while the warp recharges starts nothing: {me.FailNote("warp")} ({me.Sl("warp").Cool:0.0} s left)");

        // AIMED: a target within 45 degrees of the bow, from a seeded side of it
        float std = d2w.HitRadius + Classes.Art(me.Class).Length * 0.5f + Drives.Standoff;
        {
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position - dir * 1500f; Ready(Aim.Along(dir)); await Wait(0.3);
            H.SelectTarget(d2w); await Wait(0.05);
            var (reach, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 6.0);                          // held to the top: 3300 u of reach
            Check(Math.Abs(me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position) - std) < 20f && moved.Length() < reach - 500f && !me.Disabled,
                  $"held at the top (3300 u) with a target 1500 u off the bow: it lands just short of it ({me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position):0} u, want {std:0}), {moved.Length():0} u, shorter than the charge -- and no penalty ({me.Disabled})");
            await Settle();
        }
        {
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position - dir * 3000f; Ready(Aim.Along(dir)); await Wait(0.3);
            H.SelectTarget(d2w); await Wait(0.05);
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 3.5);                               // 2000 u of reach
            Check(Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 2000f) < 20f && moved.Normalized().Dot(dir) > 0.999f && me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position) > 900f,
                  $"a target 3000 u ahead, 2000 u of charge: 2000 u toward it, not onto it ({moved.Length():0} u, {me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position):0} u still to go)");
        }
        {   // a target behind: outside the cone, so straight ahead instead
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position + dir * 900f; Ready(Aim.Along(dir)); await Wait(0.3);
            H.SelectTarget(d2w); await Wait(0.05);
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 3.0);
            Check(Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 1600f) < 20f && moved.Normalized().Dot(dir) > 0.999f && H.Selected == d2w,
                  $"a target behind (outside 45 degrees): 1600 u straight ahead instead ({moved.Length():0} u)");
        }
        {   // aimed when it JUMPS: charged facing away, swung onto the target mid-charge
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position + dir * 1100f; Ready(Aim.Along(dir)); await Wait(0.3);    // d2w dead astern
            H.SelectTarget(d2w); await Wait(0.05);
            bool swung = false;
            await WarpHold(me, 4.0, () => { if (!swung && me.ChargeHeld >= 1.5) { me.Rotation = Aim.Along(-dir); swung = true; } });
            Check(swung && Math.Abs(me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position) - std) < 20f,
                  $"charged facing away, turned onto the target mid-charge: it jumps to the target ({me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position):0} u off, want {std:0})");
        }
        {   // ...or turned off it: straight on along the new heading
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position - dir * 1400f; Ready(Aim.Along(dir)); await Wait(0.3);
            H.SelectTarget(d2w); await Wait(0.05);
            var side = new Vector2(-dir.Y, dir.X); bool swung = false;
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 3.0, () => { if (!swung && me.ChargeHeld >= 1.5) { me.Rotation = Aim.Along(side); swung = true; } });
            Check(swung && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 1600f) < 20f && moved.Normalized().Dot(side) > 0.999f,
                  $"charged facing the target, turned 90 degrees off it mid-charge: 1600 u along the new heading ({moved.Length():0} u, {moved.Normalized().Dot(side):0.000} along it)");
        }
        H.ClearSelection();

        // WEBBED: a pinned capital charges and jumps, and the jump leaves the webbers' posts, so the
        // web lets go -- timed from the frame it lands
        {
            me.Position = new Vector2(4000, 2500) + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(0f, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle()); await Wait(0.3);
            var webs = new[] { 0f, 2.1f, 4.2f }.Select(a => H.SpawnRaider(me.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a) * 300f)).ToList();
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && !me.Pinned; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool pinned = me.Pinned;
            var at = me.Position;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !(me.Charging && me.ChargeHeld >= 2.5); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && me.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 500f; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double free = 0; bool landed = me.Position.DistanceTo(at) > 500f;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && me.Pinned; i++) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); free += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
            Check(pinned && landed && !me.Pinned && free < 0.3,
                  $"webbed, a battleship charges and jumps anyway, and is free of the web {free:0.00} s after it lands (under 0.3; pinned first {pinned}, jumped {landed})");
            foreach (var w in webs) if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(w)) w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Settle();
        }

        // A BROADSIDE FIRES MID-CHARGE (kits_v31 §3.4, the drive against every class's moves): pressed
        // 1.5 s into a hold, its wind-up runs and its volleys go out while the charge goes on growing,
        // and the release still jumps the whole 3.5 s charge -- 2000 u along the bow. Seeded headings.
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            H.ClearSelection();
            me.Position = VaryNear(home, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle());
            me.Sl("broadside").Cool = 0; me.Sl("broadside").Left = 0; me.Sl("broadside").N = 0; await Wait(0.2);
            var bow = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation);
            bool pressed = false, windRan = false, firedCharging = false; double windAt = -1; float reachAt = -1f;
            var (reach, moved, cancelled) = await WarpHold(me, 3.5, () =>
            {
                if (!pressed && me.ChargeHeld >= 1.5)
                {
                    pressed = true; me.UseAbility("broadside", 0);
                    windAt = me.BroadsideWindupLeft; reachAt = me.ChargeReach;
                }
                else if (pressed && me.Charging)
                {
                    windRan |= me.BroadsideWindupLeft > 0 && me.BroadsideWindupLeft < windAt;
                    firedCharging |= me.BroadsideVolleysLeft == 0 && me.BroadsideCooldownLeft > 0;
                }
            });
            Check(pressed && windAt > 0 && windRan && firedCharging && reachAt < 500f && !cancelled && Math.Abs(reach - 2000f) < 20f
                  && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 2000f) < 20f && Mathf.Abs(bow.AngleTo(moved)) < 0.02f,
                  $"a broadside pressed 1.5 s into a warp charge at {Mathf.RadToDeg(bow.Angle()):0} deg: its wind-up runs ({windAt:0.00} s, ran {windRan}) and it fires while the charge holds ({firedCharging}); the charge grows on from {reachAt:0} u to {reach:0} (want 2000) and jumps {moved.Length():0} u along the bow");
            await Settle();
        }

        // THE HOST'S COOLDOWN ARRIVING MID-HOLD (a guest's predicted cooldown is overwritten by the
        // host's reports until the host's own arrives): the release jumps nothing, and V says COOLING.
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            H.ClearSelection();
            me.Position = VaryNear(home, 200f); Ready(VaryAngle()); await Wait(0.2);
            double arriveAt = Vary(1.3f, 2.6f), coolTo = Vary(5f, 18f); bool set = false;
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, Vary(3f, 4.5f), () => { if (!set && me.ChargeHeld >= arriveAt) { me.Sl("warp").Cool = coolTo; set = true; } });
            double cool = me.Sl("warp").Cool;
            Check(set && moved.Length() < 1f && !me.Charging && me.FailNote("warp") == "COOLING" && !me.Disabled && cool < coolTo && cool > 0,
                  $"the warp's cooldown ({coolTo:0.0} s) arriving {arriveAt:0.0} s into a hold: the release jumps {moved.Length():0.0} u, V says {me.FailNote("warp")}, and the cooldown is the one that arrived ({cool:0.0} s, never a fresh 20)");
            Ready(me.Rotation);
        }

        // CRAFT ALREADY OUT FIGHT ON THROUGH A DISABLE (kits_v31 §3.4; decision 13): a carrier sends
        // its fighters at a dummy and then jumps 600 u past its warp's safe ring. While the warp's
        // DISABLED is on (4 s), the fighters out go on with their passes: shots land, and none of them
        // turns for home. The ring is lowered to 1000 u here (a row override, as the title screen's
        // warp_cooldown) so the 1600 u jump from 850-1000 u short of the dummy lands 600-750 u past it,
        // inside the wing's 1500 u control range on both sides; the price is the overshoot's, whatever
        // the ring. Watched from the frame it lands. Three seeded runs, each with a fresh wing (a class
        // swap rebuilds it; the ship node is the same).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship); await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
            H.ClearSelection();
            var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            me.Position = d2w.Position - dir * Vary(850f, 1000f); Ready(Aim.Along(dir));
            me.Stats.SetBase("warp_safe", 1000);
            await Wait(0.3);
            me.OrderAttack(d2w);
            var wing = Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == me && w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter).ToList();
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && !wing.Any(w => w.ShotsThisPass > 0); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool firing = wing.Any(w => w.ShotsThisPass > 0);
            var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 3.0);                               // 1600 u: 600 over the 1000 u ring
            double off = me.Statuses.Left(Status.Disabled);
            float after = me.Position.DistanceTo(d2w.Position);
            bool Fighting(Wing w) => w.FighterPhase is "Approach" or "Burst" or "Overshoot" or "Turn";
            var outs = wing.Where(Fighting).ToList();
            var seen = wing.ToDictionary(w => w, w => w.ShotsThisPass);
            int shots = 0; bool quit = false; double t = 0;
            while (t < 3.0 && me.Disabled)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); t += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                foreach (var w in wing) { int n = w.ShotsThisPass; shots += n >= seen[w] ? n - seen[w] : n; seen[w] = n; }
                quit |= outs.Any(w => !Fighting(w));
            }
            Check(firing && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 1600f) < 20f && Math.Abs(off - 4) < 0.15 && after < 1450f && outs.Count > 0 && t >= 2.9 && shots >= 2 && !quit,
                  $"a carrier jumping 600 u over its ring with {outs.Count} fighters on a dummy (firing first {firing}): disabled {off:0.00} s (want 4), {after:0} u from the dummy after, and through {t:0.0} s of the disable its fighters fired {shots} shots and none turned for home ({!quit})");
            await Settle();
        }
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        H.ClearSelection();
        me.Position = home; Ready(0f); await Wait(0.2);
    }

    // THE NINE'S BOOST, AND THE DRIVE TABLE ITSELF: every hull names one drive; the row sits after the
    // class's own on the bar and on the wire, on V, never walled; the boost is +50% top speed, thrust
    // and strafe for 3 s, 15 s from the press; refused ANCHORED (a hold of x0) and in stasis; allowed
    // webbed, where the web's share of top is taken after the lift. Literals from the ruling.
    async Task LaneBBoostChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        bool Cap(ShipClass c) => c is ShipClass.Battleship or ShipClass.Carrier or ShipClass.Destroyer;
        Check(Drives.All.Length == 2 && Classes.All.All(c => c.Drive == (Cap(c.Id) ? Drives.Warp : Drives.Boost)),
              "every hull names one drive: the warp on the battleship, carrier and destroyer, the boost on the other nine");
        Check(Classes.All.All(c => Abilities.For(c.Id).Length == c.Abilities.Length + 7 && Abilities.For(c.Id)[c.Abilities.Length] == c.Drive.Row
                                   && !c.Abilities.Contains(c.Drive.Row) && Unlocks.LockedAt(c.Id, 1, c.Drive.Row) == null
                                   && Abilities.KeyFor(c.Id, c.Drive.Id) == global::Godot.Key.V && Abilities.Bind(c.Id, c.Drive.Id, global::Godot.Key.G) != null),
              "the drive's slot: after the class's own rows and before the six open keys, on V and fixed there, walled at no level");
        bool N9(double a, double b) => Math.Abs(a - b) < 1e-9;
        Check(Classes.All.All(c =>
              {
                  var st = new ShipStats(c.Id);
                  return Cap(c.Id) ? N9(st["warp_safe"], 2400) && N9(st["warp_rate"], 800) && N9(st["warp_cooldown"], 20) && st["surge_lift"] == 0
                                   : N9(st["surge_time"], 3) && N9(st["surge_cooldown"], 15) && N9(st["surge_lift"], 1.5) && st["warp_safe"] == 0;
              }),
              "the drives' rows on the sheet: warp 2400 u safe, 800 u/s, 20 s on the capitals; boost 3 s, 15 s, x1.5 on the nine; neither on the other");
        Check(Abilities.ControlsHint(ShipClass.Battleship).Contains("V hold to warp") && !Abilities.ControlsHint(ShipClass.Battleship).Contains("Shift")
              && Abilities.ControlsHint(ShipClass.LightDart).Contains("V boost") && Abilities.ControlsHint(ShipClass.LightDart).Contains("Shift + A/D strafe")
              && Abilities.ControlsHint(ShipClass.LightDart).EndsWith("Esc menu"),
              "the controls line names the hull's drive, and Shift only on a hull that slides");

        // +50% ON A LIGHT, A HEAVY AND A FREIGHTER at seeded headings, flat out first; timed from the
        // first frame the slot runs
        foreach (var (cls, top, boosted, boostedSlide) in new[] { (ShipClass.LightDart, 260f, 390f, 195f), (ShipClass.HeavyWarden, 190f, 285f, 142.5f), (ShipClass.FreightHauler, 120f, 180f, 90f) })
        {
            await SetClass(cls);
            var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; await Wait(0.3);
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && s.SpeedAhead < top - 0.5f; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            float before = s.SpeedAhead;
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double left0 = s.Sl("boost").Left, cool0 = s.Sl("boost").Cool;
            var st = Abilities.Find(cls, "boost").State(s, null);
            await Wait(2.6);
            float fast = s.SpeedAhead;
            await Wait(0.5);                                                            // 3.1 s after the first boosted frame
            float after = s.SpeedAhead; double leftAfter = s.Sl("boost").Left;
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            Check(Math.Abs(before - top) < 1f && Math.Abs(left0 - 3) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(cool0 - 15) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(fast - boosted) < 4f
                  && after <= top + 0.5f && leftAfter == 0 && st.Lit && st.Line.StartsWith("BOOST ") && st.Line.EndsWith(" s"),
                  $"V on a {cls} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(s.Rotation):0} deg: {before:0} -> {fast:0} u/s (want {boosted:0}), back to {after:0} (top {top:0}) at 3.1 s; 3 s up, 15 s from the press ({left0:0.00} / {cool0:0.00}); its slot reads '{st.Line}'");
            // the boosted slide, from rest
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; await Wait(0.2); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool starboard = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f;
            var (across, turned, _) = await Slide(s, starboard ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A, 1.0);
            float signed = starboard ? across : -across;
            Check(Math.Abs(signed - boostedSlide) < 3f && Mathf.RadToDeg(turned) < 0.5f,
                  $"boosted, a {cls}'s Shift + {(starboard ? "D" : "A")} slide reaches {signed:0.0} u/s (want {boostedSlide:0.0} ±3), the nose held ({Mathf.RadToDeg(turned):0.00} deg)");
            s.Sl("boost").Left = 0; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // 15 s FROM THE PRESS: a second V is refused at 14.8 s and taken at 15.2 s (a light)
        {
            await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
            var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; await Wait(0.3);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var cooling = Abilities.Find(s.Class, "boost").State(s, null);
            await Wait(3.5);
            var coolingAfter = Abilities.Find(s.Class, "boost").State(s, null);
            await Wait(14.8 - 3.5);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool early = s.Sl("boost").Left > 0; string why = s.FailNote("boost");
            await Wait(0.4);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(!early && why == "COOLING" && s.Sl("boost").Left > 0 && cooling.Lit && coolingAfter.Busy > 0 && coolingAfter.Line.StartsWith("BOOST ") && !coolingAfter.Lit,
                  $"a second V is refused 14.8 s after the press ({why}) and taken at 15.2 s; the slot reads '{cooling.Line}' running and '{coolingAfter.Line}' cooling");
            s.Sl("boost").Left = 0; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0;

            // WEBBED: the boost is allowed and does not break the web; the web's 20% is taken after the
            // lift, so a boosted pinned hull holds 30% of its sheet top (260 -> 78 u/s), and it cannot slide
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 6.0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            await Wait(1.5);
            float pinnedFast = s.SpeedAhead; bool stillPinned = s.Pinned;
            var (pinnedSlide, _, _) = await Slide(s, global::Godot.Key.D, 0.5);
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            Check(s.Sl("boost").Left > 0 && stillPinned && Math.Abs(pinnedFast - 78f) < 3f && Math.Abs(pinnedSlide) < 1f,
                  $"webbed, V still boosts and the web holds: a pinned echo pushes {pinnedFast:0.0} u/s under forced thrust (30% of 260 = 78), and slides {pinnedSlide:0.00} u/s");
            s.Sl("boost").Left = 0; s.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);

            // IN STASIS: nothing
            s.TakeDamage(s.Hp + 1); await Wait(0.1);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool deadBoost = s.Sl("boost").Left > 0;
            typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(s, 0.0);
            s.UseAbility("reboard", 0); await Wait(0.1);
            s.Restore(s.MaxHp, true, 0);
            Check(!deadBoost && s.Alive, $"in stasis V boosts nothing ({deadBoost}); re-boarded, alive again");
        }

        // ANCHORED: a hull held at x0 (the sniper's railgun charge; the Anchor in 6c) is refused
        {
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
            var sn = Me; sn.AutopilotTo = null;
            sn.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); sn.Rotation = VaryAngle(); sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
            sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").Cool = 0; sn.Sl("boost").Cool = 0;
            sn.UseAbility("railgun", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && sn.Sl("railgun").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(sn.Held == 0f && sn.Sl("boost").Left <= 0 && sn.FailNote("boost") == "ANCHORED",
                  $"held at x0 (the railgun's charge), V is refused {sn.FailNote("boost")} and nothing runs");
            sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0.001;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && sn.Sl("railgun").Left > 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            sn.Sl("railgun").Cool = 0; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        // THE CARDS: a hull meets its own drive's card (far off picked) and, if it slides, the strafe card
        {
            var s = Me;
            Unmeet("boost", "strafe", "warp");
            H.SelectWaypoint("FAR", s.Position + new Vector2(0, 1600), 200f); await Wait(0.1);
            bool boostMet = Met("boost"), strafeEarly = Met("strafe");
            var foe = H.SpawnRaider(s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 350f); await Wait(0.1);
            Check(boostMet && !Met("warp") && !strafeEarly && Met("strafe"),
                  $"a sniper meets the BOOST card with a waypoint 1600 u off (not the warp's), and the STRAFE card with a hostile inside 500 u ({boostMet}, {strafeEarly} -> {Met("strafe")})");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12); H.ClearSelection();
        }
    }

    // ── LANE B · THE DRIVES ACROSS PEERS (rung 5; kits_v31 §3.4, kits_v3 §3.9) ────────────────────
    // The arena pair, before "TWO OF THE NINE": the guest flies its destroyer (a warp hull), then a
    // dart. Host side: a relocation the host makes is never priced; a guest's charged overshoot and a
    // bit-less snap ARE, on the host's own measure; a guest's boost and slide replicate, and the host's
    // speed clamp never cuts a legal boosted slide. Guest side: what the host's word does to it.
    PlayerShip LaneBGuest() => H?.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine);
    async Task LaneBHostDrives()
    {
        var nf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        Drives.PriceSnaps = true;                                           // this window prices bit-less snaps
        await RealTime(() => LaneBGuest() is { Class: ShipClass.Destroyer }, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        var g = LaneBGuest();
        if (g == null) { Check(false, "arena host (lane B): no guest destroyer to watch"); Drives.PriceSnaps = false; return; }
        // A RELOCATION THE HOST MAKES -- a returning pilot put back where it was -- is never a jump
        var reloc = g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 3000f;
        var held = new Session.Held { OldPeer = g.OwnerId, World = (int)typeof(Hub).GetField("_world", nf).GetValue(H), Pos = reloc, Rot = g.Rotation, Hp = g.Hp };
        Priv(H, "RestoreHeld", held, g.OwnerId);
        bool relocDisabled = false;
        var relocWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => { relocDisabled |= LaneBGuest() is { } gg && gg.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled); return false; } };
        AddChild(relocWatch);
        await RealTime(() => g.Position.DistanceTo(reloc) < 40f, Wan ? 6 : 3);
        bool arrived = g.Position.DistanceTo(reloc) < 40f;
        await Wait(1.5);
        relocWatch.QueueFree();
        Check(arrived && !relocDisabled && g.Sl("warp").Cool <= 0,
              $"arena host (lane B): the guest's destroyer put back 3000 u away by the host (a returning pilot's place) is never priced as a jump -- arrived {arrived}, disabled {relocDisabled}, warp cooling {g.Sl("warp").Cool:0.0} s");
        LaneBWorldEntryChecks(g);                                           // snaps priced (this window); one frame, no real report between
        // THE REST OF THE GUEST'S DRIVES, watched every frame until it becomes a freighter
        double firstOff = -1, secondOff = -1; bool was = false, sawBoost = false;
        float fastest = 0, widest = 0, restOff = -1; int clamps0 = -1, clampsDart = 0;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (LaneBGuest() is not { } gg) return false;
            bool on = gg.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled);
            if (on && !was) { double l = gg.Statuses.Left(Status.Disabled); if (firstOff < 0) firstOff = l; else if (secondOff < 0) secondOff = l; }
            was = on;
            if (gg.Class == ShipClass.LightDart)
            {
                if (clamps0 < 0) clamps0 = gg.SpeedClamps;
                clampsDart = gg.SpeedClamps - clamps0;
                var v = (Vector2)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netVel", nf).GetValue(gg);
                var f = Vector2.Up.Rotated(gg.Rotation);
                if (gg.Sl("boost").Left > 0) { sawBoost = true; fastest = Mathf.Max(fastest, v.Dot(f)); widest = Mathf.Max(widest, Mathf.Abs(v.Dot(new Vector2(-f.Y, f.X)))); }
                restOff = gg.Position.DistanceTo((Vector2)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netPos", nf).GetValue(gg));
            }
            return false;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        await RealTime(() => LaneBGuest() is { Class: ShipClass.FreightHauler }, Wan ? 90 : 70);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Drives.PriceSnaps = false;
        Check(Math.Abs(firstOff - 4) < 0.2,
              $"arena host (lane B): the guest's charged jump 600 u past its 2400 u ring is priced HERE, on the host's own measure: disabled {firstOff:0.00} s (want 4)");
        Check(Math.Abs(secondOff - 6) < 0.2,
              $"arena host (lane B): a 3300 u snap with no charge bit at all is priced all the same: disabled {secondOff:0.00} s (want 6: 900 over, the cap)");
        Check(sawBoost && Math.Abs(fastest - 390) < 8 && Math.Abs(widest - 195) < 8 && clampsDart == 0 && restOff >= 0 && restOff < 20,
              $"arena host (lane B): the guest dart's boost and slide arrive -- the host's slot ran ({sawBoost}), its reports read {fastest:0} u/s ahead (390) and {widest:0} u/s across (195), the speed clamp cut none of them ({clampsDart}), and at rest the host holds it {restOff:0.0} u from its own report");
    }

    // ENTERING A WORLD OR RE-BOARDING IS NEVER A JUMP (kits_v31 §3.4, rung 5). Fed straight to the
    // host's copy of the guest's warp hull inside ONE frame, so no real report falls between them, with
    // bit-less snaps priced: (a) a late report from the world it left (Hub.EnterSector counts every peer
    // in no sector until it reports again) -- one bit-less, one with the charge bit, and two far apart
    // -- then, counted in this world again, its first report from the new spawn (the ship's own last
    // real report); (b) a live report, the hull wrecked, the wreck's report, a re-board, and its next
    // report from somewhere else. Neither may DISABLE it or start its warp's cooldown. Seeded spots
    // 1500-4000 u off (never near the 600 u snap line); the hull's real report is restored after each.
    void LaneBWorldEntryChecks(PlayerShip g)
    {
        var nf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        var pos = (Vector2)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netPos", nf).GetValue(g);
        var vel = (Vector2)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netVel", nf).GetValue(g);
        float rot = (float)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netRot", nf).GetValue(g);
        var run = (DriveRun)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_drive", nf).GetValue(g);
        void Report(Vector2 at, bool bit) => g.ApplyState(at.X, at.Y, vel.X, vel.Y, rot, g.AimPoint.X, g.AimPoint.Y, g.Trigger, g.Staggered, at.X, at.Y, rot, bit);
        Vector2 Far() => pos + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1500f, 4000f);
        bool Priced() => g.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled) || g.Sl("warp").Cool > 0;
        var sector = Session.SectorOf(g.OwnerId);
        bool clean = sector == Hub.Sector && Drives.PriceSnaps && g.Alive && !Priced();
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var old = Far();
            Session.Sectors.Remove(g.OwnerId);                              // as EnterSector leaves it
            Report(old, k == 1);                                            // k 1: it was charging when the world changed
            if (k == 2) Report(old + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1500f, 3000f), false);
            if (sector is { } sk) Session.Sectors[g.OwnerId] = sk;          // its NetMySector: counted here again
            Report(pos, false);                                             // its first report from the new spawn
            bool priced = Priced();
            Check(clean && !priced,
                  $"arena host (lane B): a guest's late report from the world it left ({old.DistanceTo(pos):0} u off{(k == 1 ? ", charge bit set" : k == 2 ? ", two of them" : "")}), then its first from the new spawn, is never a jump -- disabled {g.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled)}, warp cooling {g.Sl("warp").Cool:0.0} s (counted in this world first {clean})");
            if (priced) { g.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled); g.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; }
        }
        double hp = g.Hp;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var far = Far();
            Report(pos, false);                                             // alive, where it is
            Priv(g, "Die");                                                 // into stasis where it lies
            Report(pos, false);                                             // the wreck's report
            typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", nf).SetValue(g, 0.0);
            g.Reboard();
            bool back = g.Alive;
            Report(far, false);                                             // its next report, from elsewhere
            bool priced = Priced();
            Check(clean && back && !priced,
                  $"arena host (lane B): a guest's warp hull re-boarded ({back}) and then reported {far.DistanceTo(pos):0} u from its wreck is never a jump -- disabled {g.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled)}, warp cooling {g.Sl("warp").Cool:0.0} s");
            if (priced) { g.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled); g.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; }
            run.From = null; Report(pos, false);                            // back on its real reports
            g.Hp = hp;
        }
    }

    async Task LaneBGuestDrives()
    {
        var nf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        GetViewport().GuiReleaseFocus();                                    // the helm's keys are polled: no text box may hold them
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        H.ClearSelection();
        // the host relocates this ship first (its check); wait it out, then fly from wherever it is
        await Wait(Wan ? 6.0 : 4.0);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        void LockOff() { var run = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_drive", nf).GetValue(me); run.GetType().GetField("Lock").SetValue(run, 0.0); }
        async Task<double> HostDisabledFor(double wait)
        {   // from the first frame the host's bit is here to the first it is gone
            await RealTime(() => me.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled), wait);
            if (!me.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled)) return -1;
            double t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && me.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled); i++) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); t += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
            return t;
        }
        // 600 u OVER, and this ship's own lock thrown away the moment it lands: the host's word alone
        var (_, moved, _) = await WarpHold(me, 1.0 + 3000.0 / 800.0, driver: true);
        LockOff();
        bool freeHere = !me.Disabled;
        double off = await HostDisabledFor(Wan ? 4 : 2);
        Check(freeHere && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - 3000f) < 20f && Math.Abs(off - 4) < 0.4 && me.Sl("warp").Cool > 10,
              $"arena guest (lane B): a jump 600 u past the ring with this ship's own lock bypassed ({freeHere}) is still DISABLED {off:0.00} s by the host (want 4), and the host's cooldown is on its slot ({me.Sl("warp").Cool:0.0} s)");
        // A SNAP WITH NO CHARGE BIT: 3300 u in one report
        await Wait(0.5);
        me.Position += Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation) * 3300f; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        double snapOff = await HostDisabledFor(Wan ? 4 : 2);
        Check(Math.Abs(snapOff - 6) < 0.4, $"arena guest (lane B): 3300 u in one report with no charge bit is priced by the host: DISABLED {snapOff:0.00} s (want 6)");
        await Wait(0.5);
        // A DART: the boost and the slide on the ability path and the owner's flight
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var d = Me; d.AutopilotTo = null; d.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        double dartHull = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightDart)["hull"];
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(d.MaxHp - dartHull) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); await Wait(3.0);
        d.PressDrive();                                                     // V, as the hub hands it over
        for (int i = 0; i < 30 && d.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        await Wait(1.2);
        float fast = d.SpeedAhead;
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D); await Wait(0.8);
        float across = d.SpeedAcross; double left = d.Sl("boost").Left;
        KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
        d.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Check(Math.Abs(fast - 390) < 5 && Math.Abs(across - 195) < 4 && left > 0,
              $"arena guest (lane B): its dart's boost holds under the host's slot: {fast:0} u/s ahead (390) and a {across:0} u/s slide (195), {left:0.0} s still up");
        await Wait(1.5);                                                    // at rest, for the host to read where it is
    }

    // F20's BEHAVIOUR, from 3 varied spots each (the numbers themselves are the ENEMY TABLE check,
    // above -- this proves the game reads them). An unpinned target inside a gunship's 500 u
    // missile reach draws nothing (the pin gate); THEN, separately, a pinned one: both barrels at
    // once, 2.58 DPS, and a missile whose flight is 10 s and lands 35. The two are separate loops,
    // never one run's pinned tail bleeding into the next run's "unpinned" head.
    async Task LaneAHeavyRowsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me; var keep = pm.Position;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            var hvSpot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 480f);
            var hv = H.SpawnRaider(hvSpot, Enemies.Gunship);
            typeof(Raider).GetField("_missileCd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(hv, 0.0);
            int blasts0 = H.BlastsPending;
            bool inReach = true;
            // HELD IN PLACE both sides: hv is re-pinned to its spawn spot and pm to `at` every frame,
            // and the reach itself is asserted each frame -- a stale pick (taken once before the wait)
            // would let an unpinned heavy drive off toward the map's edge and pass only because it fell
            // out of range, not because the pin gate held it.
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3; i++)
            {
                pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                hv.Position = hvSpot;
                inReach &= hv.Position.DistanceTo(pm.Position) <= 500f;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            Check(!pm.Pinned && H.BlastsPending == blasts0 && inReach,
                  $"unpinned, {at.DistanceTo(hv.Position):0} u inside a gunship's 500 u missile reach: it throws nothing");
            hv.TakeDamage(9999);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            // pinned directly (as the door's own checks pin), so only the geometry varies here --
            // the boost-and-close sequence that PRODUCES a pin is its own check (the 6b block). A
            // fresh application per sub-test, each comfortably longer than that sub-test's own
            // worst-case wait, so it never lapses mid-check; cleared at the end of the run so it
            // never outlives this function either.
            pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 8.0);

            // HELD IN PLACE: Pinned forces thrust (the web's ~20% creep), so an un-held pilot would
            // drift off the spot every geometry below is measured from -- exactly the "a stale pick,
            // re-taken after it -- the world moved" trap. pm.Position is reasserted every frame.
            var hvL = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 130f), Enemies.Gunship);
            typeof(Raider).GetField("_missileCd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(hvL, 99.0);   // the laser sub-test's gunship throws nothing: the missile sub-test reads the only blast
            double HvLaser() => pm.DamageBySource.Where(kv => kv.Key == $"raider:{hvL.NetId}").Sum(kv => kv.Value);
            // TIMED FROM THE EFFECT: the clock starts on the first frame a volley has landed (HvLaser()
            // grows), never on the latch -- a volley then lands every 60 frames, so a 150-frame read
            // holds exactly two more, each 30 frames from either end of the window (no knife edge).
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && HvLaser() == 0; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double hl0 = HvLaser();
            for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double hdps = (HvLaser() - hl0) / 2.0;
            Check(hvL.Latched && hl0 > 0 && Math.Abs(hdps - 2.58) < 0.15,
                  $"a gunship on a pinned pilot, {at.DistanceTo(hvL.Position):0} u off: {hdps:0.00} DPS (want 2.58, 2 barrels of 1.29)");
            hvL.TakeDamage(9999);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

            pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 30.0);
            var hvM = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 480f), Enemies.Gunship);
            double HvMissile() => pm.DamageBySource.Where(kv => kv.Key == $"heavy:{hvM.NetId}:missile").Sum(kv => kv.Value);
            typeof(Raider).GetField("_missileCd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(hvM, 0.0);
            double mm0 = HvMissile();
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 13 && H.BlastsPending == 0; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var ring = Nodes<FxNode>().FirstOrDefault(t => t.Id == Fx.WarnZone && Math.Abs(t.Radius - Raider.BlastRadius) < 0.1f);
            Check(H.BlastsPending == 1 && ring != null && Math.Abs(ring.Time - 10) < 1e-6 && ring.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 30f,
                  $"pinned, {at.DistanceTo(hvM.Position):0} u off: its missile's flight is 10 s");
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && H.BlastsPending > 0; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            Check(Math.Abs(HvMissile() - mm0 - 35) < 1e-6, $"...and it lands 35 ({HvMissile() - mm0:0})");
            hvM.TakeDamage(9999);
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
        }
        pm.Position = keep; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── F5 · A SHOT STRIKES EACH BODY ONCE, AND ENDS AFTER ITS STOPS (lane A slice 3, J8) ──────────
    // A shell (10 a blow) down a held line of three gunships, from 3 varied angles and spacings, with
    // Stops 1, 2 and 0: exactly the first 1, 2 or 3 lose exactly 10 each -- once, however many of the
    // sweep's 6 u points fall inside a body -- and the ones past its last stop lose nothing.
    async Task LaneAShotStopsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var from = yonder + dir.Orthogonal() * Vary(1200f, 1600f);       // well off the pilot, whatever the angle
            float gap = Vary(160f, 260f), first = Vary(200f, 320f);
            foreach (int stops in new[] { 1, 2, 0 })
            {
                var spots = new Vector2[3];
                var foes = new Raider[3];
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                {
                    spots[k] = from + dir * (first + gap * k) + dir.Orthogonal() * Vary(-4f, 4f);
                    foes[k] = H.SpawnRaider(spots[k], Enemies.Gunship); foes[k].Hp = 1e9;
                }
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
                var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
                float range = first + gap * 2 + 300f;
                var shot = Combat.Fire(Shots.Shell, from, dir, 1500f, range, 10, radius: 2f, hitSource: "test:stops");
                shot.Stops = stops;
                for (int i = 0; i < 120 && IsInstanceValid(shot) && shot.Alive; i++)
                {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
                var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, 3).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
                int want = stops == 0 ? 3 : stops;
                bool ok = Enumerable.Range(0, 3).All(k => Math.Abs(lost[k] - (k < want ? 10 : 0)) < 1e-6);
                Check(ok, $"a shell with Stops {stops} ({(stops == 0 ? "through everything" : stops == 1 ? "the first body" : "two bodies")}) down a line of three gunships {first:0} u + {gap:0} u apart, at {Mathf.RadToDeg(dir.Angle()):0} deg: the first {want} lose 10 each, once ({string.Join(" / ", lost.Select(l => l.ToString("0.##")))})");
                foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── F23 · LINES: what a line strikes, and the railgun's row (lane A slice 3, J9) ─────────────
    // Pure (Lines.Pick): 3 varied layouts -- an angle, a start, three bodies on the line at varied
    // spots handed over in a shuffled order, one body just off its side and one past its end -- with
    // Stops 0 / 1 / 2: everything on it, the nearest, the nearest two, always nearest first. Then the
    // railgun's row against the kit's literals: 2500 x 14 u, through everything, the rail bar and report.
    void LaneALinesChecks()
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var a = new Vector2(Vary(-3000f, 3000f), Vary(-3000f, 3000f));
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var side = dir.Orthogonal();
            float length = Vary(1500f, 2500f), half = Vary(5f, 12f);
            var b = a + dir * length;
            var pool = new List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)>();
            float[] along = { Vary(100f, 400f), Vary(600f, 900f), Vary(1100f, 1400f) };
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                float r = Vary(10f, 30f);
                pool.Add(($"on{k}", a + dir * along[k] + side * Vary(-1f, 1f) * (half + r - 2f), r));
            }
            float rOff = Vary(10f, 30f);
            pool.Add(("beside", a + dir * Vary(200f, 1300f) + side * (half + rOff + Vary(8f, 40f)) * (run % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1), rOff));
            pool.Add(("beyond", a + dir * (length + rOff + Vary(20f, 200f)), rOff));
            var shuffled = pool.OrderBy(_ => Rng.Randi()).ToList();
            string Names(List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)> l) => string.Join(",", l.Select(t => t.name));
            var all = Lines.Pick(a, b, half, 0, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var one = Lines.Pick(a, b, half, 1, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var two = Lines.Pick(a, b, half, 2, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            Check(Names(all) == "on0,on1,on2" && Names(one) == "on0" && Names(two) == "on0,on1",
                  $"a line {length:0} x {half * 2:0} u at {Mathf.RadToDeg(dir.Angle()):0} deg, handed its bodies as {Names(shuffled)}: Stops 0 strikes on0,on1,on2, Stops 1 on0, Stops 2 on0,on1, nearest first, never the one beside it or past its end ({Names(all)} / {Names(one)} / {Names(two)})");
        }
        var rail = Lines.All[Lines.Rail];
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        Check(rail.Id == "rail" && rail.Stops == 0 && !rail.AtTarget && rail.Fx == Fx.Rail && rail.Beam == Beam.Rail
              && Math.Abs(sheet[rail.Reach] - 2500) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet[rail.Width] - 14) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["rail_damage"] - 150) < 1e-9,
              $"the railgun is a Lines row: 2500 x 14 u (reach {sheet[rail.Reach]:0}, width {sheet[rail.Width]:0}), through everything (Stops {rail.Stops}), its whole reach (AtTarget {rail.AtTarget}), the rail bar and report, 150 a line");
    }

    // ── F23 · A LINE THAT STOPS AT ITS TARGET (lane A slice 3, gate fix J12) ────────────────────
    // Pure (Lines.End, the segment Strike reads, then Lines.Pick): kits_v31 3.1's `tot` shape -- 14 u x
    // 1500 u, stops at the target -- beside the railgun's row, at 3 varied angles and starts. Aimed at a
    // point 600-1200 u out: a body short of it is struck by both; a body just past it is untouched on the
    // AtTarget row and struck on the rail row (which runs its whole 2500). Aimed 2000-2300 u out: the
    // AtTarget row ends at its 1500 u reach, so a body just past 1500 is untouched on it, struck on the rail.
    void LaneALinesAtTargetChecks()
    {
        var tot = new LineDef { Id = "tot", Stops = 0, AtTarget = true };
        var rail = Lines.All[Lines.Rail];
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        const float totReach = 1500f, totHalf = 7f;
        float railReach = (float)sheet[rail.Reach], railHalf = (float)sheet[rail.Width] * 0.5f;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var from = new Vector2(Vary(-3000f, 3000f), Vary(-3000f, 3000f));
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float near = Vary(600f, 1200f), far = Vary(2000f, 2300f), r = Vary(10f, 30f);
            var to = from + dir * near;
            var toFar = from + dir * far;
            var pool = new List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)>
            {
                ("pastReach", from + dir * (totReach + r + Vary(20f, 200f)), r),
                ("short", from + dir * (near - Vary(150f, 400f)), r),
                ("past", from + dir * (near + r + Vary(20f, 200f)), r),
            };
            string Names(Vector2 end, float half) => string.Join(",", Lines.Pick(from, end, half, 0, pool, t => t.at, t => t.r).Select(t => t.name));
            Vector2 totEnd = Lines.End(tot, totReach, from, to), totEndFar = Lines.End(tot, totReach, from, toFar);
            Vector2 railEnd = Lines.End(rail, railReach, from, to), railEndFar = Lines.End(rail, railReach, from, toFar);
            string tn = Names(totEnd, totHalf), tf = Names(totEndFar, totHalf), rn = Names(railEnd, railHalf), rf = Names(railEndFar, railHalf);
            Check(totEnd.DistanceTo(to) < 1e-2f && Math.Abs(from.DistanceTo(totEndFar) - 1500f) < 1e-2f
                  && Math.Abs(from.DistanceTo(railEnd) - 2500f) < 1e-2f && railEndFar.DistanceTo(from + dir * 2500f) < 1e-2f
                  && tn == "short" && tf == "short,past" && rn == "short,past,pastReach" && rf == "short,past,pastReach",
                  $"a 14 u x 1500 u line that stops at its target, at {Mathf.RadToDeg(dir.Angle()):0} deg aimed {near:0} u out: strikes {tn}, never the body just past the target; aimed {far:0} u out it ends at {from.DistanceTo(totEndFar):0} u, striking {tf}; the railgun's row runs {from.DistanceTo(railEnd):0} u either way and strikes {rn} / {rf}");
        }
    }

    // ── F6 · A PREDICTED MISSILE HAS AN ID ON EVERY PEER (lane A slice 3, J10) ───────────────────
    // Three harmless outpost missiles (0 damage, 10 u) thrown at 3 varied spots far from anything: each
    // blast the host holds and each MissileVisual it shows carry the same id, from the missiles' one
    // space (NetIds.Missile, 10000-19999), three different ids, none a live shot's; then all three land.
    static IEnumerable<int> BlastIds(Hub h) =>
        ((System.Collections.IList)typeof(Hub).GetField("_blasts", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(h))
            .Cast<object>().Select(e => (int)e.GetType().GetField("Item5").GetValue(e));
    static bool InMissileSpace(int id) => id >= NetIds.Missile && id < NetIds.Missile + 10000;
    async Task LaneAMissileIdsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var before = Nodes<MissileVisual>().ToHashSet();
        var ids0 = BlastIds(H).ToHashSet();
        int pending0 = H.BlastsPending;
        var spots = new Vector2[3];
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            spots[k] = yonder + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(2500f, 3500f);
            H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = Missiles.Outpost, Damage = 0, Blast = 10f, Flight = Vary(1.5f, 2.5f) },
                           spots[k] + new Vector2(0, -600), spots[k], 0);
        }
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var mine = Nodes<MissileVisual>().Where(v => !before.Contains(v)).ToList();
        var held = BlastIds(H).Where(i => !ids0.Contains(i)).ToHashSet();
        var shotIds = Nodes<Shot>().Select(s => s.NetId).Where(i => i != 0).ToHashSet();
        bool eachAtItsSpot = spots.All(p => mine.Count(v => v.To.DistanceTo(p) < 1f) == 1);
        var seen = mine.Select(v => v.NetId).ToHashSet();
        Check(mine.Count == 3 && eachAtItsSpot && seen.Count == 3 && seen.SetEquals(held) && seen.All(InMissileSpace) && !seen.Overlaps(shotIds),
              $"three predicted missiles thrown at once: the host's blasts and the missiles it draws carry the same three ids, from the missiles' one space ({string.Join(", ", seen)} / held {string.Join(", ", held)})");
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && H.BlastsPending > pending0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        Check(H.BlastsPending == pending0 && !BlastIds(H).Any(held.Contains),
              $"...and all three land, their ids gone with them ({H.BlastsPending - pending0} still pending)");
    }
    // Rung 5, the host's half: three at far spots, once both guests are in; they fly 40 s.
    void LaneAMissileIdsHost()
    {
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var at = new Vector2(-7000, 7000) + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 900f);
            H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = Missiles.Outpost, Damage = 0, Blast = 10f, Flight = 40 }, at + new Vector2(0, -600), at, 0);
        }
        var drawn = Nodes<MissileVisual>().Where(v => v.Flight > 30).Select(v => v.NetId).ToHashSet();
        Check(drawn.Count == 3 && drawn.All(InMissileSpace), $"host: three predicted missiles thrown for the guests, each with its own id ({string.Join(", ", drawn)})");
    }
    // Rung 5, the guest's half: the three arrive with the host's ids -- three, different, in the missiles' space.
    async Task LaneAMissileIdsGuest()
    {
        await RealTime(() => Nodes<MissileVisual>().Count(v => v.Flight > 20) >= 3, 25);
        var got = Nodes<MissileVisual>().Where(v => v.Flight > 20).Select(v => v.NetId).ToList();
        Check(got.Count == 3 && got.Distinct().Count() == 3 && got.All(InMissileSpace),
              $"guest: the host's three predicted missiles arrive each with its id, the host's, three different ones in the missiles' space ({string.Join(", ", got)})");
    }

    // ── F7 · CHARGE BANDS (lane A slice 3, J11) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Pure (Charges.At), each at 3 varied charges, never on a band's edge:
    //  - a ramp (sniper_active_reload.md 1.4: 40% at once rising to 100% at full): 0.40 + 0.60 x share,
    //    and 1.00 held past full;
    //  - steps (kits_v2's tap 8 and full 45): 8/45 down the tap's line short of full, 1 down the full line after;
    //  - the railgun's own table: the whole (x1) down the rail line, however far its charge got (the kit's 150).
    void LaneAChargeBandChecks()
    {
        var ramp = new[] { new ChargeBand { At = 0, Mult = 0.40, Line = 1 }, new ChargeBand { At = 1, Mult = 1.00, Line = 1, Ramp = true } };
        var steps = new[] { new ChargeBand { At = 0, Mult = 8.0 / 45, Line = 2 }, new ChargeBand { At = 1, Mult = 1, Line = 3 } };
        float[] shares = { Vary(0.05f, 0.30f), Vary(0.35f, 0.65f), Vary(0.70f, 0.95f) };
        foreach (float sh in shares)
        {
            var (rm, rl) = Charges.At(ramp, sh);
            var (sm, sl) = Charges.At(steps, sh);
            Check(Math.Abs(rm - (0.40 + 0.60 * sh)) < 1e-9 && rl == 1 && Math.Abs(sm * 45 - 8) < 1e-9 && sl == 2,
                  $"a charge {sh * 100:0}% of full: a ramp's 40% -> 100% gives {rm * 100:0.0}% (want {(0.40 + 0.60 * sh) * 100:0.0}), steps give the tap's 8 of 45 down the tap's line ({sm * 45:0.00}, line {sl})");
        }
        foreach (float sh in new[] { Vary(1.05f, 1.4f), Vary(1.5f, 2.5f), Vary(3f, 6f) })
        {
            var (rm, rl) = Charges.At(ramp, sh);
            var (sm, sl) = Charges.At(steps, sh);
            var (km, kl) = Charges.At(Charges.Of("railgun"), sh);
            var (k0, kl0) = Charges.At(Charges.Of("railgun"), Vary(0.05f, 0.95f));
            Check(Math.Abs(rm - 1) < 1e-9 && rl == 1 && Math.Abs(sm * 45 - 45) < 1e-9 && sl == 3
                  && km == 1 && kl == Lines.Rail && k0 == 1 && kl0 == Lines.Rail
                  && Math.Abs(new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper)["rail_damage"] * km - 150) < 1e-9,
                  $"a charge held to {sh * 100:0}% of full: the ramp holds at 100% ({rm * 100:0.0}), steps give the full 45 down the full line ({sm * 45:0.00}, line {sl}), the railgun its whole 150 down the rail line ({km:0.##} x, line {kl})");
        }
    }

    // ── THE BANDS AND THE LINES ARE IN THE BUILD'S FINGERPRINT (lane A slice 3, gate fix J12) ───────
    // The bug: Charges.All was a dictionary, which Net.Fingerprint does not hash, so two builds whose
    // railgun bands differed admitted each other. Now the fingerprint's parts write Charges.All and
    // Lines.All out row by row, and at 3 varied railgun multipliers the fingerprint moves (the band is
    // put back after each, and the build's own fingerprint returns).
    void LaneAChargeTableHashedChecks()
    {
        var parts = FingerprintParts();
        string charges = parts.FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Charges.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "";
        string lines = parts.FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Lines.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "";
        Check(charges.Contains("Id=railgun") && charges.Contains("ChargeBand{") && lines.Contains("AtTarget=False") && lines.Contains("Reach=rail_range"),
              $"the build's fingerprint reads the charge bands and the lines row by row ({(charges == "" ? "no Charges.All part" : charges)} / {(lines == "" ? "no Lines.All part" : lines)})");
        var band = Charges.Of("railgun")[0];
        int build = FingerprintNow();
        foreach (double m in new double[] { Vary(0.2f, 0.6f), Vary(1.2f, 2f), Vary(3f, 9f) })
        {
            double keep = band.Mult;
            int moved;
            band.Mult = m;
            try { moved = FingerprintNow(); }
            finally { band.Mult = keep; }
            int back = FingerprintNow();
            Check(moved != build && back == build,
                  $"a build whose railgun band fires x{m:0.00} has another fingerprint ({moved:x8} against the build's {build:x8}), and with the band put back the build's again ({back:x8})");
        }
    }

    // ── F11 · THE PRISM (lane A slice 5, kits5-J2) ────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Pure (Prism.Resolve): theta is the asserted input (kits_v2 Warrior card): {0, 14, 16, 45, 59, 61, 120, 180}
    // gives SQUARE, SQUARE, SLANT, SLANT, SLANT, OPEN, OPEN, OPEN, from 3 varied guards, the light coming in
    // on either side of the guard.
    void LaneAPrismBandChecks()
    {
        float[] thetas = { 0f, 14f, 16f, 45f, 59f, 61f, 120f, 180f };
        int[] want = { 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, -1, -1, -1 };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float gAng = VaryAngle(); var g = Vector2.Right.Rotated(gAng);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var got = thetas.Select(t => Prism.Resolve(g, -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(t))).Band).ToArray();
            Check(got.SequenceEqual(want) && Prism.Bands[0].Id == "square" && Prism.Bands[1].Id == "slant",
                  $"a guard at {Mathf.RadToDeg(gAng):0} deg, the light {(sign > 0 ? "left" : "right")} of it at theta 0/14/16/45/59/61/120/180: SQUARE, SQUARE, SLANT, SLANT, SLANT, OPEN, OPEN, OPEN ({string.Join(",", got)})");
        }
    }

    // Pure (Prism.Resolve): SQUARE sends 75% back along g and lets 25% straight on; SLANT at 40 deg
    // mirrors 50% at 80 deg off the line back to the source and bends 50% by 20 deg, to the other side of
    // the light from the mirror (the card's "SLANT at 40 deg mirrors 25 at 80 deg and bends 25 by 20 deg"),
    // from 3 varied guards and both sides.
    void LaneAPrismResolveChecks()
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var g = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var uSq = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(1f, 13f)));
            var sq = Prism.Resolve(g, uSq);
            Check(sq.Band == 0 && sq.Out.DistanceTo(g) < 1e-4f && sq.Through.DistanceTo(uSq) < 1e-4f
                  && Math.Abs(sq.OutShare - 0.75) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sq.ThroughShare - 0.25) < 1e-9,
                  $"SQUARE at theta {sq.Theta:0.0}: 0.75 back along the guard, 0.25 straight on ({sq.OutShare} / {sq.ThroughShare})");
            var u = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(40f));
            var sl = Prism.Resolve(g, u);
            float mirrorOff = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(sl.Out.AngleTo(-u))), bend = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(u.AngleTo(sl.Through)));
            bool otherSide = Mathf.Sign(u.Cross(sl.Out)) != Mathf.Sign(u.Cross(sl.Through));
            Check(sl.Band == 1 && Mathf.Abs(mirrorOff - 80f) < 0.01f && Mathf.Abs(bend - 20f) < 0.01f && otherSide
                  && Math.Abs(sl.OutShare - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sl.ThroughShare - 0.5) < 1e-9,
                  $"SLANT at 40 deg ({(sign > 0 ? "left" : "right")}): half mirrored at 80 deg ({mirrorOff:0.00}), half bent 20 deg ({bend:0.00}) to the other side of the light ({otherSide})");
        }
    }

    // World (Prism.Catch, host): the pilot Parrying, its guard on its nose, a 50 beam tick from a source
    // 400-1500 u off. SQUARE (theta 1-12 deg): a gunship on the guard 300-900 u out loses 37.5, credited
    // "prism". SLANT at 40 deg: a gunship on the mirror loses 25. OPEN (theta 65-170) and a ring: not caught.
    // A RAY reaches 900 u, a beam 1500: a gunship 1000-1400 u out on the guard is untouched by a caught ray.
    // The pilot's hull never moves. 3 varied spots and headings, the light from either side.
    async Task LaneAPrismSplitChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot;
            pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp; pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 5.0);
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var uSq = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(1f, 12f)));
            var uSl = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(40f));
            var mirror = (uSl - 2f * uSl.Dot(g) * g).Normalized();
            var spots = new[] { at + g * Vary(300f, 900f), at + mirror * Vary(300f, 1400f), at + g * Vary(1000f, 1400f) };
            var foes = spots.Select(s => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(s, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            void Place() { for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; pm.Position = at; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f; }
            double hull0 = pm.Hp;

            Place(); var hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var dv) ? dv : 0;
            bool sq = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSq * Vary(400f, 1500f), at + uSq * Vary(300f, 800f), 50, $"test:beam#{run}a");
            double credited = (pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var dv2) ? dv2 : 0) - dealt0;
            double sqLost = hp[0] - foes[0].Hp;
            Check(sq && Math.Abs(sqLost - 37.5) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credited - 37.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a Parrying pilot at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg catches a 50 beam tick SQUARE: the gunship on its guard loses 37.5 ({sqLost:0.##}), credited as \"prism\" ({credited:0.##})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            bool sl = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSl * Vary(400f, 1500f), at + uSl * Vary(300f, 800f), 50, $"test:beam#{run}b");
            double slLost = hp[1] - foes[1].Hp;
            Check(sl && Math.Abs(slLost - 25) < 1e-6,
                  $"...and a SLANT tick at 40 deg: the gunship on the mirror, {spots[1].DistanceTo(at):0} u out, loses 25 ({slLost:0.##})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            var uOpen = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(65f, 170f)));
            bool open = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uOpen * 800f, at + uOpen * 500f, 50, $"test:beam#{run}c");
            bool ring = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Area, at - uSq * 800f, at + uSq * 500f, 50, $"test:ring#{run}");
            Check(!open && !ring && Enumerable.Range(0, 3).All(k => hp[k] == foes[k].Hp),
                  $"...an OPEN tick (theta past 60) and a ring are not caught, and nothing is split ({open} / {ring})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            bool ray = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Ray, at - uSq * 600f, at, 10, $"test:ray#{run}");
            double rayNear = hp[0] - foes[0].Hp, rayFar = hp[2] - foes[2].Hp;
            Check(ray && Math.Abs(rayNear - 7.5) < 1e-6 && rayFar == 0,
                  $"...a caught ray (10) reaches 900 u: the gunship on the guard {spots[0].DistanceTo(at):0} u out takes 7.5 ({rayNear:0.##}), the one {spots[2].DistanceTo(at):0} u out nothing ({rayFar:0.##})");
            Check(pm.Hp == hull0, $"...and the catcher's own hull never moves ({hull0:0.#} -> {pm.Hp:0.#})");

            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying);
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // World (Prism.Walk, what Boss.Burn judges a beam with): a 50 tick down a 60 u segment through the
    // pilot, from 3 varied bearings. Not Parrying, the pilot loses 50. Parrying with its guard on the
    // source, it loses nothing and the gunship on its guard loses 37.5: the walk stopped at the catcher.
    async Task LaneAPrismWalkChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var u = -g.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-10f, 10f)));
            var a = at - u * Vary(500f, 1200f); var b = at + u * Vary(300f, 900f);
            var spot = at + g * Vary(300f, 900f);
            var foe = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); foe.Hp = 1e9;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            foe.Position = spot; pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f;
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            double h0 = pm.Hp;
            Prism.Walk(a, b, 30f, 50, a, $"test:walk#{run}a", new[] { pm });
            double bare = h0 - pm.Hp;
            pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp; pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 5.0);
            double f0 = foe.Hp; h0 = pm.Hp;
            Prism.Walk(a, b, 30f, 50, a, $"test:walk#{run}b", new[] { pm });
            Check(Math.Abs(bare - 50) < 1e-6 && pm.Hp == h0 && Math.Abs(f0 - foe.Hp - 37.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a 50 beam tick walked through the pilot from {Mathf.RadToDeg(u.Angle()):0} deg: bare it lands 50 ({bare:0.##}); Parrying it lands 0 and the gunship on the guard loses 37.5 ({f0 - foe.Hp:0.##})");
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── F12 · THE MELEE ARC AND THE GUARD CLAMP (lane A slice 5, kits5-J1) ─────────────────────
    // Pure (Melee.Pick, Melee.Guard): the blade's literals (160 u, ±55°, kits_v2 Warrior card) and the
    // whirlwind's (210 u, all round) from 3 varied spots and facings. A body well inside the wedge and one
    // whose rim just reaches in are struck; one 2-25° outside the wedge, one past the reach and one
    // behind are not; Stops 1 takes the nearest. The guard follows the cursor to ±90° off the nose and no
    // further (the prism's clamp), from 3 varied noses; nothing is exactly on 55° or 90°.
    void LaneAMeleeArcChecks()
    {
        const float reach = 160f, half = 55f;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var from = new Vector2(Vary(-3000f, 3000f), Vary(-3000f, 3000f));
            float facing = VaryAngle();
            Vector2 At(float bearingDeg, float dist) => from + Vector2.Right.Rotated(facing + Mathf.DegToRad(bearingDeg)) * dist;
            var pool = new List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)>();
            float r0 = Vary(8f, 20f), r1 = Vary(8f, 20f), r2 = Vary(8f, 20f), r3 = Vary(8f, 20f), r4 = Vary(8f, 20f);
            pool.Add(("inside", At(Vary(-45f, 45f), Vary(40f, 90f)), r0));
            pool.Add(("rim", At(Vary(-40f, 40f), reach + r1 - Vary(2f, 10f)), r1));
            pool.Add(("wide", At((run % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * Vary(57f, 80f), Vary(60f, 140f)), r2));
            pool.Add(("far", At(Vary(-30f, 30f), reach + r3 + Vary(10f, 60f)), r3));
            pool.Add(("behind", At(180f + Vary(-60f, 60f), Vary(40f, 140f)), r4));
            var shuffled = pool.OrderBy(_ => Rng.Randi()).ToList();
            string Names(List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)> l) => string.Join(",", l.Select(t => t.name).OrderBy(n => n));
            var blade = Melee.Pick(from, facing, reach, Mathf.DegToRad(half), 0, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var first = Melee.Pick(from, facing, reach, Mathf.DegToRad(half), 1, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var whirl = Melee.Pick(from, facing, 210f, Mathf.Pi, 0, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            Check(Names(blade) == "inside,rim" && first.Count == 1 && first[0].name == "inside"
                  && new[] { "inside", "rim", "wide", "behind" }.All(n => whirl.Any(t => t.name == n)),
                  $"a 160 u x +-55 deg arc facing {Mathf.RadToDeg(facing):0} deg strikes the body inside and the one whose rim reaches in, never one outside the wedge, past the reach or behind ({Names(blade)}); Stops 1 takes the nearest ({string.Join(",", first.Select(t => t.name))}); a 210 u whirl all round takes the one behind and the wide one ({Names(whirl)})");

            float nose = VaryAngle();
            float wideR = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(95f, 175f)), wideL = -Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(95f, 175f)), inR = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(5f, 85f));
            float gR = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + wideR, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            float gL = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + wideL, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            float gI = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + inR, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            Check(Mathf.Abs(gR - Mathf.Pi / 2f) < 1e-4f && Mathf.Abs(gL + Mathf.Pi / 2f) < 1e-4f && Mathf.Abs(gI - inR) < 1e-4f,
                  $"the guard clamp, nose {Mathf.RadToDeg(nose):0} deg: a cursor {Mathf.RadToDeg(wideR):0} deg right clamps to 90 ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gR):0.0}), {Mathf.RadToDeg(-wideL):0} deg left to -90 ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gL):0.0}), {Mathf.RadToDeg(inR):0} deg is followed ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gI):0.0})");
        }
    }

    // World (Melee.Strike, host): the pilot swings a test row (reach its own main_range, +-55 deg, the
    // blade's 26 a blow) from 3 varied spots and headings, with a gunship in front inside its reach, one
    // behind and one just past the reach. Only the one in front loses 26, once, and the pilot's
    // DealtBy["melee_test"] grows by 26: the door credits the row's id.
    async Task LaneAMeleeStrikeChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        var row = new MeleeDef { Id = "melee_test", Reach = "main_range", Arc = 55f, Stops = 0 };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot;
            float reach = (float)pm.Stats[row.Reach];
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var spots = new[] { at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * reach * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f),
                                at - nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-50f, 50f))) * reach * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f),
                                at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-30f, 30f))) * (reach + Vary(150f, 300f)) };
            var foes = spots.Select(s => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(s, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
            pm.Position = at; pm.Rotation = rot;
            var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(row.Id, out var dv) ? dv : 0;
            var hit = Melee.Strike(row, pm, 26);
            var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, 3).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt = (pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(row.Id, out var dv2) ? dv2 : 0) - dealt0;
            Check(Math.Abs(lost[0] - 26) < 1e-6 && lost[1] == 0 && lost[2] == 0 && hit.Count == 1 && Math.Abs(dealt - 26) < 1e-6,
                  $"a {reach:0} u +-55 deg arc swung at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: the gunship in front loses 26, the one behind and the one past the reach nothing ({string.Join(" / ", lost.Select(l => l.ToString("0.##")))}), and DealtBy[\"melee_test\"] grows 26 ({dealt:0.##})");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── THE BUILD A PLAYER READS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // One check, about a trap in THIS game's protocol hash that a build string can fall into.
    void BuildChecks()
    {
        // THE PILOT IS NOT THE BUILD: nothing a run changes about the pilot enters the fingerprint. The
        // bought upgrades were a readonly int[] -- Plain to the fingerprint -- so every purchase moved it,
        // and a peer whose Net was first touched after a pilot loaded would have hashed that pilot's
        // purchases. Character itself DOES contribute a few parts -- a save path, a kept-kills cap, the
        // bounds a stat off disk is clamped to -- every one `const`, the same for every peer on this
        // build whichever pilot is loaded; named here rather than asserted away. What must never show
        // up is anything a PLAYER decided -- Bought chief among them -- asserted by construction (no
        // such part) and by effect (purchases made, the fingerprint is still the build's).
        var buildConst = new[] { "Character.Dir=", "Character.MaxBonus=", "Character.MaxStock=",
                                  "Character.PaidKept=", "Character.SaveDelay=" };
        var pilotParts = FingerprintParts().Where(p => p.StartsWith("Character.", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                                                      && !buildConst.Any(c => p.StartsWith(c, StringComparison.Ordinal))).ToList();
        var boughtWas = Character.Bought.ToArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < Character.Bought.Length; i++) Character.Bought[i] = Rng.RandiRange(0, Progression.MaxPerUpgrade);
        int bought = FingerprintNow();
        boughtWas.CopyTo(Character.Bought, 0);
        Check(pilotParts.Count == 0 && bought == Net.Protocol && typeof(Character).GetField(nameof(Character.Bought), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null,
