              $"nothing about the pilot is part of the build's fingerprint: its bought upgrades are a property over a mutable field, and buying moves nothing ({bought:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {(pilotParts.Count == 0 ? "no Character part" : string.Join(" | ", pilotParts))}{Moved(bought)})");
        // THE FINGERPRINT NEVER HASHES ITSELF, and it is whole when it is taken: Net.Protocol is a property
        // set by Net's static constructor, after every Net static is set. As a readonly field initializer
        // it hashed itself as 0 and every Net static below it as unset, so it differed from every
        // fingerprint taken later in the same process (R1's first runs: 3724c77b against 7991f5f3).
        var selfParts = FingerprintParts().Where(p => p.StartsWith("Net.Protocol", StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
        int now = FingerprintNow();
        Check(typeof(Net).GetField(nameof(Net.Protocol), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null && selfParts.Count == 0 && _hashAtStart == Net.Protocol && now == Net.Protocol,
              $"the build's fingerprint never hashes itself and is whole when it is taken: at the harness's start and now it is the build's ({_hashAtStart:x8} at the start, {now:x8} now, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}{(selfParts.Count == 0 ? "" : "; " + string.Join(" | ", selfParts))})");
        // A STRUCT ROW IS HASHED: any game value type or System.ValueTuple`N whose public fields are
        // Plain or delegates, readonly or not (a site's post) is written out field by field -- an array
        // of them was not hashed at all -- so one field of one row, moved, moves the fingerprint, and
        // put back it is the build's again
        var posts = Emplacements.PirateBase;
        int at = Rng.RandiRange(0, posts.Length - 1);
        var post = posts[at];
        posts[at] = new Post(post.Row, post.At + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f));
        int shifted = FingerprintNow();
        posts[at] = post;
        string postPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Emplacements.PirateBase=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(shifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && postPart.Contains("Post{At=", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a struct row is part of the build's fingerprint: one pirate-base post moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (post {at}: {shifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {postPart[..Math.Min(90, postPart.Length)]})");
        // A MUTABLE STRUCT ROW IS HASHED TOO: StatusGuard and TurretSpec carry no IsReadOnlyAttribute
        // (a mount's gun has settable fields) -- StructRow used to demand it, so a StatusGuard[] and
        // an EmplacementDef's TurretSpec? printed as their bare type name no matter their numbers, and
        // two builds that differed only there still shook hands.
        int gi = Rng.RandiRange(0, StatusSet.Guards.Length - 1);
        var guardWas = StatusSet.Guards[gi];
        StatusSet.Guards[gi] = new StatusGuard { Status = guardWas.Status, Share =guardWas.Share + Vary(0.05f, 0.4f) };
        int guardShifted = FingerprintNow();
        StatusSet.Guards[gi] = guardWas;
        string guardPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("StatusSet.Guards=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(guardShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && guardPart.Contains("Share=", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a mutable struct row is part of the build's fingerprint: one status guard's share moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (guard {gi}: {guardShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {guardPart[..Math.Min(90, guardPart.Length)]})");
        var baseDef = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base));
        var gunWas = baseDef.Gun.GetValueOrDefault();
        var gun = gunWas; gun.Damage = gunWas.Damage + Vary(1f, 50f);
        baseDef.Gun = gun;
        int gunShifted = FingerprintNow();
        baseDef.Gun = gunWas;
        string gunPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Emplacements.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(gunShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && gunPart.Contains("Damage=", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !gunPart.Contains("Gun=TurretSpec}", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"the pirate base's mutable gun is part of the build's fingerprint: its damage moved moves it, put back it is the build's again ({gunShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8})");
        // A VALUE-TUPLE ROW IS HASHED TOO: Hub.PracticeTargets and Hub.Outposts are
        // System.ValueTuple`N tables, a different assembly than the game's own -- StructRow only ever
        // looked at the game's assembly, so an array of them was skipped whole, not merely printed
        // wrong. One practice target moved, moves the fingerprint; put back it is the build's again.
        int pi = Rng.RandiRange(0, Hub.PracticeTargets.Length - 1);
        var targetWas = Hub.PracticeTargets[pi];
        Hub.PracticeTargets[pi] = (targetWas.number, targetWas.at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f), targetWas.armed, targetWas.fighter);
        int targetShifted = FingerprintNow();
        Hub.PracticeTargets[pi] = targetWas;
        string targetPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Hub.PracticeTargets=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(targetShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && targetPart != "none",
              $"a value-tuple row is part of the build's fingerprint: one practice target moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (target {pi}: {targetShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {targetPart[..Math.Min(90, targetPart.Length)]})");
        // A ROW WITH A DELEGATE FIELD IS HASHED TOO: WaveCrew.Count is a Func<WaveBrief,int> --
        // StructRow used to demand every field Plain, so a WaveCrew[] printed as its bare type name
        // ("WaveCrew"), and the private static readonly rows built from it (Waves.Patrol, Waves.HuntPin)
        // never entered the fingerprint at all. One crew's Step moved, moves it; put back it is the
        // build's again, and the printed row shows the struct written out, not a bare type name.
        var w = Waves.All.First(x => x.Id == "raid");
        int ci = Rng.RandiRange(0, w.Crew.Length - 1);
        var c = w.Crew[ci];
        w.Crew[ci] = new WaveCrew(c.Kind, c.Way, c.Nth, c.Count, c.At, c.Step + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f));
        int crewShifted = FingerprintNow();
        string crewPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Waves.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        try
        {
            Check(crewShifted != Net.Protocol && crewPart.Contains("WaveCrew{", StringComparison.Ordinal),
                  $"a row with a delegate field is part of the build's fingerprint: one wave crew's step moved moves it, and it is written out, not bare ({crewShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {crewPart[..Math.Min(90, crewPart.Length)]})");
        }
        finally { w.Crew[ci] = c; }
        Check(FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol,
              $"a wave crew row put back is the build's fingerprint again ({FingerprintNow():x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8})");
        // THE KITS LANE'S TABLES ARE PART OF THE BUILD (lane A, K2): the outgoing door's rows
        // (StatusSet.OutGuards, a struct row with an enum field), a heavy raider row's F20 fields
        // (Barrels, MissileFlight, MissileDamage, the Status? Cc, Exp) and an ability row's F1 Add and
        // Ramp (a RampSpec table inside a table). Each field moved moves the fingerprint, and the part
        // that moved is the table's own; put back, it is the build's again. A skipped table would
        // leave two builds that differ only there shaking hands.
        {
            int oi = Rng.RandiRange(0, StatusSet.OutGuards.Length - 1);
            var ogWas = StatusSet.OutGuards[oi];
            var heavies = Enemies.All.Where(e => e.Barrels > 1).ToArray();
            var ed = heavies[Rng.RandiRange(0, heavies.Length - 1)];
            var (barWas, flWas, mdWas, ccWas, exWas) = (ed.Barrels, ed.MissileFlight, ed.MissileDamage, ed.Cc, ed.Exp);
            var ab = Ab.Broadside;
            var (addWas, rampWas) = (ab.SpeedAdd, ab.Ramp);
            var moves = new (string what, string part, Action set, Action back)[]
            {
                ($"outgoing door row {oi}'s gun share", "StatusSet.OutGuards=",
                    () => { var g = ogWas; g.Gun += Vary(0.05f, 0.4f); StatusSet.OutGuards[oi] = g; }, () => StatusSet.OutGuards[oi] = ogWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s barrels", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Barrels = barWas + Rng.RandiRange(1, 3), () => ed.Barrels = barWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s missile flight", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.MissileFlight = flWas + Vary(0.5f, 4f), () => ed.MissileFlight = flWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s missile damage", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.MissileDamage = mdWas + Vary(1f, 20f), () => ed.MissileDamage = mdWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s Cc", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Cc = ccWas == null ? Status.Pinned : null, () => ed.Cc = ccWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s Exp", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Exp = exWas + Vary(1f, 20f), () => ed.Exp = exWas),
                ("an ability row's SpeedAdd", "Ab.Broadside=", () => ab.SpeedAdd = "max_speed", () => ab.SpeedAdd = addWas),
                ("an ability row's Ramp", "Ab.Broadside=", () => ab.Ramp = new RampSpec { Build = "max_speed", Cap = "max_speed", Bleed = "max_speed" }, () => ab.Ramp = rampWas),
            };
            var unseen = new List<string>();
            foreach (var (what, part, set, back) in moves)
            {
                string before = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal));
                string after;
                int moved;
                try { set(); moved = FingerprintNow(); after = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal)); }
                finally { back(); }
                if (moved == Net.Protocol || before == null || after == before) unseen.Add($"{what} ({part} {(before == null ? "absent" : "unmoved")})");
            }
            Check(unseen.Count == 0 && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && ab.Ramp == rampWas && ed.MissileFlight == flWas,
                  $"the kits lane's tables are part of the build's fingerprint: an outgoing door row, a heavy's barrels / missile flight / missile damage / Cc / Exp, an ability row's SpeedAdd and Ramp each move it, and put back it is the build's again ({(unseen.Count == 0 ? "all 8 seen" : "unseen: " + string.Join("; ", unseen))}{Moved(FingerprintNow())})");
        }
        // A BARE BELL TABLE IS HASHED: Nozzle was a positional record struct -- no public fields, so
        // not a row to StructRow -- and Lanes.CourierBells / Gatherer.DroneBells, Nozzle[] fields of
        // their own, never entered the fingerprint. One courier bell moved moves it; put back it is
        // the build's again, and the part shows the bell written out field by field.
        var bells = (Nozzle[])typeof(Lanes).GetField("CourierBells", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static).GetValue(null);
        int bi = Rng.RandiRange(0, bells.Length - 1);
        var bellWas = bells[bi];
        bells[bi] = new Nozzle(bellWas.X + Vary(0.5f, 5f), bellWas.Y, bellWas.Bell);
        int bellShifted = FingerprintNow();
        bells[bi] = bellWas;
        string bellPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Lanes.CourierBells=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(bellShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && bellPart.Contains("Nozzle{Bell=2.11", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a bare bell table is part of the build's fingerprint: one courier bell moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (bell {bi}: {bellShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {bellPart[..Math.Min(90, bellPart.Length)]})");
        // Net.Fingerprint() folds in every static field of every null-namespace type that is
        // IsLiteral or IsInitOnly with a Plain field type -- and string is Plain. A
        // `public static readonly string Build` would therefore enter the hash two peers are
        // matched on, and two BYTE-IDENTICAL builds packed a minute apart would refuse each other
        // at the handshake. Asserted STRUCTURALLY, the way the trap is laid: the member must be a
        // property, and the static field behind it must be neither literal nor init-only.
        var buildProp = typeof(Game).GetProperty("Build", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);
        var buildFields = typeof(Game).GetFields(BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
                                      .Where(f => f.FieldType == typeof(string) && (f.IsLiteral || f.IsInitOnly)).ToList();
        Check(buildProp != null && buildProp.PropertyType == typeof(string)
              && typeof(Game).GetField("Build", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null
              && buildFields.All(f => f.Name != "_build")
              && Game.Build == "dev",
              $"the build a player reads is a property over a mutable static, so it cannot enter the protocol hash two peers are matched on -- and outside a release it says so ({Game.Build}; {buildFields.Count} frozen strings on Game, none of them the build)");
    }

    // ── A BOSS KEEPS UP WITH THE PILOT IT IS FIGHTING ───────────────────────────────────────────
    // Its hull and damage have always climbed 10% a level; its WIND-UPS and its REACH never moved,
    // so a pilot whose gear and points lengthen its own reach every level would fight each boss
    // from further out and dodge it more easily than the last. One percent a level, compounding:
    // quicker to wind up, faster in flight, longer-armed. The burn of a beam and how often that
    // burn is judged are left alone, because those are the damage and it has a scale of its own.
    void BossScaleChecks()
    {
        var row = Missions.ForLevel(1).Moves.First(m => m.Windup > 0 && m.Reach > 0);
        Check(Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(1) - 1.0) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(2) - 1.01) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(11) - Math.Pow(1.01, 10)) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(51) - Math.Pow(1.01, 50)) < 1e-9,
              $"a boss gains 1% a level on its wind-ups and its reach: x{Missions.Quicken(2):0.000} at level 2, x{Missions.Quicken(11):0.000} at 11, x{Missions.Quicken(51):0.000} at 51");

    }

    // ── THE CURVE (lane F): Par, the chip-free reference pilot's rows ──
    // THE ONE PLACE PAR IS PROVED AGAINST LITERALS (numbers_curve_raids_items.md §1.3). Every other
    // check reads Par rather than repeating a figure the item pass will re-literal.
    void CurveParChecks()
    {
        bool at(int L, double h, double d, double c) =>
            Math.Abs(Par.HullScale(L) - h) < 0.0006 && Math.Abs(Par.DamageScale(L) - d) < 0.0006 && Math.Abs(Par.CraftScale(L) - c) < 0.0006;
        Check(at(1, 1, 1, 1) && at(10, 1.418, 1.636, 1.376) && at(20, 1.642, 2.004, 1.593) && at(40, 2.216, 3.131, 2.151) && at(80, 2.341, 3.259, 2.272),
              $"Par: hull x{Par.HullScale(10):0.000} / x{Par.HullScale(20):0.000} / x{Par.HullScale(40):0.000}, damage x{Par.DamageScale(10):0.000} / x{Par.DamageScale(20):0.000} / x{Par.DamageScale(40):0.000}, craft x{Par.CraftScale(40):0.000} at L10 / 20 / 40 (1.418 / 1.642 / 2.216, 1.636 / 2.004 / 3.131, 2.151)");
        // THE PLATEAU: flat past L40 (tiers stop at T10, the gate at g26), and never falling.
        bool rising = Enumerable.Range(1, 79).All(L => Par.HullScale(L + 1) >= Par.HullScale(L) && Par.DamageScale(L + 1) >= Par.DamageScale(L) && Par.CraftScale(L + 1) >= Par.CraftScale(L));
        bool whole = Enumerable.Range(0, Par.Rows.Length).All(i => Par.Rows[i].Level == i + 1) && Par.Rows.Length == 80;
        Check(rising && whole && Par.HullScale(80) / Par.HullScale(40) <= 1.1 && Par.HullScale(200) == Par.HullScale(80) && Par.HullScale(0) == 1,
              $"Par never falls, has a row for every level 1-80, and is flat past L40: x{Par.HullScale(80) / Par.HullScale(40):0.000} from L40 to L80, the same at L200, and x1 under L1");
        // THE L1 ANCHOR: the Lancer's 60 s hull is 3222 (the fleet's walled L1 median), the Drake's x700/760.
        Check(Math.Abs(Par.Rows[0].Boss - 3222) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760 - 2968) < 0.5,
              $"the Lancer's L1 hull on par's 60 s is 3222 and the Drake's 2968 ({Par.Rows[0].Boss:0}, {Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760:0})");
        // THE BOSS ROWS MOVE WITH PAR: when the item pass re-literals the table, the two L1 hulls in
        // Missions.Bosses (read by id) must move with Rows[0].Boss, or this goes red.
        {
            double lanHull = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "silver_lancer").Hull, draHull = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "drake_bastion").Hull;
            Check(Math.Abs(lanHull - Par.Rows[0].Boss) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(draHull - Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760) < 0.5,
                  $"the boss rows stand on Par's anchor: silver_lancer {lanHull} = Rows[0].Boss {Par.Rows[0].Boss:0.0}; drake_bastion {draHull} = x700/760 of it ({Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760:0.0})");
        }
        // TIME TO DIE holds at every level (a pilot who stops dodging): par's hull against the cut
        // sheet x DamageScale, less the 0.5% a second it regenerates -- 31.0 s against the Lancer's 15.76,
        // 42.0 s against the Drake's 12.19, at three varied levels anywhere on the table (fractional too).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            double L = Vary(1f, 80f), H = Par.DamageScale(L) * Par.Rows[0].Hull;
            double lancer = H / (15.76 * Par.DamageScale(L) - 0.005 * H), drake = H / (12.19 * Par.DamageScale(L) - 0.005 * H);
            Check(Math.Abs(lancer - 31.0) < 0.2 && Math.Abs(drake - 42.0) < 0.3,
                  $"at L{L:0.0} par lives {lancer:0.0} s against the Lancer's sheet (31.0) and {drake:0.0} s against the Drake's (42.0)");
        }
        // A FRACTIONAL LEVEL is read between its two rows, and LevelAtHull is DamageScale's inverse,
        // at three varied levels inside the rising part of the table (L1-40).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            double L = Vary(1.2f, 39.8f); int lo = (int)Math.Floor(L);
            double t = L - lo, mid = Par.HullScale(lo) + (Par.HullScale(lo + 1) - Par.HullScale(lo)) * t;
            Check(Math.Abs(Par.HullScale(L) - mid) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Par.LevelAtHull(Par.DamageScale(L)) - L) < 1e-6,
                  $"L{L:0.00}: hull x{Par.HullScale(L):0.0000} between L{lo} and L{lo + 1}, and a hull x{Par.DamageScale(L):0.000} of par's L1 stands at L{Par.LevelAtHull(Par.DamageScale(L)):0.00}");
        }
    }

    // THE CUT (lane F, numbers §1.2): with no chips, par lives 31 s against the Lancer and 42 s against
    // the Drake at every level, so every boss move but the two 250 supers (the Lancer's burn, the
    // Drake's rock) is its old row x0.744 / x0.787 -- the ram and the scrap included, though the
    // code flags them Super. The old rows are literals here, so a row moved back fails.
    void CurveBossRowChecks()
    {
        var lan = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "silver_lancer"); var dra = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "drake_bastion");
        double Dmg(Missions.BossType b, string id) => b.Moves.First(m => m.Id == id).Damage;
        var cut = new (Missions.BossType b, string id, double was, double k, double now)[]
        {
            (lan, "guns", 3.6, 0.744, 2.68), (lan, "trident", 15, 0.744, 11.2), (lan, "wave", 45, 0.744, 33.5), (lan, "ram", 40, 0.744, 29.8),
            (dra, "gun", 6, 0.787, 4.72), (dra, "shotgun", 18.75, 0.787, 14.76),
        };
        foreach (var (b, id, was, k, now) in cut)
            Check(Math.Abs(Dmg(b, id) - now) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Dmg(b, id) / was - k) < 0.003,
                  $"{b.Name}'s {id}: {Dmg(b, id)} = {was} x{Dmg(b, id) / was:0.000} (the cut is x{k})");
        var beam = lan.Moves.First(m => m.Id == "beam");
        Check(beam.Damage == 50 && beam.Damage * 5 == 250 && Dmg(dra, "throw") == 250
              && lan.Moves.Length == 5 && dra.Moves.Length == 3,
              $"the two supers are kept: the burn {beam.Damage} a tick (250 over its five landings) and the rock {Dmg(dra, "throw")}; no other move on either row");
        // A SIEGE READS THE LANCER'S ROW BY ID, not by its place in Missions.Bosses (whose order sets
        // which boss holds odd and even levels): with the two rows swapped for the length of this
        // check, the base is still 3222 and a pylon 402.75, at three varied levels.
        var order = Missions.Bosses.ToArray();
        try
        {
            (Missions.Bosses[0], Missions.Bosses[1]) = (Missions.Bosses[1], Missions.Bosses[0]);
            var pb = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base)); var py = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Pylon));
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                int L = (int)Vary(1f, 40f);
                Check(Missions.Bosses[0].Id == "drake_bastion" && Math.Abs(pb.Hull(L) - 3222) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(py.Hull(L) - 402.75) < 1e-9,
                      $"with the boss rows reordered, the siege still stands on silver_lancer at L{L}: base {pb.Hull(L)} (3222), pylon {py.Hull(L)} (402.75)");
            }
        }
        finally { order.CopyTo(Missions.Bosses, 0); }
    }

    // A RAIDER'S STRENGTH IS A LEVEL (lane F): its hull on Par's craft scale, its laser volley on
    // Par's damage scale, its missile the row's flat figure -- a light and a heavy at three varied
    // levels, whole and fractional, spawned the way every wave spawns them (Hub.SpawnRaider).
    void CurveRaiderChecks()
    {
        foreach (int kind in new[] { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Gunship })
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                double L = k == 0 ? (int)Vary(2f, 20f) : Vary(20f, 70f);
                var r = H.SpawnRaider(Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(Vary(-2500f, 2500f), -3900f), kind, null, L);
                if (r == null) { Check(false, $"a level-{L:0.0} raider could not be spawned"); continue; }
                var d = Enemies.Of(kind);
                Check(Math.Abs(r.Strength - L) < 1e-12 && Math.Abs(r.MaxHull - d.Hull * Par.CraftScale(L)) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(r.Hp - r.MaxHull) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(r.Volley - d.Dps * d.Barrels * d.ShotEvery * Par.DamageScale(L)) < 1e-9 && r.Volley > d.Dps * d.Barrels * d.ShotEvery,
                      $"a level-{L:0.00} {(r.Heavy ? "heavy" : "light")}: hull {r.MaxHull:0.0} ({d.Hull} x{Par.CraftScale(L):0.000}), a volley of {r.Volley:0.00} (x{Par.DamageScale(L):0.000}); its missile stays the row's {d.MissileDamage:0}");
                H.RaiderDown(r);
            }
    }

    // ── FIELDS (lane D, F9): what a ship draws round itself while a slot runs is a ROW (Fields.All) ──
    // The rule, with no ship: a row is up only on a hull that HAS its slot, only while the slot's Left
    // runs, and a row with a pool only while its Own is unspent, fading as Own / pool. The bubble is
    // proved against its literals (260 u, a 400 pool) off the freighter's real sheet, from three
    // seeded draws of what is left of the pool -- never on the pool's edge.
    void FieldsContractChecks()
    {
        var fs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        Check(Math.Abs(fs["bubble_radius"] - 260) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(fs["bubble_pool"] - 400) < 1e-9 && Fields.Of("bubble")?.Slot == "bubble",
              $"fields: the bubble row reads the freighter's own sheet, 260 u over a 400 pool ({fs["bubble_radius"]:0} u, {fs["bubble_pool"]:0})");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            double own = Vary(20f, 380f), left = Vary(0.5f, 7.5f);
            float len = Vary(80f, 260f);
            var up = Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (left, own), id => fs[id], len).ToList();
            var b = up.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            Check(up.Count == 1 && b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - own / 400) < 1e-4 && b.Tag == null,
                  $"fields: a bubble with {own:0} of 400 left and {left:0.0} s to run is up at 260 u, drawn at {own / 400:0.00} strength ({b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.00})");
            Check(!Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (0.0, own), id => fs[id], len).Any()
                  && !Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (left, 0.0), id => fs[id], len).Any()
                  && !Fields.Up(id => false, id => (left, own), id => fs[id], len).Any(),
                  $"fields: and none at all once its time is out, once its pool is spent, or on a hull with no bubble slot (run {run})");
        }
    }
    // THE BUBBLE ON A LIVE FREIGHTER: pressed still, pressed while moving, pressed turned and then
    // spent -- Fields.Up(ship) shows it at the sheet's 260 u from the first frame the slot runs, fades
    // with the pool, and is gone the moment the pool is.
    async Task FieldsBubbleChecks(PlayerShip fr, Vector2 yonder)
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            fr.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); fr.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            fr.Velocity = run == 1 ? Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(30f, 70f) : Vector2.Zero;
            fr.Sl("bubble").Cool = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Left = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Own = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool downBefore = !Fields.Up(fr).Any(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            fr.UseAbility("bubble", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && !fr.BubbleUp; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var b = Fields.Up(fr).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            Check(downBefore && b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - 1f) < 1e-4,
                  $"fields: a live freighter's bubble is drawn from its slot, at 260 u and full strength ({(run == 1 ? "moving" : "still")}, {b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.00})");
            if (run != 2) continue;
            double spent = Vary(100f, 300f);
            fr.Hit(spent, fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 200f), "test:fieldspend");
            var half = Fields.Up(fr).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            fr.Hit(400 - spent + Vary(5f, 20f), fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 200f), "test:fieldspent");   // just past the pool: the hull keeps nearly all it had
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(half.Row != null && Math.Abs(half.Left - (400 - spent) / 400) < 1e-3 && !Fields.Up(fr).Any(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble"),
                  $"fields: {spent:0} spent of the pool draws it at {(400 - spent) / 400:0.00} ({half.Left:0.00}); spent out, it is gone though its clock runs ({fr.Sl("bubble").Left:0.0} s)");
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
        fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }
    // THE KITS' FIELD ROWS, by their literals and with no ship (their abilities are other lanes'):
    // the Supercarrier's ring is its sheet's patrol_range (600 u stock, 648 u under a common
    // Targeting Chip's +8%), the Taunt's tag reads its guard (0.67 is "−33%"), and the boost's plume
    // is up exactly while its slot runs. Each from three seeded draws of what is left of the slot.
    void FieldsRowChecks()
    {
        var want = new[] { ("patrol", "super"), ("taunt", "taunt"), ("boost", "boost") };
        Check(want.All(w => Fields.Of(w.Item1)?.Slot == w.Item2),
              $"fields: the kits' rows are there, each on its slot ({string.Join(", ", want.Select(w => $"{w.Item1}:{Fields.Of(w.Item1)?.Slot ?? "MISSING"}"))})");
        foreach (var (reach, guard) in new[] { (600.0, 0.67), (648.0, 0.67), (600.0, 0.5) })
        {
            double left = Vary(0.5f, 19.5f);
            float len = Vary(80f, 260f);
            double Stat(string id) => id == "patrol_range" ? reach : id == "taunt_guard" ? guard : 0;
            var up = Fields.Up(id => id != "bubble", id => (left, 0.0), Stat, len).ToDictionary(u => u.Row.Id);
            string tag = guard == 0.67 ? "−33%" : "−50%";
            Check(up.TryGetValue("patrol", out var pr) && Math.Abs(pr.Radius - reach) < 1e-3 && pr.Row.Look == FieldLook.Dashed,
                  $"fields: the patrol ring is drawn at the carrier's patrol_range, {reach:0} u ({(up.ContainsKey("patrol") ? up["patrol"].Radius : -1):0})");
            Check(up.TryGetValue("taunt", out var tg) && tg.Tag == tag && tg.Row.Look == FieldLook.Shimmer && Math.Abs(tg.Radius - len * 0.55f) < 1e-3,
                  $"fields: the taunt shimmers over the hull and its tag reads {tag} for a guard of {guard} ({(up.ContainsKey("taunt") ? up["taunt"].Tag : "none")})");
            Check(up.ContainsKey("boost") && up["boost"].Row.Look == FieldLook.Plume
                  && !Fields.Up(id => id != "bubble", id => (0.0, 0.0), Stat, len).Any(),
                  $"fields: the boost's plume burns while its slot runs ({left:0.0} s left) and none of the three is up once it is out");
        }
    }
    // THE SAME ROWS ON A LIVE SHIP, for every class that owns the slot: its slot running draws the
    // field from its OWN sheet. A slot no class owns yet is another lane's ability still to merge
    // (lane E's Supercarrier, the Warden's Taunt, lane B's boost): said as a NOTE, never a pass.
    async Task FieldsLiveRowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var row in new[] { "patrol", "taunt", "boost" })
        {
            var def = Fields.Of(row);
            var owners = Enum.GetValues<ShipClass>().Where(c => Abilities.For(c).Any(a => a.Id == def.Slot)).ToList();
            if (owners.Count == 0) { GD.Print($"NOTE unbound field row {row}: no class owns slot '{def.Slot}' yet"); continue; }
            foreach (var c in owners.Take(3))
            {
                await SetClass(c);
                var s = Me; s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                s.Sl(def.Slot).Left = Vary(1.5f, 3f);
                var f = Fields.Up(s).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == row);
                bool radiusOk = row != "patrol" || (Math.Abs(f.Radius - s.Stats["patrol_range"]) < 1e-3 && s.Stats["patrol_range"] >= 600 - 1e-6);
                bool tagOk = row != "taunt" || f.Tag == $"−{Mathf.RoundToInt((float)(1 - s.Stats["taunt_guard"]) * 100)}%";
                Check(f.Row != null && radiusOk && tagOk,
                      $"fields: a live {c} with its '{def.Slot}' slot running draws the {row} field ({f.Radius:0} u{(f.Tag != null ? ", " + f.Tag : "")})");
                s.Sl(def.Slot).Left = 0;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                Check(!Fields.Up(s).Any(u => u.Row.Id == row), $"fields: ...and none once the {c}'s '{def.Slot}' slot is out");
            }
        }
    }
    // THE TAUNT'S FLASH IS AN EFFECT ROW: raised at three seeded spots with its 1000 u reach, one
    // node each, that ring at that size, and gone after its 0.8 s.
    async Task FieldsTauntRingChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 600f);
            Fx.Raise(Fx.TauntRing, at, 1000f);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var n = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.TauntRing).ToList();
            Check(Fx.All[Fx.TauntRing].Id == "taunt_ring" && n.Count == 1 && Math.Abs(n[0].Radius - 1000f) < 1e-3 && n[0].GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(at) < 0.5f,
                  $"fields: the taunt's ring goes up once, 1000 u round where it was pressed ({n.Count} up)");
            await Wait(1.0);
            Check(!Nodes<FxNode>().Any(x => x.Id == Fx.TauntRing), "fields: ...and is gone after its 0.8 s");
        }
    }
    // ── THE TORN CHUNK (lane D, F9; kits_v3 §3.2, kits_v31 §3.3): ONE raise per tear, riding the
    // anchor's NetId, Size 0.16 x the hull's length; with it the sparks, the smoke and a scar on the
    // hull at the hook. The chunk leaves at 260 u/s within ±25° of the line to the destroyer and is
    // at rest at 2 s; the node follows the pure Fx.Tumble of its raise, which is what lets every peer
    // draw the same chunk. `size` is the spec's literal (kits_v3 §3.2: dummy 14.72 -- its "15 u", 0.16
    // x 2 x its 46 u hit radius --, Lancer 57.6, pylon 35.2, base 89.6), NaN only for a boss the spec
    // gives no figure for. Once up the chunk has left its hull for the world (Combat.World), so a hull
    // killed under it does not take it along. The hook, the bearing and the distance to the destroyer
    // are seeded, and re-taken for every tear.
    async Task FieldsRipChecks(IHittable anchor, string what, float size, bool timed)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        float len = Fx.LengthOf(anchor);
        var hookLocal = new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * len);
        var hook = n.ToGlobal(hookLocal);
        var toward = hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f);
        int scars0 = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, toward);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3).ToList();
        var chunk = rips.FirstOrDefault();
        float want = float.IsNaN(size) ? 0.16f * len : size;
        Check(rips.Count == 1 && chunk.Anchor == anchor.NetId && chunk.GetParent() == Combat.World && Math.Abs(chunk.Radius - want) < 0.05f && Math.Abs(0.16f * len - want) < 0.05f
              && chunk.Start.DistanceTo(hook) < 0.5f,
              $"rip on the {what}: ONE chunk rides its id, out in the world ({chunk?.GetParent()?.Name}), {want:0.0} u (0.16 of its {len:0} u), cut where the hook was ({rips.Count} raised, {chunk?.Radius:0.0} u, {chunk?.Start.DistanceTo(hook):0.0} u off)");
        int sparks = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.RipSparks && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
        int smoke = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
        var scars = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion()).ToList();
        var fresh = scars.OrderBy(x => x.Elapsed).FirstOrDefault();
        Check(sparks == 1 && smoke == 1 && scars.Count == Math.Min(scars0 + 1, 3) && fresh != null && fresh.Position.DistanceTo(hookLocal) < 0.5f
              && Fx.All[Fx.RipSparks].Count == 28 && Fx.All[Fx.RipSmoke].Count == 6,
              $"rip on the {what}: 28 sparks and 6 puffs go with it, and a scar on the hull at the hook ({sparks}, {smoke}, {scars.Count} scars)");
        if (chunk == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.Elapsed < 0.5; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk)) { Check(false, $"rip on the {what}: the chunk is gone before 0.5 s"); return; }
        double e = chunk.Elapsed;
        var moved = chunk.GlobalPosition - chunk.Start;
        float off = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(moved.AngleTo(toward - chunk.Start)));
        float run = 260f * (float)(e - e * e / 4);
        var (pure, _) = Fx.Tumble(chunk.Seed, chunk.Start, toward, e);
        Check(off <= 25.01f && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - run) < 1f && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(pure) < 0.01f,
              $"rip on the {what}: {e:0.00} s on, the chunk is {moved.Length():0} u out (260 u/s slowing to rest in 2 s: {run:0}), {off:0.0} degrees off the line to the destroyer, exactly where its raise says");
        if (!timed) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.Elapsed < 2.2; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var still = chunk.GlobalPosition;
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool atRest = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(still) < 0.01f;
        await Wait(1.1);
        bool gone = !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) || chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        bool loose = !Nodes<FxNode>().Any(x => (x.Id == Fx.RipSparks || x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke) && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId);
        bool scarOn = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(fresh) && !fresh.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        Check(atRest && gone && loose && scarOn,
              $"rip on the {what}: the chunk lies still past 2 s and is gone by 3.3 s with its sparks and smoke; the scar stays (still {atRest}, gone {gone}, sprays gone {loose}, scar {scarOn})");
        await Wait(7.0);
        Check(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(fresh) || fresh.IsQueuedForDeletion(), $"rip on the {what}: ...and the scar is gone by 10.3 s");
    }
    // AT MOST 3 SCARS ON ONE HULL: four tears in a row leave three, the first one gone.
    async Task FieldsScarCapChecks(IHittable anchor)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        FxNode first = null;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
        {
            var hook = n.ToGlobal(new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * Fx.LengthOf(anchor)));
            Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f));
            await Wait(Vary(0.08f, 0.15f));
            first ??= n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        }
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        int scars = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        Check(scars == 3 && (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(first) || first.IsQueuedForDeletion()),
              $"four tears in a row leave 3 scars on the hull, the oldest gone ({scars})");
    }
    // A HULL KILLED UNDER ITS OWN CHUNK: torn at a seeded hook, then killed 0.2 s later by its caller
    // (the real kill: an emplacement is freed the frame it dies). The chunk was cut and has left for
    // the world, so at 1 s it is still drawn, where its raise says, with its sparks and smoke -- a
    // chunk that stayed its hull's child went with it (the gate's finding, kits_v3 §3.2's 3 s life).
    async Task<FxNode> FieldsTearAhead(IHittable anchor)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        var hook = n.ToGlobal(new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * Fx.LengthOf(anchor)));
        Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f));
        await Wait(0.2);
        return Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId).OrderBy(x => x.Elapsed).FirstOrDefault();
    }
    async Task FieldsRipOutlivesChecks(FxNode chunk, Node2D hull, string what)
    {
        int id = chunk?.Anchor ?? -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && !chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion() && chunk.Elapsed < 1.0; i++)
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool hullGone = !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(hull) || hull.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        bool drawn = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && !chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion() && chunk.IsVisibleInTree()
                     && chunk.GetParent() == Combat.World && chunk.Elapsed >= 1.0
                     && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(Fx.Tumble(chunk.Seed, chunk.Start, chunk.To, chunk.Elapsed).At) < 0.01f;
        int sprays = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => (x.Id == Fx.RipSparks || x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke) && x.Anchor == id);
        Check(hullGone && drawn && sprays == 2,
              $"a {what} killed 0.2 s after a tear leaves its chunk flying: at 1 s it is still drawn where its raise says, with its sparks and smoke (hull gone {hullGone}, chunk {drawn}, {sprays} sprays)");
    }
    // THE YARD'S DUMMIES: three tears on three of them, the last one watched to the end, then the cap.
    async Task FieldsRipYardChecks()
    {
        var names = new[] { "TargetDummy1", "TargetDummy3", "TargetDummy4" };
        float dummyLen = Fx.LengthOf(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>(names[0]));
        Check(Math.Abs(0.16f * dummyLen - 15f) < 0.3f, $"a dummy's chunk is the spec's 15 u: 0.16 of its {dummyLen:0.0} u is {0.16f * dummyLen:0.00} u");
        for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
            await FieldsRipChecks(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>(names[i]), $"dummy {names[i][^1]}", 14.72f, timed: i == names.Length - 1);
        await FieldsScarCapChecks(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1"));
    }
    // A GUEST SEES THE HOST'S TEAR (rung 5). The host tears a chunk from the boss's nose, at the
    // literal hook FieldsRipHook, thrown at the guest's ship; this watches every frame, from before
    // the arena, for the first chunk to go up here, and reads it once it has flown 30 u: riding the
    // boss's id at the Lancer's 57.6 u, gone up within 20 u of where the boss's nose is on THIS
    // peer, flying down its SEEDED line -- the line to this ship turned by this peer's own
    // Fx.U(seed, 0) x 25 degrees -- and its scar on the boss here too. The line is to where this ship
    // is NOW and the host aimed at where it was, so the budget is what the ship has moved since (20 u,
    // plus its speed over the chunk's flight and the wire) seen from where the chunk went up; it
    // never rests on the spec's 25 degree bound.
    static Vector2 FieldsRipHook(float len) => new(0, -0.4f * len);
    void FieldsHostTears(Boss boss, PlayerShip at)
    {
        if (boss == null || at == null) return;
        Fx.Tear(boss, boss.ToGlobal(FieldsRipHook(boss.Length)), at.Position);
    }
    string _guestRip;
    LateSampler FieldsGuestRipWatch()
    {
        _guestRip = null;
        var w = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (_guestRip != null) return true;
            var b = H?.Boss; var me = Me;
            var chunk = Nodes<FxNode>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip);
            if (b == null || me == null || chunk == null || chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(chunk.Start) < 30f) return false;
            float fromNose = chunk.Start.DistanceTo(b.ToGlobal(FieldsRipHook(b.Length)));
            var line = me.Position - chunk.Start;
            var seeded = line.Normalized().Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad((Fx.U(chunk.Seed, 0) * 2 - 1) * 25f));
            float off = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs((chunk.GlobalPosition - chunk.Start).AngleTo(seeded)));
            float moved = 20f + me.Velocity.Length() * (float)(chunk.Elapsed + (Wan ? 0.6 : 0.25));
            float budget = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Atan2(moved, Mathf.Max(1f, line.Length())));
            bool scar = b.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Any(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar);
            bool ok = chunk.Anchor == b.NetId && Math.Abs(chunk.Radius - 57.6f) < 0.05f && fromNose < 20f && off < budget && scar;
            _guestRip = $"{(ok ? "ok" : "BAD")}: rides {chunk.Anchor} (boss {b.NetId}), {chunk.Radius:0.0} u, {fromNose:0.0} u from the nose here, {off:0.0} degrees off its seeded line to this ship (budget {budget:0.0}), scar {scar}";
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(w);
        return w;
    }
    async Task FieldsGuestRipChecks(LateSampler w)
    {
        await RealTime(() => w.Seen, Wan ? 20 : 12);
        Check(_guestRip != null && _guestRip.StartsWith("ok"), $"arena guest: the host's torn chunk is drawn here, the same chunk ({_guestRip ?? "never seen"})");
        w.QueueFree();
    }

    // A GUEST DRAWS THE HOST'S BUBBLE: the same row, from the slot the host's report carried.
    void FieldsGuestBubbleChecks(PlayerShip fgm)
    {
        var b = Fields.Up(fgm).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
        Check(b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - 250f / 400f) < 1e-3,
              $"arena guest: its bubble FIELD is drawn from the host's slot, 260 u at 250 of 400 ({b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.000})");
    }

    // ── THE RECYCLER: a hold turned back into salvage, and a lock so it cannot eat what you fly ──
    // A part could not be got rid of at all before this: a hold filled with commons a pilot would
    // never fit again, and salvage had nothing to buy but a refit and gear levels.
    // ── LANE E · WINGS (F13 widened, kits_v31 §3.2 / kits_v3 §3.1): the gunship and patrol rows, the
    // Orbit way, the ring pick. The keys that send them are 6a's (the Carrier's E and Q); these checks
    // send them through PlayerShip.Sortie, the one door those keys will use.
    void WingsRowsChecks()
    {
        var gs = Wings.Of(WingKind.Gunship); var pt = Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol); var fi = Wings.Of(WingKind.Fighter);
        var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier);
        // the wire id is the index: gunship 2, then patrol 3 (kits_v3 §3.1)
        Check(Wings.All.Length == 4 && Wings.All[2].Id == "gunship" && Wings.All[3].Id == "patrol"
              && gs.Way == WingWay.Orbit && gs.Sortie && pt.Sortie && !fi.Sortie && !Wings.Of(WingKind.Bomber).Sortie,
              $"Wings.All: fighter 0, bomber 1, gunship 2 (the Orbit way), patrol 3 -- both sorties, the fitted two not ({string.Join(" ", Wings.All.Select(w => w.Id))})");
        Check(cv["gunship_count"] == 2 && cv["gunship_orbit"] == 240 && cv["gunship_time"] == 12 && cv["gunship_leash"] == 3000
              && Math.Abs(cv["gunship_damage"] / cv["gunship_interval"] - 10) < 1e-9,
              $"warp gunships: 2 a target, a 240 u orbit, 12 s, sent inside 3000 u, 10 DPS each ({cv["gunship_damage"]} / {cv["gunship_interval"]} s)");
        // "Every number is the fighter's": the patrol reads the fighter's own stat ids, so what lifts one lifts both
        Check(cv["patrol_range"] == 600 && cv["patrol_orbit"] == 300 && cv["patrol_time"] == 20
              && pt.CountStat == fi.CountStat && pt.SpeedStat == fi.SpeedStat && pt.DamageStat == fi.DamageStat
              && pt.IntervalStat == fi.IntervalStat && pt.TurnStat == fi.TurnStat && pt.RangeStat == fi.RangeStat
              && pt.BurstStat == null && pt.EngageStat == "patrol_range" && pt.ToHull
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.Carrier).Reach.ContainsKey("patrol_range"),
              "the patrol: a 600 u ring measured to the hull, circling 300 u out, 20 s, on the fighter's own count, gun, speed and turn, no rest -- and its ring on the carrier's Reach list");
        // THE PATROL'S ORDER IS THE TURRET'S: in flight 0, small craft 1, the rest 2, a dummy 3 (a fallback)
        var f = Targeting.Patrol;
        var mis = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Missile }; var lt = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Light };
        var hv = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Heavy }; var dm = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Dummy };
        Check(f.Chooses(mis) && f.Chooses(hv) && f.Chooses(dm) && f.IsFallback(dm) && !f.IsFallback(mis)
              && Turret.RankIn(f, mis) == 0 && Turret.RankIn(f, lt) == 1 && Turret.RankIn(f, hv) == 2 && Turret.RankIn(f, dm) == 3
              && !Targeting.WingPrey.Chooses(mis),
              $"Targeting.Patrol takes a missile (WingPrey never does), ranked missile {Turret.RankIn(f, mis)} < light {Turret.RankIn(f, lt)} < heavy {Turret.RankIn(f, hv)} < dummy {Turret.RankIn(f, dm)}, the dummy a fallback");
    }

    // THE PATROL, flown: from three seeded spots and headings, a carrier parked with its point defence
    // out of reach (the patrol on trial). Launched 0.83 s apart, fighter_count of them; circling
    // 300 u out; a light whose hull edge is inside 600 u engaged, one outside not; +8% on the ring
    // takes one at 612-640; a seeker coming in is taken OVER the light it is on and downed before it
    // lands, credited "patrol"; the fitted fighters attack a target 1400 u out with the patrol up (6
    // craft out); the sortie ends at its LifeStat and every patrol craft is home and freed.
    async Task WingsPatrolChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var cv = Me; double pdWas = PdReachOff(cv);
        var ringStat = cv.Stats.All.First(x => x.Id == "patrol_range");
        List<Wing> Patrol() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Done).ToList();
        Raider Mark(Vector2 at) { var l = H.SpawnRaider(at); l.Hp = 9000; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return l; }
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { cv.Position = at; cv.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; cv.Rotation = head; }
                async Task Frame() { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2);
                cv.RecallWing();
                if (run == 1) cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 4);          // a Hangars part's +1: the patrol reads the fighter's count
                int want = (int)cv.Stats["fighter_count"];
                int sent = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                var pat = Patrol();
                // sent for the row's LifeStat: its end read in the frame it was sent
                double life = pat.Count > 0 ? pat.Max(w => w.Until) - cv.Clock : -1;
                bool lifeAll = pat.Count > 0 && pat.All(w => Math.Abs(w.Until - cv.Clock - 20) < 1e-6);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && pat.Any(w => w.LaunchedAt < 0); i++) await Frame();
                var outs = pat.Select(w => w.LaunchedAt).Where(t => t >= 0).OrderBy(t => t).ToList();
                double gap = 99; for (int g = 1; g < outs.Count; g++) gap = Math.Min(gap, outs[g] - outs[g - 1]);
                Check(sent == want && pat.Count == want && outs.Count == want && gap >= 0.83 - 1e-9 && gap < 0.83 + 0.05 && lifeAll,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the patrol is fighter_count craft ({want}), out of the hangar 0.83 s apart ({sent} sent, smallest gap {gap:0.000} s), sent for 20 s ({life:0.###} s)");
                if (run == 1) cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 3);
                // circling the carrier 300 u out: the frames after every craft has settled into the circle
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !pat.All(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle"); i++) await Frame();
                await Wait(1.5); Hold();
                float lo = 9999f, hi = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) { await Frame(); foreach (var w in pat) { float d = w.Position.DistanceTo(at); lo = Mathf.Min(lo, d); hi = Mathf.Max(hi, d); } }
                Check(pat.All(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle") && lo > 300 - 40 && hi < 300 + 40,
                      $"run {run + 1}: with nothing in its ring the patrol circles the carrier 300 u out ({lo:0}-{hi:0} u)");
                // THE RING, measured to the hull's edge: one light well inside, then one well outside
                var bearing = VaryAngle();
                var inL = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * 1f);
                inL.Position = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * (Vary(560f, 590f) + inL.HitRadius);
                bool took = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !took; i++) { await Frame(); took = pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, inL)); }
                Check(took, $"run {run + 1}: a light whose hull edge is {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), inL):0} u from the carrier (inside 600) is engaged");
                inL.TakeDamage(1e12);
                var outL = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(1.2f, 2.4f)) * 1f);
                outL.Position = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(1.2f, 2.4f)) * (Vary(612f, 640f) + outL.HitRadius);
                bool touched = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2; i++) { await Frame(); touched |= pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); }
                Check(!touched, $"run {run + 1}: one whose hull edge is {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), outL):0} u out (past 600) is not");
                // a Targeting Chip's +8% (648 u) takes that one in
                ringStat.Bonus += 0.08;
                bool chip = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !chip; i++) { await Frame(); chip = pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); }
                ringStat.Bonus -= 0.08;
                Check(chip && Math.Abs(cv.Stats["patrol_range"] - 600) < 1e-9,
                      $"run {run + 1}: with +8% on the ring (648 u) the one at {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), outL):0} u is engaged");
                // MISSILES COME FIRST: a light engaged inside the ring, then a seeker from inside it at the carrier
                outL.Position = at + (outL.Position - at).Normalized() * (Vary(250f, 450f) + outL.HitRadius);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); i++) await Frame();
                double credit0 = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol"); int down0 = Shot.Intercepted; double hull0 = cv.Hp;
                var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(480f, 560f);
                var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, at - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: cv.NetId, turnRate: 2f);
                int turnedIn = -1; float downAt = -1f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && sk.Alive; i++)
                {
                    await Frame();
                    if (turnedIn < 0 && pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, sk))) turnedIn = i + 1;
                    if (sk.Alive) downAt = sk.Position.DistanceTo(at);
                }
                Check(turnedIn > 0 && turnedIn <= 2 && !sk.Alive && Shot.Intercepted > down0 && cv.Hp >= hull0
                      && cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") > credit0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: a seeker fired at the carrier from {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u is taken over the light the patrol was on (in {turnedIn} frames) and brought down {downAt:0} u out, before it lands, credited \"patrol\" ({cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") - credit0:0.0}; hull {hull0:0.#} -> {cv.Hp:0.#})");
                outL.TakeDamage(1e12);
                // THE FITTED WING WITH IT: the fighters still attack a target 1400 u out, so 6 craft are out
                if (run == 0)
                {
                    var far = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1350f, 1420f));
                    cv.OrderAttack(far);
                    int outNow = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && outNow < 6; i++)
                    { await Frame(); outNow = Nodes<Wing>().Count(w => w.Carrier == cv && (w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter || w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol) && !w.Inside); }
                    bool fightersAt = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !fightersAt; i++)
                    { await Frame(); fightersAt = Nodes<Wing>().Any(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter && w.Position.DistanceTo(far.Position) < 400f); }
                    bool patrolHome = Patrol().All(w => w.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 600f + 150f);
                    Check(outNow == 6 && fightersAt && patrolHome && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Fighter) == 3,
                          $"the first wing still attacks a target {at.DistanceTo(far.Position):0} u out with the patrol up: {outNow} craft out, the fighters at it ({fightersAt}), the patrol still round the carrier ({patrolHome})");
                    cv.RecallWing(); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
                }
                // THE END: at its LifeStat (cut to 3 s from here, the row's 20 being proved above) every patrol craft flies
                // home and is freed; the fitted fighters are untouched
                foreach (var w in Patrol()) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock + 3);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2; i++) await Frame();
                bool stillOut = Patrol().Count == want;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && Patrol().Count > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(stillOut && Patrol().Count == 0 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) == 0 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Fighter) == 3,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the sortie ends at its time -- out 2 s before it, then home and freed ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol)} left); the 3 fitted fighters are kept");
                // ENDED WITH CRAFT STILL IN THE HANGAR (the carrier lost in the launch spread, or a short
                // LifeStat): `run` of them out when it ends -- none, one, two -- the rest never go and
                // are freed at once; the ones out come home and are freed as ever
                int crew = (int)cv.Stats["fighter_count"];
                cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                var early = Patrol();
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && early.Count(w => w.LaunchedAt >= 0) < run; i++) await Frame();
                var inside = early.Where(w => w.LaunchedAt < 0).ToList();
                foreach (var w in early) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock);
                int innerFrames = 0;
                for (; innerFrames < 60 && inside.Any(w => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(w) && !w.Done); innerFrames++) await Frame();
                bool innerFreed = inside.All(w => !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(w) || (w.Done && w.LaunchedAt < 0));
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(early.Count == crew && inside.Count == crew - run && innerFreed && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) == 0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: a sortie ended with {inside.Count} of {early.Count} still in the hangar: those never launch and are freed within 1 s ({innerFrames} frames), and none is left ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol)})");
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            cv.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdWas); cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 3);
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
    }

    // THE GUNSHIPS, flown: from three seeded spots, gunship_count warped onto a 240 u circle round a
    // target the carrier sent them at (inside 3000 u; one past it refused), 10 DPS each landed on it,
    // credited "gunship", gone at their time; and, with the patrol up at once, split by anchor --
    // the gunships on their far target, the patrol still round the carrier.
    async Task WingsGunshipChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var cv = Me; double pdWas = PdReachOff(cv);
        List<Wing> Guns() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Done).ToList();
        Raider Mark(Vector2 at, double hp) { var l = H.SpawnRaider(at, Enemies.Gunship); l.Hp = hp; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return l; }
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { cv.Position = at; cv.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; cv.Rotation = head; }
                async Task Frame() { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2);
                var bearing = VaryAngle();
                var past = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(3080f, 3400f), 9000);
                int refused = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, past);
                past.TakeDamage(1e12);
                var tgt = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(0.8f, 2.0f)) * Vary(900f, 2900f), 1e9);
                await Frame();
                int sent = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, tgt);
                var gs = Guns();
                double life = gs.Count > 0 ? gs.Max(w => w.Until) - cv.Clock : -1;
                bool lifeAll = gs.Count > 0 && gs.All(w => Math.Abs(w.Until - cv.Clock - 12) < 1e-6);
                bool warped = false; float firstOff = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && !warped; i++)
                {
                    await Frame();
                    warped = gs.Count == 2 && gs.All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit");
                    if (warped) firstOff = gs.Max(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position) - 240f));
                }
                Check(refused == 0 && sent == 2 && warped && firstOff < 30f && lifeAll,
                      $"run {run + 1}: gunships at a target {at.DistanceTo(past.Position):0} u out refused ({refused}); at one {at.DistanceTo(tgt.Position):0} u out, 2 warp onto its 240 u circle (off it by {firstOff:0.0} u), sent for 12 s ({life:0.###} s)");
                // the landed DPS, timed from the frame both were on their circle: 2 x 10 over 4 s
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp, c0 = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("gunship"); float lo = 9999f, hi = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 240; i++) { await Frame(); foreach (var w in gs) { float d = w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position); lo = Mathf.Min(lo, d); hi = Mathf.Max(hi, d); } }
                double lost = hp0 - tgt.Hp, credited = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("gunship") - c0;
                Check(Math.Abs(lost - 80) <= 12 && Math.Abs(credited - lost) < 1e-6 && lo > 240 - 40 && hi < 240 + 40,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the two land {lost:0.0} in 4 s (2 x 10 DPS = 80), all credited \"gunship\" ({credited:0.0}), holding {lo:0}-{hi:0} u round it");
                if (run == 0)
                {   // SPLIT BY ANCHOR: the patrol up at once stays round the carrier while the gunships hold theirs
                    cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                    float patrolFar = 0f, gunNear = 9999f;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5; i++)
                    {
                        await Frame();
                        foreach (var w in Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Inside)) patrolFar = Mathf.Max(patrolFar, w.Position.DistanceTo(at));
                        foreach (var w in Guns()) gunNear = Mathf.Min(gunNear, w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position));
                    }
                    Check(patrolFar > 0 && patrolFar < 600 + 150 && gunNear > 240 - 40 && Guns().Count == 2,
                          $"gunships and the patrol at once, split by anchor: the patrol never past {patrolFar:0} u of the carrier, the gunships never nearer their target than {gunNear:0} u");
                    foreach (var w in Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol)) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock);
                }
                // THE END: at their time (cut to 2 s from here, the row's 12 being proved above) they warp out
                foreach (var w in gs) w.SendOut(tgt, cv.Clock + 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) await Frame();
                bool stillThere = Guns().Count == 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && Guns().Count > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(stillThere && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the gunships are on station until their time, then gone ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship)} left)");
                // ...and a target that dies takes them with it
                if (run == 2)
                {
                    var t2 = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(900f, 1500f), 9000);
                    await Frame();
                    cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, t2);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 && !Guns().All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit"); i++) await Frame();
                    t2.TakeDamage(1e12);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 10 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) > 0; i++) await Frame();
                    Check(cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0, "a gunship's target dies: they warp out with it");
                }
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            cv.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdWas);
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
    }

    async Task RecyclerChecks()
    {
        var yard = H.Yard;
        // THE RECYCLER BELONGS TO THE EQUIPMENT BASE, and serves only a pilot over it and calm
        // (Landmarks.Serves). The ship is set down on the pad at a seeded spot with its combat clock
        // run out, for everything below, and put back after.
        var me = Me; if (me == null) { Check(false, "the recycler checks need a ship to set down on the equipment base"); return; }
        var keepAt = me.Position; var pad = Landmarks.ById("equipment");
        me.Position = pad.At + new Vector2(Vary(-0.8f, 0.8f) * pad.Half.X, Vary(-0.8f, 0.8f) * pad.Half.Y); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_combatT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(me, 0.0);
        Character.GearHold.Clear(); Character.GearLocked.Clear();
        Character.Stow("bs_rapid_1"); Character.Stow("bs_rapid_1"); Character.Stow("cv_elite_3");
        yard.SetStock("salvage", 0);

        // A KIT PART IS NOT LOOT and is refused outright; a LOCKED part is refused too.
        Character.Stow("bs_main_battery");
        bool kitRefused = !yard.QueueScrap("bs_main_battery");
        Character.ToggleGearLock("cv_elite_3");
        bool lockedRefused = !yard.QueueScrap("cv_elite_3") && Character.GearLocked.Contains("cv_elite_3");

        // QUEUED: out of the hold at once, so it cannot be fitted or queued twice while it waits.
        bool queued = yard.QueueScrap("bs_rapid_1");
        bool goneFromHold = Character.GearHold.GetValueOrDefault("bs_rapid_1") == 1 && yard.ScrapPending == 1;
        // ...and TAKE BACK puts it straight back.
        bool back = yard.UnqueueScrap("bs_rapid_1") && Character.GearHold.GetValueOrDefault("bs_rapid_1") == 2 && yard.ScrapPending == 0;
        Check(kitRefused && lockedRefused && queued && goneFromHold && back,
              $"the recycler takes loot and nothing else: a hull's own mount refused, a locked part refused, a queued part out of the hold at once and back again when taken back ({yard.ScrapPending} queued)");

        // IT PAYS, one part every Economy.ScrapEvery, in salvage, by rarity.
        // ONE EPIC, because the pile will not hold still: the salvagers fill it and the hauler
        // takes loads off it while this runs, so the payment has to be big enough to read through
        // that. 600 against a fleet that moves tens either way in five seconds.
        Character.ToggleGearLock("cv_elite_3");                      // unlocked, to be scrapped
        bool epicQueued = yard.QueueScrap("cv_elite_3");
        double paid0 = yard.Stock("salvage");
        await Wait(Economy.ScrapEvery + 0.6);
        double paid = yard.Stock("salvage") - paid0;
        Check(epicQueued && paid > 450 && paid < 750 && yard.ScrapPending == 0
              && Math.Abs(Economy.ScrapValue(Rarity.Common) - 100) < 1e-6
              && Math.Abs(Economy.ScrapValue(Rarity.Rare) - 250) < 1e-6
              && Math.Abs(Economy.ScrapValue(Rarity.Epic) - 600) < 1e-6,
              $"it chews through the queue one part every {Economy.ScrapEvery:0} s and pays by rarity -- an epic is 600 ({paid:0} into a pile the fleet is also working), a rare 250, a common 100");
        Character.ToggleGearLock("cv_elite_3");                      // ...and locked again for the round trip below
        Character.Stow("cv_elite_3");

        // A LOCK IS THE PART ID'S, like its level, and it survives a round trip to disk.
        string keepId = Character.Id;
        Character.Id = "recycler"; Character.Save();
        Character.GearLocked.Clear();
        bool loaded = Character.Load("recycler") && Character.GearLocked.Contains("cv_elite_3");
        Character.Delete("recycler"); Character.Id = keepId;
        Check(loaded, $"a lock belongs to the part id and comes back off disk ({string.Join(",", Character.GearLocked)})");
        Character.GearHold.Clear(); Character.GearLocked.Clear();
        me.Position = keepAt; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── THE LANES: four courier runs to the outposts, a quarter of the passive income each ──
    // Everything asserted here is a literal from the owner's words: four lanes, 25% each, both
    // directions, a quarter off for one blockade and a half for two, and the gunship's own 42
    // coming back the other way. Where things STAND is varied (VaryNear); what they are worth is
    // not.
    async Task LaneChecks()
    {
        var Y = H.Yard;
        var lv = (System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, int>)typeof(Yard)
                 .GetField("_levels", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(Y);
        var cdF = typeof(LaneGun).GetField("_cd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        double keepOre = Y.Stock("ore"), keepCredits = Y.Credits;
        var keepMe = Me.Position;
        // clear of every lane's stand by more than a raider's 2000 u notice, so nothing a check
        // puts on a lane comes after the pilot instead of holding it
        var park = VaryNear(Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(-700, 700), 150f);
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e9);
        Me.Position = park; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        await Wait(0.3);
        // 100 units delivered, and what the base is actually PAID for them. Yard.Deposit is the
        // one place the lanes are felt, and this is read in the SAME frame it is called, so the
        // fleet's own deliveries cannot move the figure.
        double Paid() { Y.SetStock("ore", 0); Y.Deposit("ore", 100); return Y.Stock("ore"); }

        // ── THE TABLE: four lanes, base to outpost, a quarter each ──────────────────────────
        Check(Lanes.All.Length == 4 && Lanes.All.All(l => Math.Abs(l.Share - 0.25) < 1e-9)
              && Math.Abs(Lanes.All.Sum(l => l.Share) - 1.0) < 1e-9
              && Enumerable.Range(0, Lanes.All.Length).All(i => Lanes.Ends(i).near == Hub.BasePos
                                                                && Lanes.Ends(i).far == Hub.Outposts[Lanes.All[i].Outpost].at)
              && Enumerable.Range(0, Lanes.All.Length).Select(Lanes.Name).SequenceEqual(new[] { "SE", "NE", "NW", "SW" }),
              $"four lanes, each from the base to one outpost, carrying a quarter of the passive income and a whole between them ({string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, Lanes.All.Length).Select(i => $"{Lanes.Name(i)} {Lanes.All[i].Share:0.00}"))})");

        // ── A COURIER DOCKS WHERE THE FLEET DOES ────────────────────────────────────────────
        // The owner: "let the trade ships from outposts share the landing zones with the miners and
        // salvagers. Not stopping early awkwardly." Every courier on every lane -- all four
        // bearings, every run -- is put the same VARIED time short of the end of its approach, one
        // of each pair to its base arm and the other to its outpost's clamp, seen to be flying, and
        // left to fly it in real frames. Where each ENDS is asserted: its centre within 50 u of the
        // pad's, its nose within 10 u of the open face, and pointing in through it within 5 degrees.
        var drones = Nodes<Courier>().ToList();
        var c0 = drones.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Lane == 0);
        Check(c0 != null && drones.Count == Lanes.All.Sum(l => l.Drones) && drones.Count(c => c.Lane == 0) == 2,
              $"every lane has its couriers ({drones.Count} of {Lanes.All.Sum(l => l.Drones)} built)");
        // THE DOCKS STAND WHERE THEY WERE MEASURED, proved here against literals so the checks below
        // may read the rows. The base's five arms did not move when they became rows of Docks.BaseArms:
        // each index on the spot it was measured at, in the order Yard.NetState sends an arm's index
        // down the wire. An outpost carries four clamps, one on each corner, opening outward. And
        // every lane docks at the arm on its own side of the base and the clamp on its outpost's
        // corner nearest the base. WHICH PLACE CARRIES WHICH DOCKS is its Landmark row, reached by
        // id: the base the five arms (the Yard's own, in the same order), each of the four outposts
        // the four clamps where it stands, and no other place any.
        var armWas = new[] { new Vector2(0f, -195.9f), new Vector2(-169.5f, -97.9f), new Vector2(169.5f, -97.9f),
                             new Vector2(-169.5f, 97.9f), new Vector2(169.5f, 97.9f) };
        var clampAt = new[] { new Vector2(-43.1f, -57.2f), new Vector2(43.1f, -57.2f), new Vector2(-43.1f, 55.5f), new Vector2(43.1f, 55.5f) };
        var clamps = Docks.On(Landmarks.Outposts[0]);
        bool carried = Docks.On(Landmarks.ById("base")).Select(d => d.Row.Id).SequenceEqual(Y.Arms.Select(a => a.Dock.Row.Id))
                       && Landmarks.Outposts.Length == 4
                       && Enumerable.Range(0, 4).All(i => Landmarks.Outposts[i].At == Hub.Outposts[i].at && Docks.On(Landmarks.Outposts[i]).Length == 4
                                                          && Docks.On(Landmarks.Outposts[i]).All(d => d.At == Hub.Outposts[i].at))
                       && Landmarks.All.Count(l => Docks.On(l).Length > 0) == 5;
        var ends = new[] { ("arm_se", "clamp_nw"), ("arm_ne", "clamp_sw"), ("arm_nw", "clamp_se"), ("arm_sw", "clamp_ne") };
        Check(carried && Y.Arms.Length == 5 && Enumerable.Range(0, 5).All(i => Y.Arms[i].Dock.Pad.DistanceTo(Hub.BasePos + armWas[i]) < 0.05f)
              && clamps.Length == 4 && Enumerable.Range(0, 4).All(i => clamps[i].Pad.DistanceTo(Hub.Outposts[0].at + clampAt[i]) < 0.05f
                                                                     && Mathf.Abs(clamps[i].Row.Open.X) > 0.99f && clamps[i].Row.Open.X * clampAt[i].X > 0f)
              && drones.All(c => (c.Home.Row.Id, c.Away.Row.Id) == ends[c.Lane]),
              $"the docks stand where they were measured -- the base's five arms in the wire's order ({string.Join(" ", Y.Arms.Select(a => a.Dock.Row.Id))}), four clamps on an outpost's corners opening outward, carried by the base's place and each outpost's and by no other ({carried}) -- and every lane docks on its own side ({string.Join(", ", drones.GroupBy(c => c.Lane).Select(g => $"{Lanes.Name(g.Key)} {g.First().Home.Row.Id}/{g.First().Away.Row.Id}"))})");
        // TWO CRAFT MAY SHARE ONE PAD: a miner is put in the arm one courier (on a lane the seed
        // picks) is coming in to, holding it and unloading, before the courier arrives.
        foreach (var x in Y.Gatherers) { x.ResetToWork(); Y.Release(x); }   // every arm free, nobody in line
        int sl = Math.Min(Lanes.All.Length - 1, (int)Vary(0f, Lanes.All.Length));
        var sharer = drones.First(c => c.Lane == sl);
        int shared = Array.FindIndex(Y.Arms, a => a.Dock.Row == sharer.Home.Row);
        var sDock = Y.Arms[Math.Max(0, shared)].Dock;
        var holder = Y.Gatherers.First(g => g.Kind == GatherKind.Miner);
        Y.SetArm(holder, Math.Max(0, shared)); holder.State = Gatherer.St.Unloading; holder.Cargo = 1e6;
        holder.Position = sDock.Berth(holder.Def.Length); holder.Rotation = sDock.Heading;
        var keepPhase = drones.Select(c => c.Phase).ToArray();
        var keepClock = drones.Select(c => c.Clock).ToArray();
        float before = Vary(0.3f, 1.5f);                 // how far out each starts: WHERE on its approach
        foreach (var c in drones)
        {
            bool toBase = drones.Where(d => d.Lane == c.Lane).ToList().IndexOf(c) % 2 == 0;   // the sharer is first of its lane
            c.Phase = 0f;
            c.Clock = (toBase ? c.Cycle : c.Cycle * 0.5) - before;
        }
        // timed from the effect: every one is seen in the air before its approach is counted
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        int flyingIn = drones.Count(c => !c.Docked);
        await Wait(before + 1.2);                        // in, and 1.2 s into its 2 s on the dock
        var landed = drones.Select(c =>
        {
            var dk = c.Outbound ? c.Home : c.Away;       // a half begins on a dock: home going out, away coming back
            var nose = Aim.Nose(c, c.Def.Length * 0.5f);
            return (c, dk, fromPad: c.Position.DistanceTo(dk.Pad),
                    toFace: (nose - dk.Pad).Dot(dk.Row.Open) - dk.Row.Reach,
                    skew: Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(c.Rotation, dk.Heading))));
        }).ToList();
        var farthest = landed.OrderByDescending(l => l.fromPad).First();
        // NOT SHORT OF IT, from the courier's own 30 u (the pack's, sprites.md Q6): a nose inside the
        // 10 u band puts the centre at most the pad's reach + 10 + 15 out. A flat 50 u was that bound
        // for the old 22 u courier and sat exactly ON the edge for the new one (50.0 u, nose 4 u off).
        Check(flyingIn == drones.Count
              && landed.All(l => l.c.Docked && !l.c.Held && l.fromPad < l.dk.Row.Reach + 10f + 30f * 0.5f && l.toFace > 0f && l.toFace < 10f && l.skew < 5f)
              && drones.All(c => Y.Arms.Any(a => a.Dock.Row == c.Home.Row)
                                 && Landmarks.Outposts[c.Def.Outpost].Docks.Contains(c.Away.Row) && c.Away.At == Hub.Outposts[c.Def.Outpost].at),
              $"every courier docks where the fleet does -- a base service arm at one end, its outpost's clamp at the other -- and not short of it: centre within the pad's reach + 25 u (the 10 u band + half the 30 u courier), nose within 10 u of the open face and pointing in, flown in from {before:0.00} s out on all four bearings ({flyingIn} of {drones.Count} flying at the start, {landed.Count(l => l.c.Docked)} docked; farthest {Lanes.Name(farthest.c.Lane)} {farthest.dk.Row.Id}: {farthest.fromPad:0.0} u off the pad's centre, nose {farthest.toFace:0.0} u off the face, {farthest.skew:0.0} deg off nose-in)");
        // ...and the one that came in to a held arm sits BESIDE the miner holding it: its centre past
        // the miner's own half-width along the face, its own outer edge still on the face. The miner
        // keeps its arm. Both read after the wait, where they are now.
        float along = (sharer.Position - sDock.Pad).Dot(sDock.Outboard);
        var sharerArt = Nodes<Sprite2D>(sharer).First();
        float sharerHalf = sharerArt.Texture.GetWidth() * sharerArt.Scale.X * 0.5f;
        Check(shared >= 0 && Y.Arms[shared].Occupant == holder && Y.QueueLength == 0
              && sharer.Docked && holder.Position.DistanceTo(sDock.Berth(holder.Def.Length)) < 1f
              && along > holder.Extent.halfWidth && along + sharerHalf <= sDock.Row.Face * 0.5f + 0.5f,
              $"two craft may share one pad: lane {Lanes.Name(sl)}'s courier docks at {sDock.Row.Id} while a miner holds it, beside it ({along:0.0} u outboard of the centre line, past the miner's {holder.Extent.halfWidth:0} u half-width; its outer edge {along + sharerHalf:0.0} u out on a {sDock.Row.Face * 0.5f:0.0} u half-face; still the miner's: {Y.Arms[Math.Max(0, shared)].Occupant == holder})");
        holder.ResetToWork(); Y.Release(holder);
