                ["cannon"] = 0.31931, ["missile_whoosh"] = 0.23291, ["impact_thunk"] = 0.71484, ["boss_ram"] = 0.74997,
                ["boss_shockwave"] = 0.89996, ["boss_trident"] = 0.69998, ["drake_gun"] = 0.59998, ["drake_warp"] = 0.59998,
                ["drake_scrap"] = 0.84998, ["drake_throw"] = 0.74997, ["drake_rock"] = 0.89996,
            };
            var moved = rest.Where(kv => Math.Abs(Peak($"res://sfx/{kv.Key}.wav") / kv.Value - 1) > 0.01).Select(kv => kv.Key).ToList();
            Check(moved.Count == 0, $"...and no sound that is not a beam moved ({string.Join(",", moved)})");
        }

        await WebRtcPairs();
        // leaks: leaving and re-entering the hub must not grow the orphan-node or object
        // counts (the first cycle warms caches; compare the next two against it)
        async Task Cycle()
        {
            GetTree().ChangeSceneToFile("res://MainMenu.tscn"); await Wait(0.5);
            GetTree().ChangeSceneToFile("res://Hub.tscn"); await Wait(1.0);
        }
        // Collect .NET garbage first, so the count shows real leaks, not objects merely
        // waiting for the collector (it runs whenever it likes).
        async Task<double> Settled()
        {
            for (int g = 0; g < 2; g++) { System.GC.Collect(); System.GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers(); }
            for (int f = 0; f < 3; f++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            return Performance.GetMonitor(Performance.Monitor.ObjectCount);
        }
        await Cycle();
        double objA = await Settled(), orphA = Performance.GetMonitor(Performance.Monitor.ObjectOrphanNodeCount);
        await Cycle(); await Cycle();
        double objB = await Settled(), orphB = Performance.GetMonitor(Performance.Monitor.ObjectOrphanNodeCount);
        GD.Print($"  leak check: orphan nodes {orphA:0} -> {orphB:0}; objects {objA:0} -> {objB:0} (after collection)");
        Check(orphB <= orphA, "no orphan nodes accumulate across leaving and re-entering the hub");
        Check(objB <= objA + 20, "no objects accumulate across leaving and re-entering the hub");
        HeldFiles();
        // THE LEVEL COMES WITH THE SECTOR: a peer sent into a world is told the level in the same call,
        // set before the world -- and an arena's boss -- is built from it, rather than left to the
        // mission report that follows. (Sent home again here, where the hub has just been rebuilt.)
        {
            int lv0 = Missions.Level;
            Priv(H, "NetSector", (int)Hub.SectorKind.Home, Missions.Kind, 7, Session.HeardTrip + 1);   // the kind rides beside the level now; a new trip
            int lvSet = Missions.Level;
            await Wait(1.0);                                   // the home world, rebuilt
            Missions.Level = lv0;
            Check(lvSet == 7 && H != null && !Hub.InArena, $"a peer sent into a world is told the level with it, before the world is built ({lvSet})");
        }
        await S2TripChecks();
        R2BeatChecks();

        // ── LAST, because it ends a session and that resets the fleet ────────────────────
        // A session can end without anything else moving. Quitting to the menu changes scene and
        // Yard._ExitTree writes on the way out; pressing PLAY OFFLINE, or a host closing the lobby
        // while everyone stands at home, changes nothing but the socket -- and nothing wrote the
        // character on that route, with the autosave up to thirty seconds away.
        //
        // Hosted first so there is a session to leave, and the figure is changed WHILE in it, so a
        // stale file cannot pass: the value on disk has to be the one from inside the session.
        // Placed at the very end on purpose -- going offline re-parks the base and resets the
        // ships, which quietly broke four later checks when this sat in the middle of the run.
        var yard = H.Yard;
        Net.I.Host(P(27124));
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 && !Net.IsOnline; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool hosted = Net.IsOnline;
        yard.Credits = 4242;
        // a place held for a pilot that dropped, as the session ends
        var soloHeld = (System.Collections.IDictionary)Session.Places;   // Session.Held is a public record now
        soloHeld["ghost"] = new Session.Held { OldPeer = 515151, Name = "Ghost", Until = Time.GetTicksMsec() + 60000 };
        Priv(H, "RefreshAway");
        bool ghostInParty = H.PartyIds.Contains(515151);
        Net.I.GoOffline();
        await Wait(0.15);
        Check(ghostInParty && H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.Idle && H.PartyIds.SequenceEqual(new[] { Net.LocalId }) && soloHeld.Count == 0,
              $"a session ended with a place held: the solo world's party is this pilot alone -- its portal is not kept shut ({string.Join(",", H.PartyIds)})");
        var afterLeaving = new ConfigFile();
        afterLeaving.Load($"{Character.Dir}/{Character.Id}.cfg");
        Check(hosted && Math.Abs((double)afterLeaving.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0) - 4242) < 1e-6,
              $"leaving a session writes this peer's character, with no scene change to do it for them ({(double)afterLeaving.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0):0})");
    }

    // ── A FILE'S C# OBJECT OUTLIVES EVERY NODE THAT DREW IT (Assets.cs) ─────────────────────────
    // "Handle is not initialized", twice, in a solo run that passed every check (and in an arena
    // guest's): Godot swapping the GC handle of a texture whose C# object the collector had taken,
    // because the same path was being loaded again while that object's finalizer ran. It needs a
    // collection and a finalizer to land inside one load, so it is proved here by the two things
    // that close the gap for good, not by waiting for it. The build calls the engine's loader nowhere but
    // Assets: read from the build's own code, so a GD.Load added anywhere -- a lambda, an async body,
    // this harness -- is found; and the scan must find Assets' own calls, or it is reading nothing.
    // And a file whose last sprite has gone (the title screen's foe, left behind by the scene
    // changes above) keeps the very C# object it had through a full collection and its finalizers.
    void HeldFiles()
    {
        var calls = LoaderCalls();
        int inAssets = calls.Count(c => c.StartsWith("Assets."));
        var stray = calls.Where(c => !c.StartsWith("Assets.")).ToList();
        Check(inAssets >= 2 && stray.Count == 0,
              $"every file is loaded through Assets, which holds it: the engine's loader is called there {inAssets} times and nowhere else ({string.Join(", ", stray)})");
        const string foe = "res://enemy_light_tier_2.png";                // the title screen's foe: nothing in the hub draws it
        var (weak, refs) = DrawnAndDropped(foe);
        for (int g = 0; g < 2; g++) { GC.Collect(); GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers(); }
        var again = Assets.Load<Texture2D>(foe);
        Check(refs == 1 && weak.IsAlive && ReferenceEquals(weak.Target, again) && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(again),
              $"a file whose last sprite has gone keeps its C# object through a full collection, and is handed out again as that same object -- the gap the engine's handle swap failed in cannot open ({refs} reference left, the C# object {(weak.IsAlive ? "kept" : "collected")})");
    }
    // One sprite draws the file and goes, the way a scene or a raider does. Its own method, so no
    // local of the caller's keeps the C# object alive: the count left is the C# object's alone.
    [System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImpl(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
    static (WeakReference weak, int refs) DrawnAndDropped(string path)
    {
        var tex = Assets.Load<Texture2D>(path);
        new Sprite2D { Texture = tex }.Free();
        return (new WeakReference(tex), tex.GetReferenceCount());
    }
    // Every call to the engine's loader in this build, named by the type it was written in (a
    // lambda's or an async body's compiler-made type counts as the one that holds it). Read from
    // the IL: a call, a callvirt or an ldftn whose token is a member reference or a generic
    // instance -- the loader lives in GodotSharp, so a call to it is always one of those two.
    static List<string> LoaderCalls()
    {
        static bool Loader(MethodBase m) => (m.DeclaringType == typeof(GD) && m.Name == nameof(GD.Load))
                                            || (m.DeclaringType == typeof(ResourceLoader) && m.Name.StartsWith("Load"));
        const BindingFlags every = BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
        Type[] types;
        try { types = typeof(Assets).Assembly.GetTypes(); }
        catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException e) { types = e.Types.Where(t => t != null).ToArray(); }
        var found = new List<string>();
        foreach (var t in types)
        {
            var home = t; while (home.DeclaringType != null) home = home.DeclaringType;
            foreach (var m in t.GetMethods(every).Cast<MethodBase>().Concat(t.GetConstructors(every)))
            {
                byte[] il;
                try { il = m.GetMethodBody()?.GetILAsByteArray(); } catch (Exception) { continue; }
                if (il == null) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i + 4 < il.Length; i++)
                {
                    bool call = il[i] == 0x28 || il[i] == 0x6F || (il[i] == 0x06 && i > 0 && il[i - 1] == 0xFE);
                    if (!call || (il[i + 4] != 0x0A && il[i + 4] != 0x2B)) continue;
                    MethodBase callee;
                    try { callee = t.Module.ResolveMethod(BitConverter.ToInt32(il, i + 1), t.IsGenericType ? t.GetGenericArguments() : null,
                                                          m.IsGenericMethod ? m.GetGenericArguments() : null); }
                    catch (Exception) { continue; }
                    if (callee != null && Loader(callee)) found.Add($"{home.Name}.{m.Name}");
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    // ── multiplayer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // ── a dedicated two-player arena run (its own port, after the three-player run) ──
    // Mission 1: both READY, both at the portal, into the arena together; the boss dies;
    // both home. Mission 2: into the arena again; the host drops -- the guest must land
    // home, offline, with its OWN base (a marker credit total set before it joined).
    // ── S2: THE TRANSPORT-FREE PROTOCOL FIXES (network_audit_protocol.md P4, P5, P8, P9, P10) ─────
    sealed class S2Tagged : ITagged { public Tag Tags { get; init; } }
    // P5, P8 (solo): a throw moves nothing that holds a spot; a class is changed only at refit.
    async Task S2Checks()
    {
        Check(!Targeting.Throwable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Structure }) && !Targeting.Throwable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Dummy })
              && !Targeting.Throwable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Dummy | Tag.Light }) && Targeting.Throwable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Light }),
              "a throw may not move a structure or a practice dummy (a fighter dummy included), and still moves a light craft (P5)");
        var cls0 = Character.Class; var at0 = Me.Position;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var still = Nodes<TargetDummy>().Where(d => !d.Fighter).ToList();
        int kept = 0, thrown = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3 && still.Count > 0; i++)
        {
            var bs = Me; var dm = still[i % still.Count];
            bs.Position = VaryNear(dm.Position, 600f); bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;          // the dummy inside the 1000 u reach
            var mk = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(bs.Position, 500f)); mk.Hp = 9000; mk.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 20);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var dmAt = dm.Position; float mkWas = mk.Position.DistanceTo(bs.Position);
            bs.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
            bs.Shockwave();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            if (dm.Position.DistanceTo(dmAt) < 1f) kept++;
            if (mk.Position.DistanceTo(bs.Position) - mkWas > 900f) thrown++;
            mk.TakeDamage(99999);
        }
        Check(kept == 3 && thrown == 3,
              $"a bastion's shockwave, from 3 varied spots: every practice dummy stays where it stands, every raider beside it is thrown ({kept} kept, {thrown} thrown of 3; P5)");
        await SetClass(cls0);
        if (Me is { } back) { back.Position = at0; back.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
        Check(Hub.Refit(ShipClass.Destroyer, ShipClass.Battleship, arena: true, inCombat: false) == ShipClass.Destroyer
              && Hub.Refit(ShipClass.FreightHauler, ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, arena: false, inCombat: true) == ShipClass.FreightHauler
              && Hub.Refit(ShipClass.Destroyer, ShipClass.Battleship, arena: true, inCombat: true) == ShipClass.Destroyer,
              "a class announced in the arena, or in combat at home, is refused: the pilot keeps the class it had (P8)");
        Check(Hub.Refit(ShipClass.Destroyer, ShipClass.Battleship, arena: false, inCombat: false) == ShipClass.Battleship
              && Hub.Refit(null, ShipClass.Battleship, arena: true, inCombat: true) == ShipClass.Battleship
              && Hub.Refit(ShipClass.Battleship, ShipClass.Battleship, arena: true, inCombat: true) == ShipClass.Battleship,
              "a class announced at home out of combat is taken, and so is a pilot's first announcement anywhere (P8)");
    }
    // P10b (solo): the rejoin token. A token is one per pilot, 32 hex characters, the same each time
    // it is asked for; a place is claimed by it, from 3 situations -- no token issued, the old
    // connection gone, the old connection still live.
    void S2TokenChecks()
    {
        Session.Tokens.Clear();
        string a = "s2-pilot-" + Rng.Randi(), b = a + "-other";
        Check(Session.MayClaim(a, "", liveHolder: false) && !Session.MayClaim(a, "", liveHolder: true),
              "no token issued: a held place is claimed by the pilot's id, and a live pilot's is not (P10b)");
        string ta = Session.TokenFor(a), tb = Session.TokenFor(b);
        Check(ta.Length == 32 && ta.All(Uri.IsHexDigit) && Session.TokenFor(a) == ta && tb != ta,
              $"a rejoin token is 32 hex characters, one per pilot, the same each time it is asked for ({ta.Length}; P10b)");
        Check(Session.MayClaim(a, ta, liveHolder: false) && Session.MayClaim(a, ta, liveHolder: true)
              && !Session.MayClaim(a, "", liveHolder: false) && !Session.MayClaim(a, tb, liveHolder: false) && !Session.MayClaim(a, tb, liveHolder: true),
              "a token issued: only it claims the place, gone or still live; no token or another pilot's is refused (P10b)");
        Session.End();
        Check(Session.Tokens.Count == 0 && Session.MayClaim(a, "", liveHolder: false),
              "a session over forgets the tokens it issued (P10b)");
    }
    // P9 (solo): a trip already made is not made again. (The rewritten check above it: a new trip to
    // the very sector it is in IS made -- a retried mission reloads.)
    async Task S2TripChecks()
    {
        S2TokenChecks();
        var h0 = H; int trip = Session.HeardTrip;
        Priv(H, "NetSector", (int)Hub.Sector, Missions.Kind, Missions.Level, trip);
        await Wait(1.0);
        Check(H == h0 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(h0) && Session.HeardTrip == trip,
              $"a peer told of a trip it has already made stays in its world: no reload (trip {trip}; P9)");
    }

    // ── WEBRTC, R2a: THE BEAT AND THE WATCHDOG (plan §3.6) ───────────────────────────────────
    // Solo: the rules the watchdog and the round trip are made of, each from three situations, none on
    // the 8 s edge. Rung 5 (R2BeatGuest): a guest's round trip is measured by the beat's echoes.
    void R2BeatChecks()
    {
        // SILENCE IS COUNTED IN CAPPED FRAMES (Link.FrameCapS 0.25): this machine's own stall is not the
        // other end's silence
        double stall = Vary(3.0f, 20.0f);
        int frames = Rng.RandiRange(30, 90);
        double shortSum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) shortSum = Link.Quiet(shortSum, 1.0 / 60);
        double calm = Vary(7.0f, 7.5f), mixed = Link.Quiet(Link.Quiet(calm, stall), 1.0 / 60);
        Check(Math.Abs(Link.Quiet(0, stall) - 0.25) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(shortSum - frames / 60.0) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(mixed - calm - 0.25 - 1.0 / 60) < 1e-9 && !Link.Overdue(mixed),
              $"the watchdog counts silence in frames of at most 0.25 s: one {stall:0.0} s stall adds 0.25, {frames} frames of 1/60 s add {frames / 60.0:0.000} ({shortSum:0.000}), and 7-7.5 s of silence with a {stall:0.0} s stall on top is still no drop ({mixed:0.00} s)");
        // OVER LINK.QUIETMS (8000) IS A DROP: 33 capped frames (8.25 s) are, 7-7.8 s are not, 8.2-9 s are
        double capped = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 33; i++) capped = Link.Quiet(capped, Vary(0.3f, 2.0f));
        double under = Vary(7.0f, 7.8f), over = Vary(8.2f, 9.0f);
        Check(Link.QuietMs == 8000 && Link.BeatMs == 500 && Link.Overdue(capped) && !Link.Overdue(under) && Link.Overdue(over),
              $"a peer silent past 8 s is dropped, one silent under it is not: 33 long frames {capped:0.00} s dropped, {under:0.00} s kept, {over:0.00} s dropped (QuietMs {Link.QuietMs}, beat every {Link.BeatMs} ms)");
        // THE ROUND TRIP is the least of the LAST 8 echoes: an older, lower one ages out; a backwards clock
        // teaches nothing; none yet reads 0
        var trip = new Link.Trip();
        bool none = trip.Least == 0;
        double old = Vary(0.005f, 0.02f);
        trip.Echo(old);
        var last = Enumerable.Range(0, 8).Select(_ => Vary(0.05f, 0.3f)).ToList();
        foreach (var e in last) trip.Echo(e);
        trip.Echo(-Vary(0.01f, 1.0f));
        Check(none && Math.Abs(trip.Least - last.Min()) < 1e-12 && Link.Echoes == 8,
              $"the round trip is the least of the last 8 echoes: {trip.Least * 1000:0.0} ms (least of the 8: {last.Min() * 1000:0.0}; the older {old * 1000:0.0} ms aged out; a negative echo ignored; none at all read 0)");
        // THE BEAT HAS ITS OWN ROW, reliable, on Net
        var beat = typeof(Net).GetMethod("NetBeat", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)?.GetCustomAttribute<RpcAttribute>();
        var back = typeof(Net).GetMethod("NetBeatBack", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)?.GetCustomAttribute<RpcAttribute>();
        Check(NetChannels.Beat == 12 && beat != null && back != null && beat.TransferChannel == 12 && back.TransferChannel == 12
              && beat.TransferMode == MultiplayerPeer.TransferModeEnum.Reliable && back.TransferMode == MultiplayerPeer.TransferModeEnum.Reliable,
              $"the beat and its echo ride NetChannels.Beat (12), reliable, on Net ({beat?.TransferChannel}/{beat?.TransferMode}, {back?.TransferChannel}/{back?.TransferMode})");
    }
    // Rung 5, the guest: its round trip is the beat's, measured within a few beats of being let in.
    async Task R2BeatGuest()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && Net.RoundTrip <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double rt = Net.RoundTrip;
        Check(Net.IsOnline && rt > 0 && rt < 2.0, $"guest: the beat measures its round trip to the host once let in ({rt * 1000:0.0} ms, above 0 and under 2 s)");
    }
    // ── WEBRTC, R2: THE SWITCH (§3.1, §3.3, §6.1, §6.2) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Solo, from offline. The JOIN box's refusals come before any network step (no peer made); the host's
    // INVITE A FRIEND makes one paste-row entry per invite, each with its own drawn id, its code on the
    // (harness's) clipboard; the reply box names what it was handed; a reply for a Waiting entry moves it
    // to Linking; a hung-up entry is gone, and a reply for it is refused; the table stops at MaxPlayers.
    async Task R2SwitchChecks()
    {
        Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
        const string Build = "You both need the same release (Esc menu, bottom).";
        // THE JOIN BOX, three wrong texts: a reply, another build's invite (by its own number, and by this
        // player pretending), a damaged invite. Each is named, and nothing is connecting or made.
        var reply0 = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply);
        bool joined = Net.I.Join(Message(Rendezvous.Encode(reply0)));
        Check(!joined && !Net.I.Connecting && Net.I.NetworkIdle && Net.I.LastStatus == "That is a reply code: it goes to the host, not into JOIN.",
              $"a reply pasted into JOIN goes nowhere and says where it belongs ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        var other = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Invite);
        other.Proto = Net.Protocol ^ (1 << Rng.RandiRange(0, 30)); other.Build = "2026.01.02-0f0f0f0";
        joined = Net.I.Join(Rendezvous.Encode(other));
        Check(!joined && !Net.I.Connecting && Net.I.NetworkIdle
              && Net.I.LastStatus == $"This invite is from build 2026.01.02-0f0f0f0 ({other.Proto:x8}); you are on {Game.Build} ({Net.Protocol:x8}). {Build}",
              $"another build's invite is refused before any network step, naming both builds ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        var same = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Invite);
        same.Proto = Net.Protocol; same.Build = Game.Build;
        Net.PretendAt = Net.Pretend.Code;
        joined = Net.I.Join(Message(Rendezvous.Encode(same)));
        Net.PretendAt = Net.Pretend.None;
        Check(!joined && !Net.I.Connecting && Net.I.NetworkIdle
              && Net.I.LastStatus == $"This invite is from build {Game.Build} ({Net.Protocol:x8}); you are on {Game.Build} ({Net.Protocol ^ 1:x8}). {Build}",
              $"a player on another build refuses a real invite the same way (Net.PretendAt Code) ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        string code = Rendezvous.Encode(same);
        int at = Rng.RandiRange(10, code.Length - 2);
        string damaged = code[..at] + (code[at] == '7' ? '8' : '7') + code[(at + 1)..];
        joined = Net.I.Join(damaged);
        Check(!joined && !Net.I.Connecting && Net.I.NetworkIdle && Net.I.LastStatus == "That code is damaged or cut off: copy the whole message again.",
              $"a damaged invite is named as one, never looked up as an address ({Net.I.LastStatus})");

        // THE HOST: three invites, each its own entry with its own id, each code on the clipboard
        Net.I.Host(P(27131));
        Check(Net.IsHost && Net.IsOnline && Net.I.Pending.Count == 0 && Rendezvous.ListenPort == P(27131) && !Net.I.Full,
              $"HOST: a session with no invites yet, the listener on this run's port ({Rendezvous.ListenPort})");
        var made = new List<(int id, Rendezvous.Record inv, string clip)>();
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            Clip = "";
            await Wait(Vary(0.05f, 0.4f));
            Net.I.Invite();
            bool asked = Net.I.LastStatus == "Making an invite…";
            await RealTime(() => Clip.Length > 0, 6);
            var inv = Rendezvous.Find(Clip, Rendezvous.Kind.Invite);
            var entry = inv == null ? null : Net.I.Pending.Find(inv.Id);
            Check(asked && entry != null && entry.Row == Rendezvous.Paste.Id && entry.Stage == Rendezvous.Stage.Waiting && entry.Code == Clip
                  && inv.Proto == Net.Protocol && inv.Build == Game.Build && inv.Name == Character.Name && inv.Id >= 2 && Net.I.LastInvite == Clip
                  && Net.I.LastStatus.StartsWith("Invite copied. Send it to one friend, privately (it holds your IP addresses). When their reply comes, just copy it: the game takes it. Or paste it here."),
                  $"INVITE A FRIEND #{k + 1}: a paste-row entry, Waiting, whose code on the clipboard carries its id, this build and this pilot's name ({inv?.Id}; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
            if (inv != null) made.Add((inv.Id, inv, Clip));
        }
        Check(made.Count == 3 && made.Select(m => m.id).Distinct().Count() == 3 && Net.I.Pending.Count == 3,
              $"three invites, three ids, three entries ({string.Join(",", made.Select(m => m.id))}; {Net.I.Pending.Count} pending)");
        // THE REPLY BOX: an invite, a stranger's reply, words; then a reply for a real entry
        Net.I.TakeCode(Message(made[0].clip));
        Check(Net.I.LastStatus == "That is an invite: send it to a friend. Their reply goes here.", $"an invite pasted into the reply box is named ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        var stranger = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply);
        stranger.Id = made.Max(m => m.id) + 1;
        Net.I.TakeCode(Rendezvous.Encode(stranger));
        const string Gone = "That reply is for an invite this session no longer has (used, cancelled or expired). Send them a new invite.";
        Check(Net.I.LastStatus == Gone, $"a reply for no invite of this session is refused, and says what to do ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        Net.I.TakeCode("thanks, joining in a sec");
        Check(Net.I.LastStatus == "That code is damaged or cut off: copy the whole message again.", $"words with no code in them: named ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        var answer = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply);
        answer.Id = made[1].id; answer.Candidates.Clear();              // nothing to reach: the connection only waits
        Net.I.TakeCode(Message(Rendezvous.Encode(answer)));
        var linking = Net.I.Pending.Find(made[1].id);
        Check(linking is { Stage: Rendezvous.Stage.Linking } && linking.Name == answer.Name && Net.I.LastStatus == $"{answer.Name} is joining…",
              $"a reply for a Waiting invite is taken: its entry Linking, named for the friend ({linking?.Stage}; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
        Net.I.TakeCode(Rendezvous.Encode(answer));
        Check(Net.I.LastStatus == Gone && Net.I.Pending.Find(made[1].id)?.Stage == Rendezvous.Stage.Linking,
              $"the same reply again is refused: a connection takes one answer ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        // HUNG UP: gone from the table, and a reply for it is refused
        Net.I.Hang(made[2].id);
        var late = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply);
        late.Id = made[2].id; late.Candidates.Clear();
        Net.I.TakeCode(Rendezvous.Encode(late));
        Check(Net.I.Pending.Find(made[2].id) == null && Net.I.Pending.Count == 2 && Net.I.LastStatus == Gone,
              $"a hung-up invite leaves the table, and its reply is refused ({Net.I.Pending.Count} pending; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
        // FULL at 8, the host and invites not yet answered counted together
        for (int k = 0; k < 8 && !Net.I.Full; k++)
        {
            int before = Net.I.Pending.Count;
            Net.I.Invite();
            await RealTime(() => Net.I.Pending.All.All(e => e.Code.Length > 0) || Net.I.Pending.Count == before, 6);
        }
        int atFull = Net.I.Pending.Count;
        Net.I.Invite();
        Check(Net.I.Full && Net.I.Players.Count + atFull == 8 && Net.I.Pending.Count == atFull
              && Net.I.LastStatus == "The session is full (8 players, counting invites not yet answered). Cancel an invite to free a place.",
              $"the session is full at 8 with invites counted, and says how to free a place ({Net.I.Players.Count} + {atFull}; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
        Net.I.GoOffline();
        await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
        Check(Net.I.NetworkIdle && Net.I.Pending.Count == 0 && Rendezvous.ListenPort == 0,
              $"back offline: every invite hung up, the listener closed, nothing left running ({Net.I.Pending.Count} pending, port {Rendezvous.ListenPort})");
    }

    // ── WEBRTC, R4: THE WATCHDOG THROUGH THE BOX (§3.6, §10.4 R4; -Wan only) ─────────────────────────────
    // After the paste guest's return the box drops every datagram of the invite path for 12 s. Neither
    // end is told: each hears nothing, and its watchdog (Link.QuietMs, 8 s) drops the other 8 +/- 1 s in --
    // the guest reads §3.9's text, the host lets the guest go and makes it a fresh invite, which the
    // courier carries once the blackhole lifts. The moment it began is the guest's, in wall-clock ms (the
    // two processes share a clock, not a start), posted through the courier.
    static long WallMs => DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
    async Task R4GuestBlackhole()
    {
        long t0 = WallMs;
        Box("POST", "/box/blackhole?s=12");
        Post(CourierFile("blackhole", P(27115), 0), t0.ToString());
        await RealTime(() => !Net.IsOnline, 12);
        double lost = (WallMs - t0) / 1000.0;
        Check(!Net.IsOnline && lost >= 7 && lost <= 9
              && Net.I.LastStatus == "Lost the connection to HostPilot. Ask them for a new invite code: your place is held 90 s. Your own world keeps running.",
              $"guest: into a 12 s blackhole, its watchdog lets the host go 8 +/- 1 s in, told to ask for a new invite ({lost:0.0} s; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
        await RealTime(() => WallMs - t0 >= 12000, 6);
        bool back = await R2cJoinByInvite(2, 0.5f, 3f, 20);
        await Wait(0.5);
        Check(back && Net.I.JoinedBy == "paste" && Me != null && Me.OwnerId == Net.LocalId && Me.Pilot == "Guesty",
              $"guest: back by the host's fresh invite once the blackhole lifted (id {Net.LocalId})");
    }
    async Task<PlayerShip> R4HostBlackhole(PlayerShip g)
    {
        string f = CourierFile("blackhole", P(27115), 0);
        if (!await RealTime(() => System.IO.File.Exists(f), 15)) { Check(false, "host: the guest posted its blackhole's start"); return null; }
        long t0 = long.Parse(System.IO.File.ReadAllText(f));
        int gid = g?.OwnerId ?? 0;
        long droppedAt = 0;
        void Heard(string s) { if (s == $"Player {gid} dropped.") droppedAt = WallMs; }
        Net.I.Status += Heard;
        await RealTime(() => droppedAt > 0, 12);
        Net.I.Status -= Heard;
        double lost = (droppedAt - t0) / 1000.0;
        Check(droppedAt > 0 && lost >= 7 && lost <= 9 && !Multiplayer.GetPeers().Contains(gid),
              $"host: into a 12 s blackhole, its watchdog lets the guest go 8 +/- 1 s in ({(droppedAt > 0 ? $"{lost:0.0} s" : "never")})");
        await RealTime(() => WallMs - t0 >= 12000, 6);
        bool posted = await R2cPostInvite(2);
        bool took = await R2cTakeReply(2, byClipboard: false, 30);
        await RealTime(() => H.Ships.Any(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gid), 25);
        await Wait(0.5);
        var back = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gid);
        Check(posted && took && back != null && ((System.Collections.IDictionary)Session.Places).Count == 0,
              $"host: the fresh invite, carried after the blackhole lifted, brings the guest back into its place ({back?.OwnerId})");
        return back;
    }
    // Net.Report's backlog and silence lines, for -Wan's print
    static string R4Backlog() =>
        string.Join("; ", Net.I.Report().Split('\n').Where(l => l.StartsWith("peak backlog by row") || l.StartsWith("round trip")));

    // ── WEBRTC, R3: WHAT THE PLAYER READS (§6), THE PANEL'S LIST, COPY NETWORK REPORT (§6.3) ──────────
    // Solo. Each §6 sentence whose path runs in one process, read literally: the listener moved off a taken
    // port; a reply whose connection never came up (its 12 s moved to now) and the fresh invite it brings;
    // an invite unanswered for 15 min (its birth moved back); CANCEL on the pending list freeing a place;
    // the report's lines and its button; the hint; and the guest's side -- a reply whose countdown ran out,
    // MAKE A FRESH REPLY, and a connection that closed.
    static System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener Occupy(int port)
    {
        var l = new System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener(System.Net.IPAddress.IPv6Any, port);
        l.Server.DualMode = true;
        l.Start();
        return l;
    }
    T PanelOf<T>(string name) where T : Node => GetTree().Root.FindChild(name, true, false) as T;
    async Task R3WordsChecks()
    {
        const string Hosting = "Hosting. INVITE A FRIEND makes a code for one friend. Friends on this network or on Radmin VPN can type an address below instead.";
        Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
        // THE LISTENER MOVED: 1 to 3 ports taken where it starts, from three varied bases
        var moved = new List<string>();
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            int port = P(27141 + 10 * k + Rng.RandiRange(0, 4)), taken = Rng.RandiRange(1, 3);
            var held = new List<System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener>();
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < taken; i++) held.Add(Occupy(port + i));
                Net.I.Host(port);
                int at = Rendezvous.ListenPort;
                bool ok = at == port + taken && Net.I.LastStatus == $"{Hosting} Port {port} is taken on this PC, so friends typing an address use port {at}."
                          && Net.I.Addresses.Count > 0 && Net.I.Addresses[0].EndsWith($":{at}");
                moved.Add(ok ? "ok" : $"{port} with {taken} taken: {at}; {Net.I.LastStatus}");
            }
            catch (System.Net.Sockets.SocketException e) { moved.Add($"{port}: could not take it for the check ({e.Message})"); }
            Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
            foreach (var l in held) l.Stop();
        }
        Check(moved.All(m => m == "ok"), $"a taken port moves the listener to the next free one, and HOST's line says which ({string.Join("; ", moved)})");
        Net.I.Host(P(27172));
        Check(Net.I.LastStatus == Hosting && Rendezvous.ListenPort == P(27172), $"a free port adds nothing to HOST's line ({Net.I.LastStatus})");

        // A REPLY WHOSE CONNECTION NEVER CAME UP: its 12 s moved to now; the friend gets a fresh invite
        var heard = new List<string>();
        void Heard(string line) => heard.Add(line);
        Net.I.Status += Heard;
        Net.I.Invite();
        await RealTime(() => Net.I.LastInvite.Length > 0, 6);
        var inv = Rendezvous.Find(Net.I.LastInvite, Rendezvous.Kind.Invite);
        var answer = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply);
        answer.Id = inv?.Id ?? 0; answer.Candidates.Clear(); answer.Name = "Friend" + Rng.RandiRange(10, 99);
        Net.I.TakeCode(Message(Rendezvous.Encode(answer)));
        if (Net.I.Pending.Find(answer.Id) is { } linking) linking.Until = Time.GetTicksMsec();
        const string RanOut = "). Their reply may have run out: a reply works for 30 s. A new invite for them: COPY.";
        await RealTime(() => heard.Any(l => l.StartsWith($"{answer.Name} could not get through (") && l.EndsWith(RanOut)), 6);
        var fresh = Net.I.Pending.All.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Name == answer.Name);
        Check(inv != null && Net.I.Pending.Find(answer.Id) == null && fresh is { Stage: Rendezvous.Stage.Waiting, Row: "paste" } && fresh.Code.Length > 0
              && heard.Any(l => l.StartsWith($"{answer.Name} could not get through (") && l.EndsWith(RanOut)),
              $"a reply whose connection is not up 12 s after it was taken: hung up, and a fresh invite for that friend, one COPY away ({heard.LastOrDefault()})");
        // AN INVITE NOBODY ANSWERED FOR 15 MIN
        var old = Net.I.Pending.All.First(e => e.Stage == Rendezvous.Stage.Waiting);
        int oldId = old.Id;
        old.Made = unchecked(Time.GetTicksMsec() - 900_000UL - (ulong)Rng.RandiRange(0, 60_000));
        await RealTime(() => Net.I.Pending.Find(oldId) == null, 2);
        Check(Net.I.Pending.Find(oldId) == null && heard.Contains("An invite from 15 min ago ran out unused."),
              $"an invite unanswered for 15 min is hung up and says so ({heard.LastOrDefault()})");
        // THE REPORT: this build, the session, every code made, the join's times, the window, the pickup
        string report = Net.I.Report();
        string[] wanted =
        {
            $"WARSHIPS NETWORK REPORT · build {Game.Build} ({Net.Protocol:x8})", "hosting: 1 players", "typed addresses: Same network: ",
            "reply window 30 s; clipboard pickup on", $"invite {answer.Id} by paste: ", "; the fit dropped ", $"join {answer.Id} by paste: invite made +0 ms, reply taken +",
            " ms, ICE connected never, channels open never, admitted never",     // a reply with no candidates: nothing came up
            "peak backlog by row: ", $"longest silence from a peer ",
        };
        var missing = wanted.Where(w => !report.Contains(w, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
        Check(missing.Count == 0, $"COPY NETWORK REPORT names the build, the session, each code made and each join's times ({string.Join(" | ", missing)} missing from: {report.Replace("\n", " / ")})");
        // ...and its button puts it on the clipboard
        Clip = "";
        PanelOf<Button>("CopyReport")?.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);
        Check(Clip.StartsWith("WARSHIPS NETWORK REPORT · build "), $"COPY NETWORK REPORT copies the report ({(Clip.Length > 40 ? Clip[..40] : Clip)})");
        // CANCEL on the pending list frees a place: filled to the full, then one cancelled
        for (int k = 0; k < 8 && !Net.I.Full; k++)
        {
            int before = Net.I.Pending.Count;
            Net.I.Invite();
            await RealTime(() => Net.I.Pending.All.All(e => e.Code.Length > 0) || Net.I.Pending.Count == before, 6);
        }
        await Wait(0.1);
        var list = PanelOf<VBoxContainer>("PendingList");
        var rows = list == null ? new List<HBoxContainer>() : Nodes<HBoxContainer>(list).Where(r => r.Name.ToString().StartsWith("Invite")).ToList();
        int pick = Rng.RandiRange(0, Math.Max(0, rows.Count - 1));
        int full = Net.I.Pending.Count;
        var cancel = rows.Count > pick ? Nodes<Button>(rows[pick]).FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "Cancel") : null;
        int cancelled = rows.Count > pick && int.TryParse(rows[pick].Name.ToString()["Invite".Length..], out int cid) ? cid : 0;
        cancel?.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);
        Check(rows.Count == full && cancel != null && !Net.I.Full && Net.I.Pending.Count == full - 1 && Net.I.Pending.Find(cancelled) == null,
              $"the pending list has a line per invite, and CANCEL on one frees its place ({rows.Count} lines for {full}; {Net.I.Pending.Count} left)");
        Net.I.Status -= Heard;
        // THE HINT (§6.3)
        Check(Hints.All["multiplayer"].Body == "HOST THIS WORLD, then INVITE A FRIEND and send them the code. To join, paste an invite into JOIN and send back the reply it copies.",
              $"the multiplayer hint says how invites work ({Hints.All["multiplayer"].Body})");
        Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);

        // THE GUEST: three invites from a host that never takes the reply. Each reply copied with its
        // countdown; the countdown run out (moved to now); MAKE A FRESH REPLY; the last one's connection closed.
        var deadline = typeof(Net).GetField("_deadline", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        var guestSaid = new List<string>();
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var hostInv = VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Invite);
            hostInv.Proto = Net.Protocol; hostInv.Build = Game.Build;
            // somewhere that never answers: the box's silent port, not a stranger's address
            hostInv.Candidates = new List<Rendezvous.Candidate> { VaryCandidate(Rendezvous.Via.Host, System.Net.IPAddress.Loopback) with { Port = P(19482) } };
            string name = hostInv.Name;
            bool joined = Net.I.Join(Message(Rendezvous.Encode(hostInv)));
            await RealTime(() => Net.I.ReplyCode.Length > 0, 6);
            string first = Net.I.ReplyCode, copied = Net.I.LastStatus;
            bool told = copied == $"Reply copied. Send it to {name} now: they have 30 s to take it."
                                  + (hostInv.NoStun ? $" This invite works only on {name}'s network or over Radmin VPN." : "");
            await Wait(0.1);
            bool shown = PanelOf<Label>("ReplyCode") is { } shownLbl && shownLbl.Text.StartsWith(first) && shownLbl.Text.Contains(" s left for the host to take it");
            if (k < 2)
            {
                deadline.SetValue(Net.I, Time.GetTicksMsec());
                await RealTime(() => !Net.I.Connecting, 2);
                bool ranOut = Net.I.LastStatus == $"{name} did not connect within 30 s of your reply. MAKE A FRESH REPLY and send that one, or ask them for a new invite. Playing offline.";
                await Wait(0.1);
                var freshBtn = PanelOf<Button>("FreshReply");
                bool offered = freshBtn != null && freshBtn.Visible && Net.I.FreshFrom.Length > 0;
                await Wait(1.1);                                      // the panel's one press a second
                freshBtn?.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);
                await RealTime(() => Net.I.ReplyCode.Length > 0 && Net.I.ReplyCode != first, 6);
                bool again = Net.I.Connecting && Net.I.ReplyCode.Length > 0 && Net.I.ReplyCode != first && Rendezvous.Find(Net.I.ReplyCode, Rendezvous.Kind.Reply)?.Id == hostInv.Id;
                guestSaid.Add(joined && told && shown && ranOut && offered && again ? "ok" : $"{name}: joined {joined}, told {told} ({copied}), shown {shown}, ran out {ranOut} ({Net.I.LastStatus}), offered {offered}, again {again}");
            }
            else
            {
                // the connection closed under it: over at once, not at the end of the countdown
                var answerConn = (Link.Gather)typeof(Net).GetField("_answer", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(Net.I);
                answerConn?.Conn?.Close();
                await RealTime(() => !Net.I.Connecting, 2);
                bool closed = Net.I.LastStatus == $"Could not get through to {name}: the connection was closed. Try again with you hosting, or use Radmin VPN (radmin-vpn.com). Playing offline.";
                guestSaid.Add(joined && told && shown && closed && Net.I.FreshFrom.Length > 0 ? "ok" : $"{name}: joined {joined}, told {told}, shown {shown}, closed {closed} ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
            }
            Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
        }
        Check(guestSaid.All(g => g == "ok"),
              $"a guest's reply is copied with its countdown; the countdown run out says so and offers MAKE A FRESH REPLY, which answers the same invite again; a closed connection says so at once ({string.Join("; ", guestSaid)})");
    }

    // ── GATE FIX (lane net2): P8's REFIT, the JOIN box's pickup, the token to the host alone, the join's ICE time ──
    // P8 (solo): REFIT is one rule (Hub.RefitOpen). At home in a fight the pilot's own REFIT and class
    // picker are shut, as the host would refuse the class; a class change keeps the hull's fraction and
    // does not reset a cooldown.
    async Task GateFixRefitChecks()
    {
        var combat = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_combatT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        var cls0 = Character.Class; var at0 = Me.Position;
        // AT HOME IN A FIGHT, from 3 varied moments of it and 3 places: REFIT charges nothing and opens
        // nothing, and a class card pressed in a creator already open keeps the class the pilot has
        int refused = 0; string refusedSeen = "";
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var me = Me; me.Position = VaryNear(Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(0, 900), 400f); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            combat.SetValue(me, (double)Vary(2f, (float)PlayerShip.CombatHold - 1f));
            int lv = Character.Level; var had = Character.Class;
            double credits = H.Yard.Credits;                    // read right around the press: the hauler sells every frame
            H.ResetShip();
            bool noRefit = !H.CreatorOpen && Math.Abs(H.Yard.Credits - credits) < 1e-6 && Character.Level == lv;
            await Wait(0.05);
            var cc = new CharacterCreator(); H.AddChild(cc); await Wait(0.05);
            var card = Nodes<Button>(cc).FirstOrDefault(b => Classes.All.Any(e => e.Ready && e.Id != had && b.Text.StartsWith(e.Name + "  ")));
            card?.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed); await Wait(0.05);
            bool kept = card != null && Character.Class == had && Me?.Class == had;
            cc.QueueFree(); await Wait(0.05);
            refusedSeen += $"{noRefit}/{kept}/{H.MayRefit}; ";
            if (noRefit && kept && !H.MayRefit) refused++;
        }
        combat.SetValue(Me, 0.0);
        Check(refused == 3 && H.MayRefit,
              $"at home in a fight, from 3 varied moments of it: REFIT charges nothing and opens nothing, and a class picked in the creator is refused -- the class the host would keep; out of it REFIT is open again ({refusedSeen}P8)");
        // A CLASS CHANGE KEEPS THE HULL'S FRACTION, from 3 varied pairs and fractions, clear of the base
        var pairs = new[] { (ShipClass.Battleship, ShipClass.Carrier), (ShipClass.Destroyer, ShipClass.FreightHauler), (ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, ShipClass.LightDart) };
        int fracKept = 0; string fracSeen = "";
        foreach (var (a, b) in pairs)
        {
            await SetClass(a);
            var ma = Me; ma.Position = VaryNear(Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(2400, 2400), 150f); ma.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            combat.SetValue(ma, 0.0);
            double f = Vary(0.25f, 0.75f);
            ma.Hp = f * ma.MaxHp;
            await SetClass(b);
            var mb = Me;                                        // re-taken after the wait
            double got = mb.MaxHp > 0 ? mb.Hp / mb.MaxHp : -1;
            fracSeen += $"{a}->{b} {f:0.000}->{got:0.000}; ";
            if (mb.Class == b && Math.Abs(got - f) < 0.01) fracKept++;   // 0.1 s of calm regeneration is 0.003
        }
        Check(fracKept == 3, $"a class changed at home out of a fight keeps the hull's fraction, not a full hull, from 3 varied pairs ({fracSeen}P8)");
        // ...AND DOES NOT RESET A COOLDOWN: A's, set, then B flown and A again, reads what is left of it
        int coolKept = 0; string coolSeen = "";
        foreach (var (a, b) in pairs)
        {
            await SetClass(a);
            var ma = Me; var rows = Abilities.For(a);
            if (rows.Length == 0) { coolSeen += $"{a} has no ability; "; continue; }
            string id = rows[Rng.RandiRange(0, rows.Length - 1)].Id;
            double c = Vary(20f, 40f);
            ma.Sl(id).Cool = c; double t0 = ma.Clock;
            await SetClass(b); await SetClass(a);
            var mc = Me;                                        // re-taken after the waits
            double left = c - (mc.Clock - t0), got = mc.Sl(id).Cool;
            coolSeen += $"{a} {id} {c:0.0}->{got:0.00} (left {left:0.00}); ";
            if (mc.Class == a && got >= left - 0.1 && got <= c + 1e-6 && got > 1) coolKept++;
        }
        Check(coolKept == 3, $"a class change does not reset a cooldown: flying another class and back, the ability still has what was left of it, from 3 varied pairs ({coolSeen}P8)");
        await SetClass(cls0);
        if (Me is { } back) { back.Position = at0; back.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; back.Hp = back.MaxHp; combat.SetValue(back, 0.0); }
    }

    // §15 Q1 (solo): the JOIN box fills itself from a copied invite, while a reply or words leave it alone.
    async Task GateFixJoinBoxChecks()
    {
        var toggle = PanelOf<Button>("NetToggle"); var box = PanelOf<LineEdit>("JoinBox");
        bool wasOpen = toggle.ButtonPressed; string clipWas = Clip;
        Net.I.GoOffline(); await RealTime(() => Net.I.NetworkIdle, 3);
        toggle.ButtonPressed = true;
        int filled = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)                              // 3 varied invites, each a friend's whole message
        {
            box.Text = "";
            string msg = Message(Rendezvous.Encode(VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Invite)));
            Clip = msg;
            await RealTime(() => box.Text == msg, 2);
            if (box.Text == msg) filled++;
        }
        box.Text = "";                                           // the pilot empties it: the same invite does not come back
        await RealTime(() => box.Text.Length > 0, 1.2);
        bool staysEmpty = box.Text == "";
        Clip = Message(Rendezvous.Encode(VaryRecord(Rendezvous.Kind.Reply)));
        await RealTime(() => box.Text.Length > 0, 1.2);
        bool replyLeft = box.Text == "";
        Clip = "see you at eight -- bring the good snacks " + Rng.RandiRange(10, 99);
        await RealTime(() => box.Text.Length > 0, 1.2);
        bool wordsLeft = box.Text == "";
        Check(filled == 3 && staysEmpty && replyLeft && wordsLeft,
              $"the JOIN box fills itself from a copied invite, 3 of 3 ({filled}); emptied, it stays so ({staysEmpty}); a reply ({replyLeft}) or words ({wordsLeft}) leave it alone (§15 Q1)");
        box.Text = ""; Clip = clipWas; toggle.ButtonPressed = wasOpen;
    }

    // P10b (rung 5, third player): the rejoin token goes to the host alone. Watched from the moment it
    // joins to the moment it leaves: its copy of Guesty's identity never carried a token.
    (LateSampler token, LateSampler heard) GateFixTokenWatch()
    {
        var token = new LateSampler { Probe = () => Net.I != null && Net.I.Players.Values.Any(p => p.Name == "Guesty" && p.Token.Length > 0) };
        var heard = new LateSampler { Probe = () => Net.I != null && Net.I.Players.Values.Any(p => p.Name == "Guesty" && p.HasIdentity) };
        AddChild(token); AddChild(heard);
        return (token, heard);
    }
    void GateFixTokenCheck((LateSampler token, LateSampler heard) w)
    {
        Check(w.heard.Seen && !w.token.Seen,
              $"third player: Guesty's identity reached it with no rejoin token, from its first join to its last (heard {w.heard.Seen}, a token seen {w.token.Seen}; P10b)");
        w.token.QueueFree(); w.heard.QueueFree();
    }

    // §6.3 (rung 5, host): a real join's report line reads its five times, ICE connected before the channels open.
    void GateFixJoinTimes()
    {
        var m = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(Net.I.Report(),
            @"by paste: invite made \+0 ms, reply taken \+(\d+) ms, ICE connected \+(\d+) ms, channels open \+(\d+) ms, admitted \+(\d+) ms");
        long Ms(int g) => long.Parse(m.Groups[g].Value);
        Check(m.Success && Ms(1) <= Ms(2) && Ms(2) <= Ms(3) && Ms(3) <= Ms(4),
              $"host: the invite guest's join in the report -- invite made, reply taken, ICE connected, channels open, admitted, in that order ({(m.Success ? m.Value : Net.I.Report().Replace("\n", " / "))})");
    }

    // ── WEBRTC, R2c: THE ROLES MOVED (§10.2, §10.3) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The `guest` role joins BY INVITE, its codes carried by the courier (the host posts each invite as a
    // message, numbered n; the guest puts it through the JOIN box and posts back the reply it makes); the
    // host takes reply 0 off the clipboard (the pickup, §3.4) and every later one through the reply box.
    // Under -Wan the GUEST rewrites both codes to a box pair (Rewrite), so every datagram of the invite path
    // crosses the box; the typed rows run direct. A file is written whole, then moved into its name.
    static void Post(string file, string text)
    {
        System.IO.File.WriteAllText(file + ".part", text);
        System.IO.File.Move(file + ".part", file, true);
    }
    readonly HashSet<string> _posted = new();
    string _replySaid = "";
    // Host: the newest invite this session made, once it is made, posted as invite n.
    async Task<bool> R2cPostInvite(int n)
    {
        bool made = await RealTime(() => Net.I.LastInvite.Length > 0 && !_posted.Contains(Net.I.LastInvite), 8);
        if (!made) return false;
        _posted.Add(Net.I.LastInvite);
        Post(CourierFile("invite", P(27115), n), Message(Net.I.LastInvite));
        return true;
    }
    // Host: reply n, once the courier brings it, handed to the game the way a player would.
    async Task<bool> R2cTakeReply(int n, bool byClipboard, double within)
    {
        string f = CourierFile("reply", P(27115), n);
        if (!await RealTime(() => System.IO.File.Exists(f), within)) return false;
        string text = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(f);
        if (byClipboard) { Clip = text; return true; }             // copied from the DM: the pickup takes it
        if (GetTree().Root.FindChild("ReplyBox", true, false) is not LineEdit box) return false;
        box.Text = text;
        box.EmitSignal(LineEdit.SignalName.TextSubmitted, text);
        return true;
    }
    // Guest: invite n from the courier into the JOIN box, a friend's pause first; its reply posted back;
    // true once this guest is let in.
    async Task<bool> R2cJoinByInvite(int n, float pauseLo, float pauseHi, double within)
    {
        string f = CourierFile("invite", P(27115), n);
        if (!await RealTime(() => System.IO.File.Exists(f), within)) { Check(false, $"guest: invite {n} reached the courier ({f})"); return false; }
        string text = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(f);
        int pair = 0, boxB = 0, hostReal = 0;
        if (Wan)
        {
            var made = Box("POST", "/box/pair");
            pair = made.GetProperty("n").GetInt32(); boxB = made.GetProperty("b").GetInt32();
            text = Message(Rewrite(text, Rendezvous.Kind.Invite, made.GetProperty("a").GetInt32(), out hostReal));
        }
        await Wait(Vary(pauseLo, pauseHi));
        if (GetTree().Root.FindChild("JoinBox", true, false) is not LineEdit box) { Check(false, "guest: the JOIN box is on the panel"); return false; }
        string had = Net.I.ReplyCode;                              // the last join's, never taken for this one's
        box.Text = text;
        box.EmitSignal(LineEdit.SignalName.TextSubmitted, text);
        if (!await RealTime(() => Net.I.ReplyCode.Length > 0 && Net.I.ReplyCode != had, 8)) { Check(false, $"guest: invite {n} made a reply ({Net.I.LastStatus})"); return false; }
        string reply = Net.I.ReplyCode;
        _replySaid = Net.I.LastStatus;
        if (Wan)
        {
            reply = Rewrite(reply, Rendezvous.Kind.Reply, boxB, out int guestReal);
            Box("POST", $"/box/pair/{pair}?host=127.0.0.1:{hostReal}&guest=127.0.0.1:{guestReal}&seed={Seed}");
        }
        Post(CourierFile("reply", P(27115), n), Message(reply));
        return await RealTime(() => Net.IsOnline && Net.LocalId != 1, Wan ? 25 : 15);
    }
    // Host, from HOST: INVITE A FRIEND for the paste guest, its invite posted, its reply taken off the
    // clipboard -- the host's part is "copy the friend's message" (§3.4).
    async Task R2cHostCourier()
    {
        string joining = "";
        void Joining(string s) { if (s.EndsWith(" is joining…")) joining = s; }
        Net.I.Status += Joining;
        Net.I.Invite();
        bool posted = await R2cPostInvite(0);
        bool copied = await R2cTakeReply(0, byClipboard: true, 12);
        bool taken = copied && await RealTime(() => joining.Length > 0, 2);
        Net.I.Status -= Joining;
        Check(posted && taken && joining == "guest Base is joining…",
              $"host: INVITE A FRIEND's invite went out by the courier, and the friend's reply was taken off the clipboard once copied (the pickup) -- \"{joining}\"");
    }
    // Host, once the guests are in: the paste guest joined by invite, the third player by address.
    void R2cRows()
    {
        var g = Net.I.Players.FirstOrDefault(kv => kv.Value.Name == "Guesty").Key;
        var t = Net.I.Players.FirstOrDefault(kv => kv.Value.Name == "Third").Key;
        var rowOf = (System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int, string>)typeof(Net).GetField("_rowOf", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(Net.I);
        Check(g != 0 && t != 0 && rowOf.GetValueOrDefault(g) == "paste" && rowOf.GetValueOrDefault(t) == "address" && Net.I.Pending.Count == 0,
              $"host: one session serves both rows -- Guesty came by invite, Third by the typed address, nothing left pending ({rowOf.GetValueOrDefault(g)}, {rowOf.GetValueOrDefault(t)}; {Net.I.Pending.Count} pending)");
    }
    // Host, after the third player has left: the paste guest dropped (no goodbye) gets a fresh invite and
    // comes back into its held place by its rejoin token; then, back again before this host notices its
    // old link die, its token takes the place from that live link (the live holder, S2b).
    async Task R2cHostReturns()
    {
        var places = (System.Collections.IDictionary)Session.Places;
        int gOld = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty")?.OwnerId ?? 0;
        const string Dropped = "Guesty dropped. Send them this invite to come back (their place is held 90 s): COPY.";
        bool said = false;
        void Heard(string s) { said |= s == Dropped; }
        Net.I.Status += Heard;
        Drop(gOld);
        await RealTime(() => said, 5);
        Net.I.Status -= Heard;
        Check(said && gOld != 0 && places.Count == 1 && Net.I.Pending.All.Any(e => e.Row == "paste" && e.Stage == Rendezvous.Stage.Waiting && e.Name == "Guesty"),
              $"host: a paste guest that drops is held 90 s and gets a fresh invite at once, named for it ({Net.I.LastStatus}; {places.Count} held)");
        bool posted = await R2cPostInvite(1);
        bool took = await R2cTakeReply(1, byClipboard: false, 45);
        await RealTime(() => H.Ships.Any(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gOld), Wan ? 25 : 15);
        await Wait(0.5);
        var g2 = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gOld);
        string cid = g2 != null && Net.I.Players.TryGetValue(g2.OwnerId, out var gi) ? gi.CharacterId : "";
        Check(posted && took && g2 != null && cid.EndsWith("-guest") && Session.Tokens.ContainsKey(cid) && places.Count == 0 && Net.I.Pending.Count == 0
              && H.PartyIds.Contains(g2.OwnerId) && !H.PartyIds.Contains(gOld),
              $"host: the paste guest came back by the fresh invite into its held place, claimed with its rejoin token ({g2?.OwnerId}; {places.Count} held, {Net.I.Pending.Count} pending)");
        if (Wan) g2 = await R4HostBlackhole(g2) ?? g2;
        // THE LIVE HOLDER: a new invite for the same pilot, whose old link this host still thinks is up
        int gMid = g2?.OwnerId ?? 0, again = 0;
        void Again(string s) { if (s.Contains("Send them this invite to come back")) again++; }
        Net.I.Status += Again;
        Net.I.Invite();
        bool posted2 = await R2cPostInvite(Wan ? 3 : 2);
        bool took2 = await R2cTakeReply(Wan ? 3 : 2, byClipboard: false, 20);
        ulong tTook = Time.GetTicksMsec();
        await RealTime(() => H.Ships.Any(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gMid && s.OwnerId != gOld) && !Multiplayer.GetPeers().Contains(gMid), Wan ? 12 : 8);
        double handed = (Time.GetTicksMsec() - tTook) / 1000.0;
        await Wait(0.5);
        Net.I.Status -= Again;
        var g3 = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty" && s.OwnerId != gMid && s.OwnerId != gOld);
        Check(posted2 && took2 && g3 != null && !Multiplayer.GetPeers().Contains(gMid) && handed < 6 && again == 0 && places.Count == 0 && Net.I.Pending.Count == 0
              && H.PartyIds.Contains(g3.OwnerId) && !H.PartyIds.Contains(gMid),
              $"host: the pilot back with its token while its old link still lived -- the old one let go at once ({handed:0.0} s after the reply, before the 8 s watchdog), its place handed over, no fresh invite for a pilot that is here ({g3?.OwnerId}; {again} fresh, {places.Count} held, {Net.I.Pending.Count} pending)");
    }
    // Guest, dropped by its host: by invite it cannot knock again, so it tries nothing for 20 s (the
    // address row's retries end at 14 s and RECONNECT shows at 19 s), then comes back by the host's fresh invite.
    async Task R2cGuestReturns()
    {
        ulong tLost = Time.GetTicksMsec();
        bool tried = false;
        while (Time.GetTicksMsec() - tLost < 20000)
        {
            tried |= Net.I.Connecting || Net.I.Reconnecting || Net.I.CanReconnect || Net.IsOnline;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        Check(!tried, $"guest: dropped from an invite, it tries nothing by itself for 20 s -- no retry, no RECONNECT ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
        int before = Net.LocalId;
        bool back = await R2cJoinByInvite(1, 0.5f, 3f, 30);
        await Wait(0.5);
        Check(back && Net.I.JoinedBy == "paste" && Session.Rejoin.Length == 32 && Me != null && Me.OwnerId == Net.LocalId && Me.Pilot == "Guesty",
              $"guest: back in by the host's fresh invite, holding its rejoin token, flying its own ship ({Net.I.JoinedBy}; token {Session.Rejoin.Length} characters; id {Net.LocalId})");
        if (Wan) await R4GuestBlackhole();
        // THE LIVE HOLDER: the next invite waits on the courier; this link goes silent without a word (the
        // process frozen: its peer orphaned, still up, never polled), and the pilot joins at once
        int holderN = Wan ? 3 : 2;
        string next = CourierFile("invite", P(27115), holderN);
        await RealTime(() => System.IO.File.Exists(next), 15);
        var peerField = typeof(Net).GetField("_peer", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        var orphan = peerField.GetValue(Net.I) as WebRtcMultiplayerPeer;
        int midId = Net.LocalId;
        peerField.SetValue(Net.I, null);
        Net.I.GoOffline();
        bool back2 = await R2cJoinByInvite(holderN, 0.05f, 0.3f, 5);
        await Wait(0.5);
        Check(back2 && orphan != null && Net.LocalId != midId && Me != null && Me.OwnerId == Net.LocalId && Me.Pilot == "Guesty",
              $"guest: back again while its old link still lived, under a new id (id {midId} -> {Net.LocalId})");
        orphan?.Close();
    }

    // P4 (host half): a boss held by a shockwave is still being shot. Its hull steps to 0.80, 0.75,
    // 0.70 and 0.65 of its max INSIDE one 3 s hold, 0.6 s apart, for the guest to see every step.
    async Task S2HeldBossHost(Boss boss)
    {
        if (boss == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(boss)) { Check(false, "arena host: a boss to hold (P4)"); return; }
        boss.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 3.0);
        bool heldAll = true;
        foreach (var f in new[] { 0.80, 0.75, 0.70, 0.65 })
        {
            if (boss.Hp > boss.MaxHp * f) boss.TakeDamage(boss.Hp - boss.MaxHp * f);
            await Wait(0.6);
            heldAll &= boss.Held;
        }
        Check(heldAll && Math.Abs(boss.Hp / boss.MaxHp - 0.65) < 0.02,
              $"arena host: the boss held 3 s while its hull stepped 0.80, 0.75, 0.70, 0.65 of its max ({boss.Hp / boss.MaxHp:0.00}; P4)");
    }
    // P4 + P9 (guest half). First a STALE sector report, from a trip before this one, claiming home:
    // the host must ignore it (P9) -- recorded, it would send this arena nothing more. Then every
    // step of the held boss's hull must arrive (P4): a host that sends nothing while its boss is
    // held shows only the last.
    async Task S2HeldBossGuest()
    {
        Net.AskHost(H, "NetMySector", (int)Hub.SectorKind.Home, Session.HeardTrip - 1);
        var seen = new HashSet<double>();
        await RealTime(() =>
        {
            if (H?.Boss is { } b && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(b) && b.MaxHp > 0)
                foreach (var f in new[] { 0.80, 0.75, 0.70, 0.65 })
                    if (Math.Abs(b.Hp / b.MaxHp - f) < 0.02) seen.Add(f);
            return seen.Contains(0.65) || H?.MissionWon == true;
        }, 25);
        Check(seen.Count >= 3,
              $"arena guest: a held boss's hull reaches this peer step by step, after a stale sector report the host ignored ({seen.Count} of 4 steps seen: {string.Join(", ", seen.OrderByDescending(x => x))}; P4, P9)");
    }
    // P10 (host): a turret a guest left standing is its own again when it comes back under a new id.
    async Task S2TurretRekeyed(DeployedTurret t, int oldId, PlayerShip back)
    {
        await Wait(0.3);
        bool mine = t != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(t) && back != null && t.OwnerId == back.OwnerId
                    && H.Deployed.Count(d => d.OwnerId == oldId) == 0 && H.Deployed.Count(d => d.OwnerId == back.OwnerId) == 1;
        Check(mine && t.Ship == back,
              $"arena host: the turret a guest left standing is keyed to its new id when it comes back, and finds its ship ({t?.OwnerId} vs {back?.OwnerId}; P10)");
        if (t != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(t)) H.DeployedTaken(t);
    }

    async Task ArenaMp(string role)
    {
        int Port = P(27125);
        // Where the guest parks once its own stall is over, for the host to see: 400 u from where it
        // was put back, clear of it.
        var stallDone = new Vector2(900, -100);
        async Task ToArena(string who, string mission)
        {
            // the home world must be BUILT first: the scene swap is deferred, and for a frame
            // or two the old one is still current
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && (H == null || Hub.InArena || H.GetNodeOrNull("TIO") == null || !H.IsNodeReady()); i++)
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            H.SetMyReady(true);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && H.Mission != Hub.MissionState.PortalOpen; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 14 && !Hub.InArena; i++)
            {
                if (H != null && Me != null && H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.PortalOpen) { Me.Position = H.MissionPortalPos; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            // what the mission is won against, built: a boss, or a pirate base (Missions.Kinds[].Quarry)
            await RealTime(() => H != null && H.IsNodeReady() && H.Quarry != null && Me != null, 5);
            Check(Hub.InArena, $"{who}: into the arena with the other pilot ({mission})");
        }
        if (role == "ahost")
        {
            Character.Name = "Arena Host";
            Drives.PriceSnaps = false;                  // its guest is moved by hand; LaneBHostDrives prices snaps in its own window
            Net.I.Host(Port);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && Net.I.Players.Count < 2; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(Net.I.Players.Count == 2, "arena host: the guest joined");
            await Wait(1.0);
            await LaneBHostDrives();                                        // lane B: the drives across peers (its guest half: LaneBGuestDrives)
            // ── TWO OF THE NINE, IN A SESSION ─────────────────────────────────────
            // Everything the nine classes put on the wire had only ever flown alone: the status
            // bits, the slot array a class names itself, a turret dropped into the world, an
            // effect, and a bubble that covers SOMEBODY ELSE. At home before the first arena trip
            // the host flies a WARRIOR and the guest a FREIGHTER.
            // Each process seeds its own varied geometry, so the rendezvous is a LITERAL and
            // everything varied is the HOST's -- the guest reads it off the wire.
            var mpSpot = Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(2400, 2400);   // clear of the belt, the wreck, the dummies and the lane
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
            var hw = Me; hw.AutopilotTo = null;
            Check(hw.Class == ShipClass.HeavyWarrior && Math.Abs(hw.MaxHp - 140) < 1e-6 && Abilities.For(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior).Length == 10,
                  $"arena host: hosting as a WARRIOR -- its stock 140 hull, no chips, three abilities and six open slots ({hw.MaxHp:0})");
            await RealTime(() => H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is { Class: ShipClass.FreightHauler } gg
                                 && gg.Position.DistanceTo(mpSpot) < 60, Wan ? 25 : 15);
            var fg = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine);
            Check(fg != null && fg.Class == ShipClass.FreightHauler && Math.Abs(fg.MaxHp - 400) < 1e-6
                  && fg.Position.DistanceTo(mpSpot) < 60,
                  $"arena host: the guest refitted to a FREIGHTER and parked -- its stock 400 hull ({fg?.Class}, {fg?.MaxHp:0}, {fg?.Position.DistanceTo(mpSpot):0} u off)");
            hw.Position = VaryNear(fg.Position, 230f); hw.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; hw.Rotation = 0f;   // inside its 260 u, any bearing
            await Wait(0.3);
            // ITS TURRET, MADE BY THE HOST: the guest presses T; only the host may put one in the
            // world, and only the host may take it away again.
            await RealTime(() => H.Deployed.Count(t => t.OwnerId == fg.OwnerId) == 1, Wan ? 15 : 8);
            var t1 = H.Deployed.FirstOrDefault(t => t.OwnerId == fg.OwnerId);
            Check(t1 != null && H.Deployed.Count == 1 && fg.TurretsOut == 1
                  && Math.Abs(t1.Hp - 120) < 1e-6
                  && Math.Abs(t1.Spec(true).Damage - fg.Stats["deploy_damage"]) < 1e-9
                  && Math.Abs(fg.Stats["deploy_damage"] - 6) < 1e-9,     // the stock 6: the guest's freighter carries no chips
                  $"arena host: a guest's T reached the host -- one 120-hull turret firing the GUEST's sheet, {t1?.Spec(true).Damage:0.0} a shot, owned by the guest ({H.Deployed.Count} out)");
            H.Drop(fg, VaryNear(fg.Position, 420f), fg.Stats["deploy_hull"]);
            H.Drop(fg, VaryNear(fg.Position, 420f), fg.Stats["deploy_hull"]);
            await Wait(0.3);
            Check(fg.TurretsOut == 3, $"arena host: three of the guest's turrets standing ({fg.TurretsOut})");
            // WHICH ARM HOLDS WHICH SHIP IS THE HOST'S WORD. Put the first gatherer in arm 3 of the
            // base's 5 for the guest to read off the wire: the hologram bars are drawn from
            // Arm.Occupant on every peer, and nothing had ever written it anywhere but here.
            var armShip = H.Yard.Gatherers.FirstOrDefault();
            H.Yard.SetArm(armShip, 3);
            Check(armShip != null && H.Yard.ArmOf(armShip) == 3 && H.Yard.Arms[3].Occupant == armShip
                  && H.Yard.Arms.Count(a => a.Occupant != null) == 1,
                  $"arena host: its first gatherer stands in arm 3 of the base's 5, and no other arm is taken ({(armShip == null ? -1 : H.Yard.ArmOf(armShip))}, {H.Yard.Arms.Count(a => a.Occupant != null)} busy)");
            // 45 into the LAST of them (the first is the one shot off its base below): nothing
            // carried a turret's hull after the drop, so its owner watched a pristine turret take
            // a whole raid and then vanish in a burst.
            var hurtT = H.Deployed.Last(t => t.OwnerId == fg.OwnerId);
            hurtT.TakeDamage(45);
            Check(Math.Abs(hurtT.Hp - 75) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(hurtT.MaxHp - 120) < 1e-6,
                  $"arena host: 45 into one of the guest's turrets leaves 75 of 120 ({hurtT.Hp:0})");
            // THE BUBBLE IS OVER SOMEBODY ELSE. The pool is the GUEST's and the blow lands on the
            // HOST's hull: PlayerShip.ThroughBubbles reads Combat.Players, and until now no check
            // had ever had two pilots in it.
            await RealTime(() => fg.BubbleUp, Wan ? 15 : 8);
            Check(fg.BubbleUp && Math.Abs(fg.BubbleLeft - 400) < 1e-6 && hw.Position.DistanceTo(fg.Position) < 260f,
                  $"arena host: the guest's F raised its 400 bubble, and this hull is inside its 260 u ({hw.Position.DistanceTo(fg.Position):0} u)");
            double hwHull0 = hw.Hp;
            hw.Hit(150, hw.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), "test:mpbubble");
            Check(Math.Abs(hw.Hp - hwHull0) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(fg.BubbleLeft - 250) < 1e-6,
                  $"...and a 150 blow on the HOST's hull comes out of the GUEST's pool ({fg.BubbleLeft:0} of 400 left, hull {hw.Hp:0} of {hwHull0:0})");
            // THE RUSH: a status only the host decides, and an EMP whose ring is an Fx row.
            hw.UseAbility("rush", 0);
            double rushLeft = hw.Sl("rush").Left, rushCool = hw.Sl("rush").Cool;
            Check(hw.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && Math.Abs(rushLeft - 2.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(rushCool - 18) < 1e-9
                  && Math.Abs(hw.SpeedMult - 2.5f) < 1e-6,
                  $"arena host: the warrior's rush -- hardened, 2.5 s up, 18 s cooling, 2.5x top speed ({rushLeft:0.0} s, {rushCool:0.0} s)");
            // ...and one of the guest's turrets shot off its base, for the guest to see the gap and the burst
            var doomed = H.Deployed.First(t => t.OwnerId == fg.OwnerId);
            int doomedId = doomed.NetId;
            doomed.TakeDamage(1e12); await Wait(0.4);
            Check(H.Deployed.All(t => t.NetId != doomedId) && fg.TurretsOut == 2,
                  $"arena host: a turret shot off its base is gone here ({fg.TurretsOut} left out)");
            await RealTime(() => fg.TurretsOut == 1, Wan ? 20 : 12);
            Check(fg.TurretsOut == 1 && H.Deployed.Count == 1,
                  $"arena host: the guest's C picked one up again -- one of its three left standing ({fg.TurretsOut})");
            // THE RUSH MUST LAND BEFORE THE REFIT. A refit rebuilds the ship's slots, so a rush
            // still running is discarded with them and its EMP never fires -- which is right (it is
            // a different ship now), but it would leave the guest waiting for a ring that never came.
            await RealTime(() => !hw.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && hw.Sl("rush").Left <= 0, Wan ? 12 : 6);
            await Wait(0.4);
            foreach (var dpl in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dpl);   // the world clear for the arena
            await Wait(0.3);
            // A SNIPER'S RAILGUN IS HEARD ON A GUEST. Its report is a flash of Beam.All (Beam.Rail),
            // sent to every peer through the one door every flash goes through; the guest counts it
            // (its side is in the aguest branch). The real railgun, from a seeded spot 240-600 u off
            // the guest, its line pointed straight away from it.
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
            if (H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is { } railEar)
            {

                  $"arena guest: a railgun the host fired near this ship is heard here ({Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault("rail") - railHeard0} reports since joining)");

            Check(Character.Exp == 500, $"arena guest: its OWN EXP for the kill -- 150 at level 2 (300 x the boss's level over its own), +250 first clear, +100 (500; exp {Character.Exp})");

            int agDisk = agFile.HasSection("gear_hold") ? agFile.GetSectionKeys("gear_hold").Sum(k => (int)agFile.GetValue("gear_hold", k, 0)) : 0;
            Check(agDisk == agHold0 + 2 && (string)agFile.GetValue("id", "name", "") == "Arena Guest",
                  $"arena guest: both parts reached its OWN file's hold -- the one it took, and the one it left ({agDisk - agHold0} of 2; in memory {Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() - agHold0}, unclaimed {Character.Unclaimed.Count})");
            // ── THE SIEGE, SEEN FROM HERE (the ahost branch runs it) ─────────────
            // Every warning lane this peer is shown rides the pirate base -- a child of the

            int sgBaseId = 0, sgLanesSeen = 0, sgLanesElsewhere = 0; bool sgRoundSeen = false;

            await ToArena("arena guest", "the siege");
            Me.Position = Hub.ArenaCentre + new Vector2(0, 2200); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; Me.AutopilotTo = null;   // the host's literal spot

            Check(sgLanesSeen > 0 && sgLanesElsewhere == 0 && sgRoundSeen && sgWonAt > 0 && sgClearAt >= 0 && sgClearAt - sgWonAt <= 0.6,
                  $"arena guest: the siege's warning lanes ride the pirate base here ({sgLanesSeen} seen, {sgLanesElsewhere} on anything else) and its round flew at this ship ({sgRoundSeen}); within 0.6 s of the win no lane is left and no cruise missile flies ({(sgClearAt < 0 || sgWonAt < 0 ? "never" : $"{sgClearAt - sgWonAt:0.00} s")})");
            sgWatch.QueueFree();
            H.SetMyReturn(true);
            await RealTime(() => !Hub.InArena, 30);
            await RealTime(() => H != null && H.Yard != null && H.IsNodeReady(), 5);
            // what this guest is shown of the Drake Bastion, watched from before the arena is built
            bool sawDrake = false, sawShell = false, sawRock = false;
            var drakeWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
            {
                if (H == null || !Hub.InArena || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(H.Boss)) return false;
                sawDrake |= H.Boss is { Type.Id: "drake_bastion" };
                sawShell |= Slugs().Any(s => s.Cosmetic && s.Kind == Shots.Slug);
                // WHERE THE HOST HELD IT, not a figure written down here: the body is held its
                // hull's half-width, its own radius and the row's gap off the keel, and the radius
                // is scaled by the level (Boss.Scaled), so a literal here would have to be re-chosen
                // every time the hull, the rock or the level's scale moved. Read the rows and
                // assert the spot exactly.
                var heldBy = H.Boss.S("throw")?.M;
                double heldAt = heldBy == null ? 0 : H.Boss.HalfWidth + heldBy.Radius + heldBy.Offset;
                sawRock |= heldAt > 0 && Nodes<ThrownRock>().Any(r => r.Cosmetic && r.Hold <= 7.5
                                                                      && Math.Abs(r.From.DistanceTo(H.Boss.Position) - heldAt) < 2f);
                return sawDrake && sawShell && sawRock;
            } };

            await ToArena("arena guest", "mission 2");
            int agOldId = Net.LocalId;
            int agHold1 = Character.GearHold.Values.Sum();
            Me.Position = new Vector2(900, 300); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; Me.AutopilotTo = null;
            // its boss is the host's boss, scaled as the host scaled it (the host sets a party-of-3 x2.2)
            double seenMult = 0;
            await RealTime(() => { if (H?.Boss != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(H.Boss)) seenMult = H.Boss.HullMult; return Math.Abs(seenMult - 2.2) < 1e-9; }, 5);
            Check(Math.Abs(seenMult - 2.2) < 1e-9, $"arena guest: its boss is the host's boss, scaled as the host scaled it (x2.2; x{seenMult:0.00})");
            // A PEER ARRIVING MID-THROW is sent the rock and its lane as they stand (Boss.CatchUp, from
            // the host's catch-up for a peer that reports its world, as a rejoining or slow-loading guest
